For we are in danger today of being charged with causing an uprising, with no good reason for it.”
After saying this, he sent the crowd away.

verses.heading: SMALL MAN CONTINUES HIS TRAVELS / SMALL MAN CONTINUES HIS TRAVELS
verses.text: After the uprising had calmed down, Small Man (Paul) gathered the local sacred family members together to strengthen their hearts and say his farewell to them. He then left for Land of Tall People (Macedonia).
As he traveled through that territory, with many words he lifted the hearts of the members of the sacred family who lived there. He then came to Land of Wisdom Seekers (Greece)

and stayed there for three moons. Just as he was about to set out by water to Bright Sun (Syria), the Tribal Members there hatched a plot against him, so he decided to return through Land of Tall People (Macedonia).

verses.heading: SMALL MAN’S TRAVELING FRIENDS / SMALL MAN’S TRAVELING FRIENDS
verses.text: The men who went with him are Defends His Father (Sopater) the son of Red Fire (Pyrrhus) from Much Water (Berea), Good Chief (Aristarchus) and Second Blessing (Secundus) from False Victory (Thessalonica), also Glad Heart (Gaius) from Hide Tanner (Derbe), He Gives Honor (Timothy), and He Is at Ease (Tychicus) and He Eats Well (Trophimus) from Land of the Rising Sun (Asia).
These men traveled ahead of us and were waiting for us at Cut Through (Troas).

They had to wait five days because we stayed for the Festival of Bread Without Yeast. Then we set out by water from Village of Horses (Philippi) and joined with them at Cut Through (Troas) and stayed there for seven days.

verses.heading: POWER OVER DEATH / POWER OVER DEATH
verses.text: It was the first day of the week, when we gather to eat our sacred meal together. Small Man (Paul) was doing the talking because he planned to leave the next day. He was long-winded and kept talking until the middle of the night.

There were many torches burning in the upper room of the house where we had all gathered. The number of people and the torches in this room, using up the air, may have made some people sleepy or lightheaded.
verses.html:
There were many torches burning in the upper room of the house where we had all gathered.
The number of people and the torches in this room, using up the air, may have made some people sleepy or lightheaded.

verses.text: As Small Man (Paul) spoke on and on, a young man named Greatly Blessed (Eutychus), who was sitting on the window ledge, began to sink into a deep sleep. When the sleep overcame him, he fell from the third-floor window and was found dead.
Small Man (Paul) went down, bent over the young man, and put his arms around him. “Do not fear!” he said to all. “His life has returned to him.”
Small Man (Paul) went back to the upper room, ate the ceremonial meal with them, and continued speaking until sunrise. He then went on his way,
and with glad hearts they took the young man home alive!

verses.heading: MORE TRAVELS / MORE TRAVELS
verses.text: We all climbed into our canoes and headed to Move Toward (Assos), where we would take Small Man (Paul) aboard, for he had decided to travel there on land.
So he met us there and joined us as we went on to Bent Horn (Mitylene).

We set off from there, and on the following day we came to shore across from Snow Island (Chios). The next day we touched shore at Sand Cliff (Samos), and the day after that we came to White Sheep Wool (Miletus).

We did not stop at Village of Desire (Ephesus), because Small Man (Paul) was in a hurry to get to Village of Peace (Jerusalem), if possible, for the Festival of Weeks, and did not want to take the time to go to Land of the Rising Sun (Asia).
From White Sheep Wool (Miletus), Small Man (Paul) sent a messenger to Village of Desire (Ephesus) to ask the elders of the sacred family to come to him.
He said to them, “You all know how I lived among you the whole time I was with you, from the first day that I set foot in Land of the Rising Sun (Asia).
I did all Creator asked of me with a humble heart, as I walked a trail of tears when the Tribal Members schemed against me.
You also know that I held back nothing that would help you, as I taught openly and from house to house.

I spoke truth in a sacred manner to both the Tribal Members and the Wisdom Seekers (Greeks), as I told them about turning their thoughts and hearts to the Great Spirit by trusting their lives to Creator Sets Free (Jesus), our Honored Chief.
“And now, a captive of the Spirit, I am on my way to Village of Peace (Jerusalem). I do not know what will happen to me there.
I only know the Holy Spirit has made it clear to me that in every village I will be hunted down and taken captive.

But my life means nothing to me. I only want to finish walking the road the Maker of Life has set before me, telling the good story of the gift of his great kindness as I follow Creator Sets Free (Jesus), my Honored Chief.
“I now know that none of you will see my face again. You are the ones I have taught clearly about the good road.
Hear me this day! I speak from my heart, I am no longer responsible for the fate of any of you,
for I held back nothing from you. All that Creator has made known to me, I have given to you.

“Stay alert and care for one another. The Holy Spirit has given you elders the task of watching over his people. Like shepherds that guard the sheep, you will watch over his sacred family, the ones he paid the highest price for with his own lifeblood.
“I know that after I am gone savage wolves will sneak in who care nothing for the sheep.
Even some of your own elders will rise up and lead people down a false path, just to have their own followers.
So I tell you again, stay alert! Do not forget that night and day, for three winters, I kept giving you wise counsel and warning each of you with many tears.

“I now give you over to the Great Spirit’s care and to the message of the gift of his great kindness. A message that will make you stand strong and give you his promised blessings, together with all the ones he has made holy.
“I never asked anyone for their silver, gold, or fine clothes.
You all have seen that I worked hard with my own hands to provide for myself and for the ones who traveled with me.

In this way, I have walked a path for you to follow, working hard to give help to the weak. We must never forget the words of Creator Sets Free (Jesus) when he said, ‘Giving to others is a greater blessing than getting from others.’”
When Small Man (Paul) had finished speaking, he knelt down beside the elders of the sacred family and sent his voice to the Great Spirit.
With many tears they put their arms around his neck and kissed him.
Their greatest sorrow was from his words, “You will not see my face again.” Then they walked with him to our canoe to see us on our way.
verses.html:
Their greatest sorrow was from his words, “You will not see my face again.”
Then they walked with him to our canoe to see us on our way.

verses.heading: JOURNEY TO VILLAGE OF PEACE / JOURNEY TO VILLAGE OF PEACE
verses.text: After we had torn ourselves away from them we set out in our canoe and followed the shortest distance to the island of High Point (Kos). On the next day we went to Rose Island (Rhodes), and then to Walked Over (Patara).
From there we found a large canoe that was headed for Land of Palm Trees (Phoenicia) and traveled with them.
We could see Island of Flowers (Cyprus) to our left as we traveled on toward Bright Sun (Syria), and then went to shore at Rock Land (Tyre) to unload trading goods from the canoe.

We looked for members of the sacred family who lived there and, after finding them, we stayed with them for seven days. Guided by the Spirit, they kept telling Small Man (Paul) not to go to Village of Peace (Jerusalem).
verses.html: We looked for members of the sacred family who lived there and, after finding them, we stayed with them for seven days. Guided by the Spirit, they kept telling Small Man (Paul) not to go to Village of Peace (Jerusalem).

verses.text: At the end of our time with them, as we were on our way to leave, the men of the sacred family, along with their wives and children, followed us outside the village. We all knelt down at the shoreline, sent our voice to the Great Spirit,
and said our farewells. We then climbed into the canoe as they went back to their homes.
From Rock Land (Tyre) we continued on to Village of War (Ptolemais). We were welcomed by the sacred family and stayed the rest of the day with them.
The next day we left and went to Chief Village (Caesarea) and lodged there at the home of Lover of Horses (Philip), a teller of the good story and one of the seven.

Lover of Horses (Philip) had four unmarried daughters who spoke words of prophecy from the Holy Spirit. Lover of Horses (Philip) was one of the seven who had been chosen by the message bearers in Village of Peace (Jerusalem) to be in charge of serving the meals. He also went about telling the good story in High Place (Samaria).
verses.html:
Lover of Horses (Philip) had four unmarried daughters who spoke words of prophecy from the Holy Spirit.
Lover of Horses (Philip) was one of the seven who had been chosen by the message bearers in Village of Peace (Jerusalem) to be in charge of serving the meals. He also went about telling the good story in High Place (Samaria).

verses.text: We stayed there a number of days. During our stay a prophet named Grasshopper (Agabus) came to us from Land of Promise (Judea).

He took the sash from Small Man’s (Paul’s) waist and tied it around his own feet and hands. “This is what the Holy Spirit is saying,” he prophesied. “‘The tribal leaders in Village of Peace (Jerusalem) will do the same to the owner of this sash. They will tie him up and turn him over to the People of Iron (Romans).’”
When we, along with the sacred family there, heard this, we all urged Small Man (Paul) not to go to Village of Peace (Jerusalem).

“Why are you weeping and breaking my heart?” he said to them. “I am representing our Honored Chief, Creator Sets Free (Jesus). I am ready not only to be bound but even to die for him in Village of Peace (Jerusalem).”
Nothing we could say would change his mind. “Let Creator’s will be done,” we said and then remained silent.

verses.heading: ARRIVAL AT VILLAGE OF PEACE / ARRIVAL AT VILLAGE OF PEACE
verses.text: We then prepared to leave on our journey to Village of Peace (Jerusalem).

Some of the sacred family members from Chief Village (Caesarea) traveled with us, along with a longtime follower named He Will Remember (Mnason), from Island of Flowers (Cyprus), in whose house we would stay.
When we arrived at Village of Peace (Jerusalem), the sacred family welcomed us with glad hearts.

verses.heading: MEETING WITH THE COUNCIL / MEETING WITH THE COUNCIL
verses.text: The next day Small Man (Paul) went with us to meet with He Leads the Way (James) and the elders who were with him.
After giving them a respectful greeting, he told them about all the things Creator had done as he had worked among the Outside Nations.

When they heard this, they gave praise to the Great Spirit. “Our brother,” they said to him, “you can see how many thousands of our Tribal Members have become followers of Creator Sets Free (Jesus), and how our tribal law given by Drawn from the Water (Moses) burns like a fire in them!” But then their manner changed, and their voices lowered as they looked around and then back to Small Man (Paul).
verses.html:
When they heard this, they gave praise to the Great Spirit.
“Our brother,” they said to him, “you can see how many thousands of our Tribal Members have become followers of Creator Sets Free (Jesus), and how our tribal law given by Drawn from the Water (Moses) burns like a fire in them!”
But then their manner changed, and their voices lowered as they looked around and then back to Small Man (Paul).

verses.text: “They have heard that you are teaching our Tribal Members who live among the Outside Nations to turn away from Drawn from the Water (Moses). They have also heard that they should not perform the cutting of the flesh ceremony for their children or follow our tribal traditions.
What will happen when they find out you are here? What can be done?” But it seemed that they already had made plans about what to do.
verses.html:
What will happen when they find out you are here? What can be done?”
But it seemed that they already had made plans about what to do.

verses.text: “Listen, and do what we say,” they said to him. “We have four men who have taken a solemn vow of dedication.

Go and join with them in this vow and provide for the shaving of their heads. In this way you will show everyone that these rumors are false and that you still walk in our traditional tribal law.” This was the Law of Dedication (Nazarite). The men and women who make this solemn vow to the Great Spirit must drink no wine, vinegar, or strong drink, and eat no grapes or the juice of grapes. Among other things, they also must not touch a dead person, or cut their hair or beard during all the days of this vow. The vow must be kept for at least thirty days. After the days of the vow are complete, they must shave their heads in a holy ceremony at the sacred lodge in Village of Peace (Jerusalem). He Leads the Way (James) continued giving instructions to Small Man (Paul).
verses.html:
Go and join with them in this vow and provide for the shaving of their heads. In this way you will show everyone that these rumors are false and that you still walk in our traditional tribal law.”

Among other things, they also must not touch a dead person, or cut their hair or beard during all the days of this vow. The vow must be kept for at least thirty days. After the days of the vow are complete, they must shave their heads in a holy ceremony at the sacred lodge in Village of Peace (Jerusalem).
He Leads the Way (James) continued giving instructions to Small Man (Paul).

verses.text: “As for the ones from the Outside Nations who have trusted in Creator Sets Free (Jesus), we sent them a message with our decision that they should stay away from things offered to evil spirits, from drinking blood, from the meat of a strangled animal, and from sexual impurity.”
verses.html: “As for the ones from the Outside Nations who have trusted in Creator Sets Free (Jesus), we sent them a message with our decision that they should stay away from things offered to evil spirits, from drinking blood, from the meat of a strangled animal, and from sexual impurity.”

verses.text: So the next day Small Man (Paul) went with the men to the sacred lodge. He purified himself with them and told them the number of days before the vow would be complete and the sacrifice that would be offered for them.

verses.heading: SMALL MAN TAKEN CAPTIVE / SMALL MAN TAKEN CAPTIVE
verses.text: Seven days later, when the time was complete, Small Man (Paul)returned to the sacred lodge. Some Tribal Members were there from Land of the Rising Sun (Asia). When they saw him in the sacred lodge, they took hold of him and began to stir up the crowd against him.
verses.html: Seven days later, when the time was complete, Small Man (Paul)returned to the sacred lodge. Some Tribal Members were there from Land of the Rising Sun (Asia). When they saw him in the sacred lodge, they took hold of him and began to stir up the crowd against him.

verses.text: “Fellow Tribal Members!” they shouted out to the crowd. “Help us! This is the man who teaches everywhere against our people, our tribal law, and this holy place! Even worse, he has brought Wisdom Seekers (Greeks) into the lodge and has defiled this holy place.”
verses.html: “Fellow Tribal Members!” they shouted out to the crowd. “Help us! This is the man who teaches everywhere against our people, our tribal law, and this holy place! Even worse, he has brought Wisdom Seekers (Greeks) into the lodge and has defiled this holy place.”

verses.text: They said this because they had seen He Eats Well (Trophimus) from Village of Desire (Ephesus) with Small Man (Paul) in Village of Peace (Jerusalem), and thought he had brought him into the sacred lodge.
The village was in an uproar! A group of people came together, took hold of Small Man (Paul), dragged him outside the lodge, closed the gates behind him, and tried to kill him.
A messenger went from them and told the local head soldier of the People of Iron (Romans) that there was an uprising in the Village of Peace (Jerusalem).

At once he took some soldiers and their officers with him and ran to where they were attacking Small Man (Paul). When the crowd saw the head soldier and his men, they stopped beating Small Man (Paul).
The head soldier arrested him and had him bound with two chains of iron. He then asked the crowd who this man was and what he had done.
Some in the crowd shouted one thing and some another. Since the head soldier could not figure out what happened, he decided to take Small Man (Paul) back to the soldiers’ lodge.
The crowd became so violent that Small Man (Paul) had to be carried up the stairs.
“Take him away!” they shouted over and over again as they pressed close, following behind the soldiers.
Just before they got to the soldiers’ lodge, Small Man (Paul) turned to the head soldier. “Is it permitted for me to speak to you?” he asked in the soldier’s language.

“You speak the language of the Wisdom Seekers (Greeks),” he replied. “Then you are not the man from Black Land (Egypt) who some time ago caused an uprising and took four thousand assassins out into the desert wilderness.”

“I am a Tribal Man of the tribes of Wrestles with Creator (Israel),” Small Man (Paul) answered, “from Tree Village (Tarsus) in the territory of Turns Over (Cilicia), a citizen of a well-known village.” He now had the full attention of the head soldier, so he made a request. “I beg you,” he said to the head soldier, “let me speak to my people!”
verses.html:
“I am a Tribal Man of the tribes of Wrestles with Creator (Israel),” Small Man (Paul) answered, “from Tree Village (Tarsus) in the territory of Turns Over (Cilicia), a citizen of a well-known village.”
He now had the full attention of the head soldier, so he made a request.
“I beg you,” he said to the head soldier, “let me speak to my people!”

verses.text: The head soldier gave him permission, so Small Man (Paul) stood on the steps overlooking the crowd and motioned his hand to the people. A great hush settled over them, so Small Man (Paul), speaking in the language of his own people, took a deep breath and with respect began to speak to them.
verses.html: The head soldier gave him permission, so Small Man (Paul) stood on the steps overlooking the crowd and motioned his hand to the people. A great hush settled over them, so Small Man (Paul), speaking in the language of his own people, took a deep breath and with respect began to speak to them.

verses.heading: SMALL MAN SPEAKS TO THE CROWD / SMALL MAN SPEAKS TO THE CROWD
verses.text: “My fellow Tribal Members, my fathers,” he said, “hear me now as I explain myself to you.”
When the people heard him speak in their native language, they quieted down even more.

“I am a fellow Tribal Man, born in Tree Village (Tarsus) in the territory of Turns Over (Cilicia), but I was raised in Village of Peace (Jerusalem) and was taught at the feet of Creator Has Honored (Gamaliel). I learned to closely follow all of our traditional tribal laws, and a fire for the Great Spirit burned in my belly, just as it does in yours today.
“I hunted down and even killed the followers of this Way. I put both men and women in iron chains and took them to prison.

Our chief holy man and the whole council of elders are witnesses to the truth of what I say. I asked for and received written authority to give to the local Tribal Council in Silent Weaver (Damascus), with instructions to capture any followers of the Way and take them to Village of Peace (Jerusalem) to be punished.
“It was midday on the journey to Silent Weaver (Damascus). As I came near the village, suddenly a bright light from the spirit-world above was shining all around me.
I fell to the ground and heard a voice speaking to me and twice calling out my name. “‘Man Who Questions (Saul), Man Who Questions (Saul),’ the voice said, ‘why are you pursuing and mistreating me?’
verses.html:
I fell to the ground and heard a voice speaking to me and twice calling out my name.
“‘Man Who Questions (Saul), Man Who Questions (Saul),’ the voice said, ‘why are you pursuing and mistreating me?’

verses.text: “‘Honored One,’ I asked, ‘who are you?’ “‘I am Creator Sets Free (Jesus) from Seed Planter Village (Nazareth),’ the voice answered, ‘the one you are pursuing and mistreating.’
“The men who were traveling with me saw the light but did not hear the voice of the one speaking to me.
“‘Honored One,’ I asked, ‘what is it you want me to do?’ “‘Stand to your feet and go into the village,’ he said to me, ‘and there you will be told all that I want you to do.’
“Since I was still unable to see because of the bright light, the men with me led me by the hand to Silent Weaver (Damascus).

verses.heading: SMALL MAN AND CREATOR SHOWS KINDNESS / SMALL MAN AND CREATOR SHOWS KINDNESS
verses.text: “A man named Creator Shows Kindness (Ananias), who had deep respect for our tribal law and had a good reputation among our Tribal Members who lived there,
came and stood beside me. “‘Man Who Questions (Saul), my brother,’ he said to me, ‘look up and see again!’ “I looked up, and right then sight returned to my eyes!
“Then he said to me, ‘The Great Spirit of our ancestors has chosen you to know his will, to see the Upright One and hear his voice, spoken from his own mouth.
You will tell all people the truth of what you have seen and heard.
What are you waiting for? Rise up and participate in the purification ceremony, washing you clean from your broken ways, as you call out to him, trusting in all that his name represents.’
“Sometime later, after I had returned to Village of Peace (Jerusalem), I was in the sacred lodge sending my voice to the Great Spirit. I fell into a sacred vision
verses.html: “Sometime later, after I had returned to Village of Peace (Jerusalem), I was in the sacred lodge sending my voice to the Great Spirit. I fell into a sacred vision

verses.text: and saw Creator Sets Free (Jesus). “‘You must hurry and leave Village of Peace (Jerusalem) right away,’ he said to me, ‘for they will not believe what you tell them about me.’
“‘Honored One,’ I said to him, ‘they know that I used to go from one gathering house to another, capturing and whipping the ones who trusted in you.
When the blood of Many Feathers (Stephen) your truth teller was being shed, they saw that I was standing in agreement and guarding their garments while they killed him.’
“‘Go!’ he said to me. ‘I am sending you far away to the Outside Nations.’”

verses.heading: THE CROWD TURNS AGAINST HIM / THE CROWD TURNS AGAINST HIM
verses.text: The Tribal Members listened to him, up until this last word. “Away with this one!” they shouted, “He has no right to even live on this earth!”
The crowd was wailing out loud! They tore off their outer garments and threw dust into the air.
The head soldier ordered his men to take Small Man (Paul) back to their lodge with instructions to beat him with whips until he told them the reason the crowd was so angry with him.

But as they stretched him out and prepared to whip him, Small Man (Paul) turned to the head soldier standing there. “Does your law permit you to whip a citizen of Village of Iron (Rome),” he asked, “without a fair trial?”
Hearing this, the head soldier reported to his head officer. “What are you doing?” he asked. “This man is a citizen of the People of Iron (Romans).”
The head officer went to Small Man (Paul). “Tell me,” he asked, “Are you a citizen of Village of Iron (Romans)?” “Yes, I am,” Small Man (Paul) replied.
“I paid a high price to become a citizen,” the officer said to him. “But I was born a citizen of Village of Iron (Rome),” Small Man (Paul) replied.
Right away the soldiers who were about to question him backed away. Fear came upon the head officer as he realized that he had bound a citizen of Village of Iron (Rome) in chains.

verses.heading: BEFORE THE GRAND COUNCIL / BEFORE THE GRAND COUNCIL
verses.text: But the head officer wanted to know what Small Man (Paul) was being accused of by the Tribal Members, so, before releasing him, he instructed the head holy men and the Grand Council to meet. He then brought in Small Man (Paul) and stood him before them.

verses.heading: HE SPEAKS TO THE GRAND COUNCIL / HE SPEAKS TO THE GRAND COUNCIL
verses.text: Small Man (Paul) looked deeply into the eyes of the members of the Grand Council. “My fellow Tribal Members,” he said to the council, “All my life I have walked in a good way, with a pure heart before the Great Spirit.”
Hearing this, Creator Shows Kindness (Ananias) the chief holy man ordered the ones standing near Small Man (Paul) to strike his mouth.
verses.html: Hearing this, Creator Shows Kindness (Ananias) the chief holy man ordered the ones standing near Small Man (Paul) to strike his mouth.

verses.text: “Creator will strike you, you false-faced pretender!” Small Man (Paul) said back to him. “Do you sit there using our own tribal law to decide my fate, and then break the same law by ordering me struck?”
The ones standing near him said, “How dare you speak in a disrespectful manner to Creator’s chief holy man?”
“Fellow Tribal Members,” he replied, “I did not recognize that he was the chief holy man, for it is written in the Sacred Teachings, ‘You must not speak against a leader of your people.’”

Small Man (Paul), knowing that both the Upright Ones (Sadducees) and the Separated Ones (Pharisees) sat on the Grand Council, said to them, “My fellow Tribal Members, I am a Separated One (Pharisee). It is because of my hope that the dead will rise to life again that I am on trial here today.”

verses.heading: THE COUNCIL IS DIVIDED / THE COUNCIL IS DIVIDED
verses.text: When he said this, an argument broke out between the Separated Ones (Pharisees) and the Upright Ones (Sadducees). This created a division in the council,
for the Upright Ones (Sadducees) say the dead will not rise and that there are no spirits or spirit-messengers, but the Separated Ones (Pharisees) believe in them all.

The arguments grew louder and louder. Then some scroll keepers who were among the Separated Ones (Pharisees) stood up and voiced their argument forcefully. “We find no reason to condemn this man,” they cried out. “It could be that a spirit or spirit-messenger has spoken to him!”
The division broke out into violence. The head officer, afraid that Small Man (Paul) would be torn apart by them, ordered his soldiers to take him by force and bring him back to their lodge.

That night Creator Sets Free (Jesus) came and stood near him in a sacred vision. “Be strong of heart,” he said to him, “for in the same manner you have represented me in Village of Peace (Jerusalem), you must also represent me in Village of Iron (Rome).”
verses.html:
That night Creator Sets Free (Jesus) came and stood near him in a sacred vision.
“Be strong of heart,” he said to him, “for in the same manner you have represented me in Village of Peace (Jerusalem), you must also represent me in Village of Iron (Rome).”

verses.heading: THE PLOT TO KILL SMALL MAN / THE PLOT TO KILL SMALL MAN
verses.text: Early the next day, some of the Tribal Members schemed together against Small Man (Paul). They bound themselves in a solemn promise that they would not eat or drink until they had killed him.
There were more than forty men who bound themselves to each other in this twisted plan.
They went to the head holy men and elders and said to them, “We have bound ourselves with a solemn promise to neither eat nor drink until we have killed Small Man (Paul).

So we want you and the council to ask the head officer to bring him to you. Tell him that you plan to ask Small Man (Paul) some more questions. We will then be ready to ambush him on the way and kill him.”

verses.heading: WARNING FROM A NEPHEW / WARNING FROM A NEPHEW
verses.text: But when Small Man’s (Paul’s) nephew heard about the ambush, he snuck into the place where Small Man (Paul) was being held and warned him.
Small Man (Paul) then called out to one of the head soldiers, “This young man has something important to report, so take him to your head officer.”
Hearing this, the head soldier took him to the head officer, and said, “The prisoner Small Man (Paul) asked me to bring this young man to you. He has something important to tell you.”
So the head officer took the young man aside, and asked, “What is it you want to report to me?”
“Some Tribal Members from the council have agreed to ask you to bring Small Man (Paul) before them, as if they want to question him some more,” he told the head officer.

“But do not let them fool you, for there are more than forty men waiting to ambush him on the way. They have bound themselves by a solemn promise to neither eat nor drink until they have killed him. They are ready now and waiting for you to agree to bring him.”
The head officer told the young man to say nothing, sent him away,

verses.heading: SMALL MAN SENT TO THE GOVERNOR / SMALL MAN SENT TO THE GOVERNOR
verses.text: and then called two head soldiers to himself. “I want you to be ready by the third hour of the night,” he instructed them. “Gather seventy horsemen and two hundred spearmen and take them as far as Chief Village (Caesarea).”
The head officer also provided a horse and horsemen for Small Man (Paul), to bring him safely to Happy Man (Felix), the governor for the People of Iron (Romans).
Then he wrote a letter for them to give to the governor:
verses.html: Then he wrote a letter for them to give to the governor:

verses.text: “Greetings from Limping Man Who Sets Free (Claudius Lysias) to the most noble Happy Man (Felix), governor representing the People of Iron (Romans).

“This man, who has been brought before you, was taken captive by the Tribal People, who were about to kill him. But when I learned that he was also a citizen of the People of Iron (Romans), I had my soldiers rescue him.
verses.html: “This man, who has been brought before you, was taken captive by the Tribal People, who were about to kill him. But when I learned that he was also a citizen of the People of Iron (Romans), I had my soldiers rescue him.

verses.text: To find out what he was accused of, I took him before their Grand Council.
I learned that he was being accused of matters relating to their own tribal laws, but nothing deserving death or imprisonment.
When I was told of a plot against this man, I had him sent to you at once, and told his accusers to bring their accusations to you.”
So the soldiers, following their instructions, took Small Man (Paul) by night to First Ancestor Village (Antipatris).
The next day the soldiers let the horsemen take him further, while they returned to their lodge.
When the horsemen came to Chief Village (Caesarea), they gave the letter to the governor and turned Small Man (Paul) over to him.
After reading the letter, the governor asked which territory he was from. Learning that Small Man (Paul) was from Turns Over (Cilicia), he agreed to hear his case.

“I will make my decision,” he said to Small Man (Paul), “after your accusers arrive.” He then ordered that Small Man (Paul) should be kept under guard in their lodge, which used to be the lodge of Looks Brave (Herod), the bad-hearted chief of the tribes of Wrestles with Creator (Israel).
verses.html:
“I will make my decision,” he said to Small Man (Paul), “after your accusers arrive.”
He then ordered that Small Man (Paul) should be kept under guard in their lodge, which used to be the lodge of Looks Brave (Herod), the bad-hearted chief of the tribes of Wrestles with Creator (Israel).

verses.heading: SMALL MAN ACCUSED / SMALL MAN ACCUSED
verses.text: Five days later Creator Shows Kindness (Ananias) the chief holy man, along with some of the elders and a legal expert named Third (Tertullus), came before Happy Man (Felix), and with many words they brought to him their accusations against Small Man (Paul).

When they brought Small Man (Paul) before them, the legal expert began to accuse him. “O Most Honored Happy Man (Felix),” he began his speech, “our hearts are glad that under your guidance we have had many winters of peace. Because of your wisdom, many good changes have come to the people,
changes that we fully welcome with glad and open hearts.
So we beg you, in your kindness, to hear our short complaint.
“We have found this man to be a troublemaker who, all over the world, stirs up our Tribal People in a bad way. He is a headman of the wayward band called Seed Planters (Nazarenes).
When he tried to defile our sacred lodge, we arrested himand would have judged him by our own tribal law.
But the head officer Limping Man Who Sets Free (Claudius Lysias) came and forcefully took him out of our hands. He then ordered his accusers to come to you.
When you question him for yourself, you will learn from him that we speak the truth.”
The Tribal Members who were there also joined in the accusations, saying it was all true.

The governor then motioned for Small Man (Paul) to speak. “I know that for many winters you have been a judge over this nation,” Small Man (Paul) said. “My heart is glad that I can clear the air regarding these things.
As you will find out from others, it has not been more than twelve days since I went to Village of Peace (Jerusalem) to offer my prayers and participate in traditional ceremonies at the sacred lodge.
“No one there found me making trouble or stirring up a crowd. Not at the sacred lodge, the gathering house, or in the village.
No one here can prove the accusations they now bring against me.

“I speak from my heart. I am only guilty of following the Way, which they say is false. But this is the way I follow the Great Spirit of my ancestors. This Way is in agreement with the law of my people and what has been foretold by our prophets.
This gives me the same hope in Creator that my accusers have. That all who have died, both those who do good and those who do bad, will rise to life again.
Knowing this, my aim is to walk with a clear heart toward the Great Spirit and my fellow human beings.
“After being away for a number of winters, I returned to Village of Peace (Jerusalem). I brought gifts for the poor of my nation, as well as ceremonial offerings.
When they found me, I was in the sacred lodge participating in a ceremony. There was no crowd or disturbance.
Some Tribal Members from Land of the Rising Sun (Asia) were there at that time. If they have any accusation against me, they are the ones who should make it.
“Let these men who are here tell you what I did wrong when I stood before the council.
The only thing they can say against me is what I said to them: ‘I am on trial today because I believe in the rising of the dead!’”
But Happy Man (Felix), who knew more about the Way, delayed his decision. “I will make my decision,” he said, “when Limping Man Who Sets Free (Claudius Lysias) arrives.”
He then ordered the head soldier to keep Small Man (Paul) under guard but to give him some freedom and permit his friends to care for his needs.

A number of days later Happy Man (Felix) returned with Tender Woman (Drusilla), his wife, who was a member of the tribes of Wrestles with Creator (Israel). He had Small Man (Paul) brought to him, and he and his wife listened to him tell about his trust in Creator Sets Free (Jesus), the Chosen One.
verses.html: A number of days later Happy Man (Felix) returned with Tender Woman (Drusilla), his wife, who was a member of the tribes of Wrestles with Creator (Israel). He had Small Man (Paul) brought to him, and he and his wife listened to him tell about his trust in Creator Sets Free (Jesus), the Chosen One.

verses.text: They talked back and forth about Creator’s right ways, about self-control, and about the judgment that was to come. But Happy Man (Felix) became afraid. “Leave me for now,” he said. “I will send for you when I have more time to talk.”
He was hoping that Small Man (Paul) would offer him a bribe, so from time to time he would send for him and talk with him, but Small Man (Paul)remained under guard.
verses.html: He was hoping that Small Man (Paul) would offer him a bribe, so from time to time he would send for him and talk with him, but Small Man (Paul)remained under guard.

verses.text: Two winters later Happy Man (Felix) was replaced as governor by Pig Festival (Porcius Festus). Then to gain favor with the Tribal Members, he left Small Man (Paul) in prison.

verses.heading: SMALL MAN PUT ON TRIAL / SMALL MAN PUT ON TRIAL
verses.text: Three days after Festival (Festus) arrived, he went from Chief Village (Caesarea) to Village of Peace (Jerusalem).
So the head holy men and other tribal leaders wasted no time and brought to him their accusations against Small Man (Paul). They begged him,
verses.html: So the head holy men and other tribal leaders wasted no time and brought to him their accusations against Small Man (Paul). They begged him,

verses.text: as a favor to their nation, to have Small Man (Paul) returned to Village of Peace (Jerusalem). They were hatching a plot to have him killed along the way.
“Small Man (Paul) is being guarded in Chief Village (Caesarea),” Festival (Festus) said to them, “and I am returning there soon.
Have your tribal leaders travel with me. If this man has done wrong, I will hear your accusations against him there.”

So after eight or ten more days he left for Chief Village (Caesarea). The next day he sat down in his council chair, where he would decide this case, and ordered Small Man (Paul) to be brought before him.
As soon as he arrived, the Tribal Members who had come from Village of Peace (Jerusalem) circled around him and began to make accusations against him that they could not prove.
Small Man (Paul) stood up and said, “I have not spoken against our tribal law, our sacred lodge, or against the Ruler of the People of Iron (Caesar).”

But then Festival (Festus), wishing to gain the favor of the tribal leaders, responded to Small Man (Paul) and asked, “Do you wish to stand trial before me in Village of Peace (Jerusalem)?” Small Man (Paul) could see right through him.
verses.html:
But then Festival (Festus), wishing to gain the favor of the tribal leaders, responded to Small Man (Paul) and asked, “Do you wish to stand trial before me in Village of Peace (Jerusalem)?”
Small Man (Paul) could see right through him.

verses.text: “I am making my stand here, before you, at the council chair of the People of Iron (Romans). This is where the decision about me should be made. By now, it should be clear to you that I have done nothing wrong against my own people.” Small Man (Paul) paused to draw strength from deep within. He made up his mind to do what was right and follow the path Creator had set before him.
verses.html:
“I am making my stand here, before you, at the council chair of the People of Iron (Romans). This is where the decision about me should be made. By now, it should be clear to you that I have done nothing wrong against my own people.”
Small Man (Paul) paused to draw strength from deep within. He made up his mind to do what was right and follow the path Creator had set before him.

verses.text: “If I have done anything to deserve death,” he continued, “I will not try to escape. But if their accusations are false, you have no power to turn me over to them. I appeal to the Ruler of the People of Iron (Caesar).”

verses.heading: SMALL MAN AND CHIEF WILD HORSE / SMALL MAN AND CHIEF WILD HORSE
verses.text: Festival (Festus), after speaking to his council, said to him, “You have made your appeal to the Ruler of the People of Iron (Caesar), and to him you will go.” Chief Wild Horse (Agrippa) was a Tribal Member who ruled over some of the territory near Circle of Nations (Galilee) under the power of the People of Iron (Romans). He was the son of Looks Brave (Herod) also named Wild Horse (Agrippa) and the great grandson of Looks Brave (Herod) called the Great.
verses.html:
Festival (Festus), after speaking to his council, said to him, “You have made your appeal to the Ruler of the People of Iron (Caesar), and to him you will go.”
Chief Wild Horse (Agrippa) was a Tribal Member who ruled over some of the territory near Circle of Nations (Galilee) under the power of the People of Iron (Romans). He was the son of Looks Brave (Herod) also named Wild Horse (Agrippa) and the great grandson of Looks Brave (Herod) called the Great.

verses.text: A number of days later Chief Wild Horse (Agrippa), along with his sister Bringer of Victory (Bernice), came to pay their respects to the new governor Festival (Festus).
verses.html: A number of days later Chief Wild Horse (Agrippa), along with his sister Bringer of Victory (Bernice), came to pay their respects to the new governor Festival (Festus).

verses.text: Since they were lodging with him for a number of days, he explained to the chief about the accusations made against Small Man (Paul) by the tribal leaders. “There is a man here who was left by Happy Man (Felix) as a prisoner.
When I went to Village of Peace (Jerusalem), the head holy men and the tribal elders told me about him. They wanted me to find him guilty.
I informed them that the laws of the People of Iron (Romans) would not permit me to hand over anyone until they could stand face to face with their accusers and make a defense for themselves.
“So when they came here, I wasted no time. The next day I sat as head of the council and sent for him to stand trial.
I expected to hear from his accusers about some great evil,
but instead their accusations were about their own spiritual ways and about a man named Creator Sets Free (Jesus), who was dead but who Small Man (Paul) said was alive.
“Since I knew nothing about these things, I asked if he wished to go to Village of Peace (Jerusalem) and face his accusers there.
But he appealed his case to the Ruler of the People of Iron (Caesar) and to be kept under guard until I could send him to our Ruler for his decision.”
Wild Horse (Agrippa) then said to Festival (Festus), “I would like to hear from this man for myself.” “You will hear him tomorrow,” Festival (Festus) replied.

verses.heading: SMALL MAN BEFORE CHIEF WILD HORSE / SMALL MAN BEFORE CHIEF WILD HORSE
verses.text: The next day Wild Horse (Agrippa) and Bringer of Victory (Bernice), making a big show of it, came into the council room along with the head officers and leaders of the village. Festival (Festus) gave the order, and Small Man (Paul) was brought in.
“Chief Wild Horse (Agrippa) and all who are here,” the governor said, “standing before you is the man whom the whole tribal nation has asked me to condemn to death.
But I have not found him guilty of anything deserving death. Since he has appealed to the Ruler of the People of Iron (Caesar), I will send him to Village of Iron (Rome).

“But, since I am not sure what message to send to my Ruler about him, I have decided to bring him to you all, and above all to you, Chief Wild Horse (Agrippa), so you can give me counsel in this matter.
For it seems unwise to me to send a prisoner there without a clear report of the accusations made against him.”

verses.heading: SMALL MAN TELLS HIS STORY / SMALL MAN TELLS HIS STORY
verses.text: Then Wild Horse (Agrippa) said to Small Man (Paul), “You are permitted to speak and tell your side of this story.” So Small Man (Paul) stretched out his hand and began to tell his side of the story.
“Chief Wild Horse (Agrippa),” he began, “Since my accusers are all Tribal Members, like yourself, it seems good to me that I can defend myself before you today,
verses.html: “Chief Wild Horse (Agrippa),” he began, “Since my accusers are all Tribal Members, like yourself, it seems good to me that I can defend myself before you today,

verses.text: mainly because you know so well how we disagree about many of our tribal traditions. So I humbly ask that you listen to me with patience.
“All of our Tribal People know the manner I have walked, even from the days of my youth, when I lived among our people in Village of Peace (Jerusalem).
They have known from the first, if they will admit to it, that I walked in the way of a Separated One (Pharisee), the most demanding of all our spiritual paths.
“The reason I stand here on trial before you today is my hope in the promise made by the Great Spirit to our ancestors.

It is a promise our twelve tribes solemnly strive for as they serve him night and day with prayers and ceremonies. It is for this hope, O honored chief, that I stand here accused by our tribal leaders!
Why would any of our people find it impossible to believe that the Great Spirit raises the dead?
“At first, I myself was convinced that I should do as much harm as I could to destroy the reputation of Creator Sets Free (Jesus) of Seed Planter Village (Nazareth).
verses.html: “At first, I myself was convinced that I should do as much harm as I could to destroy the reputation of Creator Sets Free (Jesus) of Seed Planter Village (Nazareth).

verses.text: In Village of Peace (Jerusalem), I obtained permission from the head holy men to capture and put many of Creator’s holy ones into prison. Not only that, but I voted against them when they were being killed.

In all our gathering houses I violently punished them, trying to force them to speak against Creator Sets Free (Jesus). Like a threatening storm I took out my anger on them, even pursuing them to faraway places.

verses.heading: SMALL MAN TELLS HIS SACRED VISION / SMALL MAN TELLS HIS SACRED VISION
verses.text: “On one of these journeys I was on my way to Silent Weaver (Damascus) with the full approval and authority of the head holy men.
Then at midday, O honored chief, I saw a light from the spirit-world above shining down on me and my fellow travelers.

We all had fallen to the ground when I heard a voice speaking to me in our tribal language. “‘Man Who Questions (Saul), Man Who Questions (Saul),’ the voice called my name twice, and asked, ‘why are you pursuing and mistreating me? It is a hard and painful thing to fight against me, like a horse pushing back against the spurs.’
verses.html:
We all had fallen to the ground when I heard a voice speaking to me in our tribal language.
“‘Man Who Questions (Saul), Man Who Questions (Saul),’ the voice called my name twice, and asked, ‘why are you pursuing and mistreating me? It is a hard and painful thing to fight against me, like a horse pushing back against the spurs.’

verses.text: “‘Honored One,’ I said back to the voice, ‘who are you?’ “‘I am Creator Sets Free (Jesus),’ the voice answered, ‘the one you are pursuing and mistreating.
Now rise up! Stand to your feet! I have chosen you to be my servant, a witness who will tell others what you have seen with your own eyes and what I will reveal to you.
“‘I will rescue you from your own people and from the Outside Nations, the ones to whom I am sending you.

My message will open their eyes so they may turn from the path of darkness to walk the road of life, and turn away from the power of the Accuser (Satan) to the power of the Great Spirit, so they may be released and set free from their bad hearts and wrongdoings. In this way, they will find their place among all who are made holy by trusting in me.’

verses.heading: SMALL MAN FINISHES HIS STORY / SMALL MAN FINISHES HIS STORY
verses.text: “So then, Chief Wild Horse (Agrippa), I was true to this sacred vision.

First I told those in Silent Weaver (Damascus). Then I told the people in Village of Peace (Jerusalem) and all in the territory of the Land of Promise (Judea), and to the Outside Nations. I told them all that they should change their thinking, return to Creator’s ways, and walk in a manner worthy of this change of heart.
“This was the reason that these Tribal Members took hold of me at the sacred lodge and tried to kill me.
Up to this day, with the help of the Great Spirit, I have told the truth to both small and great. I have said only what was foretold by the ancient prophets and by Drawn from the Water (Moses).
I said that the Chosen One must suffer, and then, being the first to rise from the dead, he would be the light bearer, shining both on our people and on the Outside Nations.”
Right then, as Small Man (Paul) was still speaking, Festival (Festus) interrupted. “Small Man (Paul),” he shouted, “you are sick in the head! Your much learning is twisting your mind!”
“O most noble Festival (Festus),” Small Man (Paul) replied, “what I am saying is clear and understandable.

Chief Wild Horse (Agrippa) understands these things, so I am speaking boldly to him and holding nothing back. I am convinced that he is aware of all that I speak of, for none of these things happened in a cave.” Small Man (Paul) then turned and faced Chief Wild Horse (Agrippa).
verses.html:
Chief Wild Horse (Agrippa) understands these things, so I am speaking boldly to him and holding nothing back. I am convinced that he is aware of all that I speak of, for none of these things happened in a cave.”
Small Man (Paul) then turned and faced Chief Wild Horse (Agrippa).

verses.text: “Chief Wild Horse (Agrippa),” he boldly asked, “do you believe in what the prophets have spoken? I know that you do!”
“Do you think that in such a short time I could be talked into becoming a follower of the Chosen One?” he replied.
“I pray to the Great Spirit that, whether in a short time or long, all who hear me today would become as I am—except for these chains.”
After hearing these words Chief Wild Horse (Agrippa) stood to his feet. The governor and Bringer of Victory (Bernice) and all the others stood up with him.
verses.html: After hearing these words Chief Wild Horse (Agrippa) stood to his feet. The governor and Bringer of Victory (Bernice) and all the others stood up with him.

verses.text: They left the room, and after talking together they said, “This man has done nothing that deserves prison or death.”
Then Chief Wild Horse (Agrippa) said to the governor, “This man could have been set free if he had not appealed to the Ruler of the People of Iron (Caesar).”

verses.heading: VOYAGE OF TROUBLE / VOYAGE OF TROUBLE
verses.text: They decided to send Small Man (Paul) by a great canoe to Land of Young Bulls (Italy). Village of Iron (Rome) was the head village of the Ruler of the People of Iron (Caesar) in the territory of Land of Young Bulls (Italy). So Small Man (Paul), along with some other prisoners, was turned over to a head soldier of the Royal Guard, named Soft Haired Man (Julius).
verses.html:
They decided to send Small Man (Paul) by a great canoe to Land of Young Bulls (Italy).
Village of Iron (Rome) was the head village of the Ruler of the People of Iron (Caesar) in the territory of Land of Young Bulls (Italy).
So Small Man (Paul), along with some other prisoners, was turned over to a head soldier of the Royal Guard, named Soft Haired Man (Julius).

verses.text: At Harbor of Death (Adramyttium) we climbed aboard a canoe that was going our way, making stops at harbors along the shoreline of Land of the Rising Sun (Asia). So we launched out into the great waters. A man named Good Chief (Aristarchus) from False Victory (Thessalonica), in the territory of the Land of Tall People (Macedonia), also journeyed with us.
On the following day we came ashore at Hunting Grounds (Sidon). There Soft Haired Man (Julius) was kind to Small Man (Paul) and permitted him to go to his friends so they could care for him.
From there we launched out again into the great waters but remained close to the shoreline of the Island of Flowers (Cyprus), for the winds were strong against us.
From there we crossed the open waters near Turns Over (Cilicia) and Many Tribes (Pamphylia), and then came to land at Weeping Waters (Myra) in the territory of Land of Wolves (Lycia).
At Weeping Waters (Myra) the head soldier found a great wooden sea canoe on its way from Man Fighter (Alexandria) to Land of Young Bulls (Italy) that would give us passage, so we climbed aboard.

For a number of days we traveled along slowly until with difficulty we came near Old Village (Cnidus). The wind was against us and began to force us off course, so we remained close to the shoreline of Flesh Eater Island (Crete) near Village of Garments (Salmone).
From there we struggled along the shoreline until we came to a place called Good Harbor, near Shaggy Village (Lasea).
The journey was no longer safe. Too much time had passed, for the Festival of Release from Wrongdoings had already passed. So Small Man (Paul) gave them his advice.
“Fellow travelers,” he said to them, “I can see that this journey ahead of us will end in injury and loss, not only of the canoe and its goods, but also of our lives.”
But the head soldier was more convinced by the headman of the canoe than by the words of Small Man (Paul).

And because the harbor was not a good place to stay the winter, a greater number of people decided it was best to launch out into the great waters and try to reach Palm Tree (Phoenix). This was a harbor on the shore of Flesh Eater Island (Crete), facing both to the southwest and to the northwest.

But then, when a gentle south wind began to blow, they thought they could reach their journey’s end. So they prepared their canoe and launched out into the great waters again. They stayed close to the shoreline of Flesh Eater Island (Crete) for safety,
but it was not long before a violent wind roared down from the island—a wind they call the Northeaster.
The canoe was caught in the wind, and when we could make no headway against it, we gave up trying and let it force us along.
Then, when we came under some cliffs, we were finally able to get the canoe under control.

We roped the life raft we were towing behind us to the side of the canoe, and then tied the ropes around the canoe to hold it together. Then, fearing we would be caught in the shallow sandbars, we lowered our anchor rock and let the canoe be dragged along by the fierce winds.
But the next day, after being pounded by the storm, they began to throw the goods overboard.
Then, on the third day, with their bare hands they threw the benches and whatever else they could find into the water.
For many days the storm continued to rage, the sun did not shine, nor could the stars be seen at night. All hope of being rescued was gone.

verses.heading: VISITED BY A SPIRIT-MESSENGER / VISITED BY A SPIRIT-MESSENGER
verses.text: After they had gone for many days without food, Small Man (Paul) stood up among them. “Fellow travelers,” he said to them, “if you would have listened to me and not set out from Flesh Eater Island (Crete), you would not have suffered this injury and loss.
But I say to you now, do not lose your courage. For even though our canoe will be lost, not one of us will lose our lives.
Last night a spirit-messenger from the Great Spirit, the one I belong to and serve, stood by my side.

“‘Do not fear,’ he said to me, ‘for you must stand before the Ruler of the People of Iron (Caesar). Behold! The Giver of Life has gifted you with the lives of all who journey with you!’” The men just stared at Small Man (Paul) with wondering eyes and said nothing. So he once again spoke courage into their hearts.
verses.html:
“‘Do not fear,’ he said to me, ‘for you must stand before the Ruler of the People of Iron (Caesar). Behold! The Giver of Life has gifted you with the lives of all who journey with you!’”
The men just stared at Small Man (Paul) with wondering eyes and said nothing. So he once again spoke courage into their hearts.

verses.text: “Be strong of heart,” Small Man (Paul) said to them, “for I have faith that the Great Spirit will do everything he told me.
But we will have to find an island to land on.”

verses.heading: THEY COME NEAR LAND / THEY COME NEAR LAND
verses.text: It had now been fourteen nights that we had been driven about by the wind and waves of the Sea with No Wood (Adriatic Sea). In the middle of the night, the men who guided the canoe could feel that we were near land.
They began to test the depth of the water and found it was as deep as a tall tree. Then a short distance later they tested it again and found that it was not as deep.
Since they knew the shoreline was rocky, they were afraid we might run into a large rock under the water, so they dropped four anchor rocks from the back of the canoe and prayed for the sun to rise.

verses.heading: SOME OF THE MEN TRY TO ESCAPE / SOME OF THE MEN TRY TO ESCAPE
verses.text: But then, some of the men, trying to escape, untied the life raft and lowered it into the water, pretending they were putting out more anchor rocks. Small Man (Paul) saw what they were doing and went to the head soldier.
verses.html:
But then, some of the men, trying to escape, untied the life raft and lowered it into the water, pretending they were putting out more anchor rocks.
Small Man (Paul) saw what they were doing and went to the head soldier.

verses.text: “If these men leave the canoe,” he said to him and the other soldiers, “you will not be saved and all will be lost.”
verses.html: “If these men leave the canoe,” he said to him and the other soldiers, “you will not be saved and all will be lost.”

verses.text: So the soldiers cut the leather straps from the life raft and let it drift away.

verses.heading: HE ENCOURAGES THE MEN / HE ENCOURAGES THE MEN
verses.text: Just before the sun began to rise, Small Man (Paul) urged everyone to eat something. “For fourteen days now you have been constantly worrying and have not eaten any food,” he said to them.
“Please eat something now. You will need it to survive. Do not fear! No one will die or be harmed. Not even one hair from your heads will be lost.”
verses.html: “Please eat something now. You will need it to survive. Do not fear! No one will die or be harmed. Not even one hair from your heads will be lost.”

verses.text: After he said this, he took a piece of frybread and, giving thanks to the Great Spirit in front of them all, he broke it and began to eat.
This gave the men courage, so they also began to eat.
All in all there were two hundred seventy-six persons in this great wooden canoe.
When they finished eating, they tossed the rest of the grain over the side to lighten the canoe.

verses.heading: SUNRISE AND A ROUGH LANDING / SUNRISE AND A ROUGH LANDING
verses.text: When daylight came, they did not recognize the shoreline, but they could see a bay with a beach. They decided to try to run the canoe up into the sandy beach, if possible.

So they cut the ropes to the anchor rocks and left them in the water. At the same time they untied the ropes holding the rudders in place. Then they set the men to the paddles, and they paddled with all their might heading toward the beach.
But on the way the canoe struck a sandbar and stayed there, stuck in the sand. The front of the canoe began to break from the force of the waves.
The soldiers made a plan to kill the prisoners so none could escape by swimming away.
But the head soldier, wanting to spare the life of Small Man (Paul), stopped them. He ordered the ones who could swim to jump overboard and swim to land.
The rest he sent floating on wooden poles and pieces of the canoe. In this way all who were aboard made it safely to the land.

verses.heading: A WARM WELCOME / A WARM WELCOME
verses.text: After everyone was safe on the shore, we found out that this land was called Island of Honey (Malta).
The indigenous people there showed great kindness to us. It was raining and cold, so they built us a warm fire and welcomed us all.

verses.heading: SNAKE BITE / SNAKE BITE
verses.text: Small Man (Paul) gathered a bundle of sticks and threw them on the fire, but the heat forced out a poisonous snake that bit into his hand and would not let go.
When the local natives saw the snake hanging from his hand, they said, “This man must be a murderer. Even though he escaped from the great waters, the spirit who rights wrongs will not let him live.”
Then Small Man (Paul) shook the snake from his hand into the fire, and nothing bad happened to him.

The local people were sure that he would swell up or fall down dead. They waited a long time, but when they saw that nothing bad had come to him, they changed their minds and said he must be a powerful spirit.

verses.heading: SMALL MAN HEALS THE SICK / SMALL MAN HEALS THE SICK
verses.text: There was a piece of land belonging to From the People (Publius), the chief of the island. He welcomed us into his home for three days and took care of all our needs.

At that time the father of From the People (Publius) was sick in bed with a high fever and a bloody stool. Small Man (Paul) went to see him and, after praying, laid his hands on the man and healed him.
After that, the rest of the island natives who were sick came to Small Man (Paul), and they were also healed.
The people honored us with many gifts, and when we were leaving, they loaded our canoe with all that we needed.

verses.heading: ARRIVAL AT VILLAGE OF IRON / ARRIVAL AT VILLAGE OF IRON
verses.text: Three months later we again launched out into the great waters in another very large wooden canoe. This canoe was made by the people from Man Fighter (Alexandria). The front of the canoe was carved into the images of two powerful lookalike spirits, Bright Star (Castor) and Much Sweet (Pollux).
We came to land at Smelly Swamp (Syracuse) and lodged there for three days.
From there we launched out and came to Royal Place (Rhegium). The next day, with the help of a south wind, we arrived at Deep Water Hole (Puteoli).
It was there that we found some sacred family members, who welcomed us to stay with them for seven days. After that we left again toward Village of Iron (Rome).

The sacred family members who lived there, when they heard we were coming, came to greet us from as far away as the Great Trading Post (Appius Market) and the Three Lodging Houses along the Great Trail (Appian Way). When Small Man (Paul) saw them, he gave thanks to the Great Spirit, and his heart was strengthened.
verses.html: The sacred family members who lived there, when they heard we were coming, came to greet us from as far away as the Great Trading Post (Appius Market) and the Three Lodging Houses along the Great Trail (Appian Way). When Small Man (Paul) saw them, he gave thanks to the Great Spirit, and his heart was strengthened.

verses.text: Then, upon our arrival to Village of Iron (Rome), Small Man (Paul) was permitted to live by himself with a soldier to guard him.

verses.heading: HE MEETS THE LOCAL COUNCIL / HE MEETS THE LOCAL COUNCIL
verses.text: Three days later Small Man (Paul) asked to meet with the local tribal leaders. When they had gathered together, he told them the story of what had happened to him. He stood there in chains under the guard of a soldier of the People of Iron (Romans). Yet he spoke with dignity as he faced the leaders of his own people. “Fellow Tribal Members,” he said to them, “I have done nothing against our people or the traditions of our ancestors, but even so I was arrested in Village of Peace (Jerusalem) and handed over to the People of Iron (Romans).
verses.html:
Three days later Small Man (Paul) asked to meet with the local tribal leaders. When they had gathered together, he told them the story of what had happened to him.
He stood there in chains under the guard of a soldier of the People of Iron (Romans). Yet he spoke with dignity as he faced the leaders of his own people.
“Fellow Tribal Members,” he said to them, “I have done nothing against our people or the traditions of our ancestors, but even so I was arrested in Village of Peace (Jerusalem) and handed over to the People of Iron (Romans).

verses.text: They questioned me and were about to release me, since I had done nothing deserving death.
But when our tribal leaders refused to agree, I had no choice but to appeal to the Ruler of the People of Iron (Caesar), not that I have any accusation to bring against my own people.

“It is for this very reason that I have asked to see and speak with you, for I wear these chains because I have the same hope held by all the tribes of Wrestles with Creator (Israel).” Small Man (Paul) then stopped speaking, looked calmly into their faces, and waited for them to reply.
verses.html:
“It is for this very reason that I have asked to see and speak with you, for I wear these chains because I have the same hope held by all the tribes of Wrestles with Creator (Israel).”
Small Man (Paul) then stopped speaking, looked calmly into their faces, and waited for them to reply.

verses.text: “No one from the Land of Promise (Judea) has come with a bad report,” they said to him, “nor have we received any written message about you from them.
But we want to hear how you see this new Way that some are following. We know that people everywhere speak against this Way.”

verses.heading: SENT TO THE OUTSIDE NATIONS / SENT TO THE OUTSIDE NATIONS
verses.text: They made plans to meet again with Small Man (Paul) on another day. When that day came, they arrived in large numbers at the place where he was lodging. From sunrise to sunset, using the law of Drawn from the Water (Moses) and the teachings of the prophets, he spoke many words to clearly show them the truth about Creator’s good road and about Creator Sets Free (Jesus).
Some were convinced by his words, but others refused to believe.

So they disagreed with each other and began to leave after Small Man (Paul) said these last words to them, “The Holy Spirit was right when he spoke these words through the prophet Creator Will Help Us (Isaiah):
“‘Go and tell this people, “You will hear but not understand, you will see but not know what you are seeing,

verses.heading: FINAL WORDS / FINAL WORDS
verses.text: because the heart of this people has become like stone. Their ears have grown dull and they have closed their eyes. If only they would open their ears and eyes, then their hearts would understand, and they would return to me and be healed.”’” A look of sorrow came over the face of Small Man (Paul) as he watched his own people turn and walk away.
verses.html:
because the heart of this people has become like stone. Their ears have grown dull and they have closed their eyes. If only they would open their ears and eyes, then their hearts would understand, and they would return to me and be healed.”’”
A look of sorrow came over the face of Small Man (Paul) as he watched his own people turn and walk away.

verses.text: “So let it be known to you,” he said to them, “that this message about the Great Spirit’s plan to rescue and make whole has been sent to the Outside Nations. And they will listen!”
Hearing this, the Tribal Members argued fiercely with one another as they walked away.
Small Man (Paul) continued to live in his own rented house and welcomed all who came to him.
With great boldness he spoke openly about Creator’s good road and kept teaching others about our Honored Chief Creator Sets Free (Jesus), the Chosen One. Aho! May it be so!
verses.html:
With great boldness he spoke openly about Creator’s good road and kept teaching others about our Honored Chief Creator Sets Free (Jesus), the Chosen One.
Aho! May it be so!

verses.heading: GREETINGS AND BLESSINGS / GREETINGS AND BLESSINGS
verses.text: From Small Man (Paul), a servant of the Chosen One, Creator Sets Free (Jesus). The Great Spirit has called me to be a message bearer, one who has been set apart to tell his good story.
The Sacred Teachings tell us about this good story that was promised by the prophets from long ago, who spoke from the Great Spirit.
verses.html: The Sacred Teachings tell us about this good story that was promised by the prophets from long ago, who spoke from the Great Spirit.

verses.text: This is the good story about Creator’s own Son. In his human body he was descended from Chief Much Loved One (David),
verses.html: This is the good story about Creator’s own Son. In his human body he was descended from Chief Much Loved One (David),

verses.text: and in a powerful way he was shown to be the Son of the Great Spirit when his human body was raised from the dead by the Spirit of all that is sacred.

It is because of the gift of his great kindness that we have been chosen to be his message bearers. We are telling his good story to all Nations so they can put their trust in Creator, follow him in all his ways, and bring honor to his name.
This sacred task is also yours, because you have been called to belong to Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One.

I write this message to the ones who live in Village of Iron (Rome). You are all deeply loved by the Great Spirit and are called to be his holy ones. I send to you great kindness and peace from our Father the Creator and from our Honored Chief, Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One.
First of all, I thank the Great Spirit, along with Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One, for all of you, because all over the world people are hearing about your trust in his good story.

verses.heading: PRAYERS AND DESIRES / PRAYERS AND DESIRES
verses.text: The Great Spirit, whom I serve from my spirit by telling others the good story about his Son, knows how much I pray for you. I never stop bringing your name before Creator when I send my voice to him, asking whether this is the time that he will finally open the way for me to come and be with you.
I am longing to see you face to face, so I can pass on to you some spiritual gift that will give you strength,
so that we can strengthen our trust in him and together become firmly rooted in the good story.
verses.html: so that we can strengthen our trust in him and together become firmly rooted in the good story.

verses.text: I want you to know, my sacred family members, how often I have tried to come to you, but many things have held me back. I have desired to share in some of the spiritual fruit Creator has grown from you, in the same way I have from others who are of the Outside Nations.
Because of the great debt of love that I owe, I must tell the good story to both the civilized and uncivilized—to all who walk in the ways of wisdom and to all who do not.
verses.html: Because of the great debt of love that I owe, I must tell the good story to both the civilized and uncivilized—to all who walk in the ways of wisdom and to all who do not.

verses.text: And now I am able and ready to tell the good story to you who live in Village of Iron (Rome).

verses.heading: NOT ASHAMED / NOT ASHAMED
verses.text: I am not ashamed of this good story, for to all who trust in its message it has Creator’s power to set free and make whole. This is true, first for our Tribal People, and then to all the Outside Nations!

For this good story tells about Creator’s great faithfulness to do what is good and right. It is the story of faithfulness and trust from beginning to end. It is written in our Sacred Teachings, “The ones in good standing will find life by trusting in what the Great Spirit has done for them.”
verses.html: For this good story tells about Creator’s great faithfulness to do what is good and right. It is the story of faithfulness and trust from beginning to end. It is written in our Sacred Teachings, “The ones in good standing will find life by trusting in what the Great Spirit has done for them.”

verses.heading: NO EXCUSE FOR HIDING THE TRUTH / NO EXCUSE FOR HIDING THE TRUTH
verses.text: From the spirit-world above, Creator’s great anger is being shown to the ones who hide the truth by following their bad hearts and wrongful ways.
The Great Spirit has a reason to be angry, because he has clearly made himself known to all human beings.
verses.html: The Great Spirit has a reason to be angry, because he has clearly made himself known to all human beings.

verses.text: Ever since the world was made, his invisible, never-fading power and Sacred Spirit have been understood and clearly shown through the things that he has made. So they have no good reason not to trust in what Creator has done for them.
verses.html:
Ever since the world was made, his invisible, never-fading power and Sacred Spirit have been understood and clearly shown through the things that he has made.
So they have no good reason not to trust in what Creator has done for them.

verses.text: For even though they knew him as Creator, they did not thank him or give him the honor he deserved. This empty way of thinking took hold of their foolish hearts and led them into darkness.

verses.heading: FOOLISH WAYS / FOOLISH WAYS
verses.text: Even though they thought they were wise, they became only foolish two-leggeds.
They traded the beauty and honor of the Great Spirit, who has always existed, for carved images of short-lived human beings, winged ones, four-leggeds, and snakes that crawl on the ground.

For this reason the Great Spirit permitted them to go their own way and follow the dark desires found in their own hearts, desires with one another that failed to honor the sacred purpose their bodies had been created for.

In doing so, they traded Creator’s truth for something false, and honored and served created things more than the Great Spirit. He is the one who is to be given honor and blessing to the time beyond the end of all days. Aho! May it be so!

So then, the Great Spirit permitted them to go their own way to dishonor themselves by following these dishonorable desires. Their women traded what was their natural sexual desire for what was not natural.

Their men did the same things, giving up their natural desire for women and fanning into flame a hunger for one another, men with men, dishonoring their own bodies. In doing so, they had to face for themselves the end result of this wrong thinking.
Since they did not want to know the Great Spirit, he turned them over to their worthless ways of thinking, to do things that should not be done.

verses.heading: FROM BAD TO WORSE / FROM BAD TO WORSE
verses.text: Filled with these wrong ways, they followed their bad hearts and made evil their aim. Keeping all things for themselves and not sharing, they became filled with greed, hatred, and violence. This took them down a dark path of fighting and killing, of lies and telling bad stories about others. They became puffed up, disrespectful and arrogant, finders of new ways to do evil things, disobedient to parents, and they even began to hate the Great Spirit.
This turned them into foolish, ruthless treaty breakers, with hearts like stone!

Even though they know that Creator is right when he says these worthless ways deserve death and will lead others there, they continue to walk in these ways, and even worse, they give their approval to other people who also walk this path.
verses.html: Even though they know that Creator is right when he says these worthless ways deserve death and will lead others there, they continue to walk in these ways, and even worse, they give their approval to other people who also walk this path.

verses.heading: WHO ARE YOU TO JUDGE? / WHO ARE YOU TO JUDGE?
verses.text: But you who judge and decide the guilt of those who walk in these broken ways have no excuse for doing so. When you decide the guilt of others, you are only proving your own guilt, because you are doing the same kinds of things.
For we know that when the Great Spirit decides the guilt of the ones who do this, his judgment is always honorable and true.
Tell me, when you do the same kinds of things that you judge others for, do you think what you have done will be hidden from the eyes of the Great Spirit?

Or do you hold bitter thoughts about Creator’s kindness, patience, and willingness to bear with others? Do you not know that it is the kindness of the Great Spirit that draws you back to the path of his right ways?

Because your hearts are unwilling to bend to the ways of the Great Spirit, your lives are becoming filled with the things that make the Great Spirit angry. A day is coming when Creator’s great anger against these things and his decision to do what is right will be made clear.

verses.heading: CREATOR WILL BE THE ONE TO DECIDE / CREATOR WILL BE THE ONE TO DECIDE
verses.text: Creator will honor each of us for what we have done.

He will honor the ones who have walked with firm steps on a path of doing good, and those who seek to live in the ways of beauty, honor, and spiritual purity. The life of the world to come that never fades away, full of beauty and harmony, will be waiting for them.
But the ones who live only for themselves, who refuse to walk the path of truth and stand against the right ways of the Great Spirit, will face a coming storm of great anger.

verses.heading: CREATOR TREATS ALL THE SAME WAY / CREATOR TREATS ALL THE SAME WAY
verses.text: Trouble and sorrow await all human beings who walk an evil path. This is true, first of all for the members of the tribes of Wrestles with Creator (Israel) but also for the Outside Nations.
But beauty, honor, and peace await all who walk in a good way. To the Tribal Members first, and also for the Outside Nations.
For the Great Spirit does not favor one over the other.

For all the Outside Nations who have followed their bad hearts and broken ways, even though they had no written law to follow, will come to a bad end. And all who were given the tribal law but also followed their bad heart and broken ways, their own tribal law will decide against them.
verses.html: For all the Outside Nations who have followed their bad hearts and broken ways, even though they had no written law to follow, will come to a bad end. And all who were given the tribal law but also followed their bad heart and broken ways, their own tribal law will decide against them.

verses.text: For it is not the ones who hear the law who have good standing with Creator but the ones who do what it says.

verses.heading: CREATION’S LAW WRITTEN ON HEARTS / CREATION’S LAW WRITTEN ON HEARTS
verses.text: If the Outside Nations, who never heard the law, naturally do what they know is right, the things instructed by the law, this natural law is all they need.
They show that creation’s law is already at work within them, carved into their hearts. There is a voice deep within their inner being that speaks to them about what is right and what is wrong.

The good story that I tell says there will come a day when the Knower of Hearts, through Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One, will bring to light what is good and bad about the secrets hidden in every human heart.

verses.heading: A WORD OF WARNING / A WORD OF WARNING
verses.text: To those among you who call yourselves Tribal Members, who take your stand on tribal law and boast about your knowledge of the Great Spirit,
because you have been instructed by this law, you are sure you know what Creator wants and what is honorable to him.
You see yourselves as guides to the blind, lights to those in dark places,
wisdomkeepers to the unwise, and instructors of children. You, because you have the law, claim to be the holders of all truth.
So then, you who teach others, do you not teach yourself? You who tell others not to steal, do you take what is not yours?
You who instruct others to be faithful in marriage, do you sleep around from lodge to lodge? You who despise those who pray to spirit-images, do you steal from their sacred lodges?
When you fail to follow the same tribal law you brag about, you bring insult to the Great Spirit.
This is in agreement with the Sacred Teachings that say, “It is because of you that the Outside Nations are speaking against the Great Spirit.”
