For all the others care only for their own things, not the things relating to Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One.
But you know the good reputation of He Gives Honor (Timothy). He works side by side with me, like a son with his father, as we tell the good story.
That is why I hope to send him to you as soon as I see how things turn out for me.
Our Honored Chief gives me hope that I will be coming to you soon.

Until then, I feel the need to send Walks with Beauty (Epaphroditus) back to you. He is a member of our sacred family and warrior who has fought side by side with me in serving the Chosen One. He was your message bearer to help me in my need, and now I am sending him back to you.
verses.html: Until then, I feel the need to send Walks with Beauty (Epaphroditus) back to you. He is a member of our sacred family and warrior who has fought side by side with me in serving the Chosen One. He was your message bearer to help me in my need, and now I am sending him back to you.

verses.text: He has a deep longing to see all of you again. His heart has been on the ground ever since you heard he was sick.
It is true that he was so sick he nearly died. But Creator had pity on him, and on myself as well, to keep my heart from falling to the ground, heavy with sorrow.
This is the reason I so desire to send Walks with Beauty (Epaphroditus) to you, so that, when you see him, your heart will be glad and my own heart will be free from worry.
So when he arrives, welcome him in our Honored Chief with glad hearts. Show great respect and honor toward people like him.
verses.html: So when he arrives, welcome him in our Honored Chief with glad hearts. Show great respect and honor toward people like him.

verses.text: For he came close to death working for the Chosen One. He risked his life to give me the help you were not able to give because you lived so far away.
verses.html: For he came close to death working for the Chosen One. He risked his life to give me the help you were not able to give because you lived so far away.

verses.heading: BEWARE OF THE FLESH CUTTERS / BEWARE OF THE FLESH CUTTERS
verses.text: So then, my sacred family members, dance with glad hearts in harmony with our Honored Chief. I never grow tired of writing these things to you again, for they give you a safe path to follow.
Be on the lookout for those wild-dog men—the flesh cutters and troublemakers who require others to participate in the cutting of the flesh ceremony.
verses.html: Be on the lookout for those wild-dog men—the flesh cutters and troublemakers who require others to participate in the cutting of the flesh ceremony.

verses.text: We are the people of the true cutting of the flesh ceremony. For we stand tall in Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One and put no trust in a ceremony done with human hands. We honor and serve Creator in the way of his Spirit, as he cuts from our hearts the worthless and broken ways that dishonor him.
verses.html: We are the people of the true cutting of the flesh ceremony. For we stand tall in Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One and put no trust in a ceremony done with human hands. We honor and serve Creator in the way of his Spirit, as he cuts from our hearts the worthless and broken ways that dishonor him.

verses.text: I used to trust in outward ceremonies and had a better reason than others to do so.

When I was eight days old, the cutting of the flesh ceremony was done for me. I was born a member of the tribes of Wrestles with Creator (Israel). I am of the tribe of Son of My Right Hand (Benjamin). I am a full-blood Tribal Member (Hebrew). As for our tribal law, I was of the Separated Ones (Pharisees).
I was so on fire for our law that I hunted down and brought harm to the sacred family. When it came to doing what is right according to our tribal law, I was faultless.

verses.heading: THE GREAT BEAUTY OF KNOWING THE CHOSEN ONE / THE GREAT BEAUTY OF KNOWING THE CHOSEN ONE
verses.text: But now, because of the Chosen One, I have let go of those things in which I took so much pride. They now mean nothing to me.

Even more than this, I now count all things to be worthless compared to the great beauty of knowing the Chosen One, Creator Sets Free (Jesus), as my Honored Chief. Because I follow him, I have lost everything, but compared to knowing the Chosen One, I now count them as dog droppings.

To be in full harmony with the Chosen One is my desire. I do not want to gain my own good standing with Creator by keeping tribal law but by trusting in the Chosen One. This good standing comes from the Great Spirit by trusting in what he has done, not what I can do.
verses.html: To be in full harmony with the Chosen One is my desire. I do not want to gain my own good standing with Creator by keeping tribal law but by trusting in the Chosen One. This good standing comes from the Great Spirit by trusting in what he has done, not what I can do.

verses.text: I want to fully know the Chosen One and the power that raised him from the dead. I want to know what it means to participate in his sufferings and to become like him in his death,
living in the hope that, like the Chosen One, I will also rise from death to life.
verses.html: living in the hope that, like the Chosen One, I will also rise from death to life.

verses.heading: FOLLOWING THE CHOSEN ONE TO VICTORY / FOLLOWING THE CHOSEN ONE TO VICTORY
verses.text: I do not mean to say that I have won the victory or have already arrived at the end of the good road. But I keep dancing the victory dance, staying in step with the Chosen One, who is the headman dancer leading the way. In this way, I can fully become what the Chosen One, Creator Sets Free (Jesus), has made me to be.

My sacred family members, I do not represent myself as one who has finished the victory dance. My one aim is to forget what is behind me and to keep moving forward, dancing the victory dance with firm steps to the drumbeat of Creator’s heart.
verses.html: My sacred family members, I do not represent myself as one who has finished the victory dance. My one aim is to forget what is behind me and to keep moving forward, dancing the victory dance with firm steps to the drumbeat of Creator’s heart.

verses.text: I keep my eyes straight ahead while I dance toward the high honor the Great Spirit has called me to through the Chosen One, Creator Sets Free (Jesus).

verses.heading: KEEP WALKING THE GOOD PATH / KEEP WALKING THE GOOD PATH
verses.text: Those among us who have grown spiritually strong should see these things in the same way. If any of you sees differently, Creator will make it clear to you.
Until then, let us keep holding true to the path we have already been walking.
My sacred family members, I call on you to join with the others who follow me as I walk this road. Keep your eyes on those who walk in the same manner and follow them also.
I have warned you many times that there are a great number of people who walk as enemies of the cross of the Chosen One. And now with tears I warn you again.

A bad end awaits these people. They have made their weak human appetites the spirit they follow. They take pride in doing things they should be ashamed of. They have set their minds on the ways of this world.

verses.heading: THE WAY OF LIFE FROM ABOVE / THE WAY OF LIFE FROM ABOVE
verses.text: But the way of life of the tribe we belong to is found in the spirit-world above, and it is from there that we eagerly wait for the one who has set us free and made us whole, our Honored Chief, Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One.

When he appears, he will take our weak, death-doomed bodies and change them into a body like his, a body that shines with beauty and honor. For he is the one who has the power to bring all things into harmony with himself.
verses.html: When he appears, he will take our weak, death-doomed bodies and change them into a body like his, a body that shines with beauty and honor. For he is the one who has the power to bring all things into harmony with himself.

verses.text: My sacred family members, how I long to be with you. You are like feathers in my headdress, making my heart dance. I have shown you how to stand firm on the solid ground of the Chosen One. So now, my much-loved ones, stand firm!

verses.heading: URGENT COUNSEL FOR TWO WOMEN / URGENT COUNSEL FOR TWO WOMEN
verses.text: My strong counsel to Good Journey Woman (Euodia) and Blessing Way Woman (Syntyche) is for them to walk hand in hand in their life together with our Honored Chief.

I also ask you, Burden Bearer (Syzygus), to be true to your name and help these women who have shared my struggle in the telling of the good story. These women have also worked side by side with Walks with Kindness (Clement) and all the others whose names are written down in Creator’s book of life.
verses.html: I also ask you, Burden Bearer (Syzygus), to be true to your name and help these women who have shared my struggle in the telling of the good story. These women have also worked side by side with Walks with Kindness (Clement) and all the others whose names are written down in Creator’s book of life.

verses.heading: DANCING FOR JOY AND WALKING IN PEACE / DANCING FOR JOY AND WALKING IN PEACE
verses.text: Always dance with joy before our Honored Chief! I will say it again: dance with joy!
Let everyone see how kind and thoughtful you are. Our Honored Chief is close at hand.

Do not let your hearts be weighed down with anything. Instead, with every step you take, send your voice to the Great Spirit, asking him for the things you need. And in all your prayers remember to give him thanks.
verses.html: Do not let your hearts be weighed down with anything. Instead, with every step you take, send your voice to the Great Spirit, asking him for the things you need. And in all your prayers remember to give him thanks.

verses.text: Then the peace and harmony of the Great Spirit, which goes far beyond our small and weak ways of thinking, will watch over your hearts and minds through the Chosen One, Creator Sets Free (Jesus).

Last of all, my sacred family members, if anything can be seen as good and honorable, think deeply about these things. Things that are true and noble, upright and pure, full of beauty and worthy of respect.
verses.html: Last of all, my sacred family members, if anything can be seen as good and honorable, think deeply about these things. Things that are true and noble, upright and pure, full of beauty and worthy of respect.

verses.text: Follow the way of life you have seen in me, the things you have learned from me, heard from me, and received from me. Keep walking in the traditions I have passed on to you. Then the Great Spirit of Peace will continue to walk with you on this road.

verses.heading: CREATOR WILL TAKE CARE OF ALL OUR NEEDS / CREATOR WILL TAKE CARE OF ALL OUR NEEDS
verses.text: My heart is dancing for joy before our Honored Chief! For even though in the past you did not have the chance to show how deeply you care for me, you have shown once again how much you truly care.
You should not think that I am looking for you to take care of my needs, for I have learned how to be at peace with whatever the Great Spirit has provided.

I have lived with less than I need, and I have lived with more than I need. I have learned the secret of walking the road of life. Whether I am well-fed or hungry, whether I have more than I need or not enough,
I can do all things through the Chosen One who gives me strength!
All the same, you have done well to help me during my time of trouble.

My friends who live in Village of Horses (Philippi), you remember those early days when I first told you about the good story. How that after I left Land of Tall People (Macedonia), you were the only sacred family that walked together with me in giving and receiving.
Even when I was in the village of False Victory (Thessalonica), you sent gifts to me more than once.
It is not your gifts that I am seeking after but all the good things that giving will add to your lives.

But now I have received more than I need. My blanket has been filled with good things. The gifts that Walks with Beauty (Epaphroditus) brought from you are like a sweet-smelling smoke offering —a sacrificial gift, pleasing to the Great Spirit.
And I know that my Creator will take care of all your needs from the great treasures of his beauty through the Chosen One, Creator Sets Free (Jesus).

verses.heading: LAST WORDS / LAST WORDS
verses.text: All honor and beauty belong to our Father the Great Spirit to the time beyond the end of all days. Aho! May it be so!
Greet all of Creator’s holy ones among you, each one who belongs to the Chosen One, Creator Sets Free (Jesus). The sacred family members who are with me send their greetings.
All of Creator’s holy ones send their greetings to you, most of all the ones who serve in the royal lodge of the Ruler of the People of Iron (Caesar).
verses.html: All of Creator’s holy ones send their greetings to you, most of all the ones who serve in the royal lodge of the Ruler of the People of Iron (Caesar).

verses.text: May the great kindness of our Honored Chief, Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One, guide your spirit on the road of life. Aho! May it be so!
verses.html:
May the great kindness of our Honored Chief, Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One, guide your spirit on the road of life.
Aho! May it be so!

verses.heading: GREETINGS / GREETINGS
verses.text: From Small Man (Paul), chosen by the Great Spirit to be a message bearer for Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One, and from He Gives Honor (Timothy).

To the Great Spirit’s holy people and sacred family members who live in Village of Giants (Colossae) and have been faithful to walk the path of the Chosen One. We greet you with the great kindness and peace that comes from our Father, the Great Spirit.

verses.heading: GIVING THANKS TO THE FATHER / GIVING THANKS TO THE FATHER
verses.text: When we send up prayers for you, we always give thanks to the Father of our Honored Chief, Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One.
We thank him for the good words we have heard about your trust in Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One and your deep love for all his holy family members.

This love and trust come from the hope you have in Creator’s promises kept safe for you in the spirit-world above. It is the same hope you heard about when you were told the words of truth found in Creator’s good story.

verses.heading: GOOD FRUIT COMES FROM THE GOOD STORY / GOOD FRUIT COMES FROM THE GOOD STORY
verses.text: The seeds of this good story have been planted throughout the whole world, and now the message is growing and bearing good fruit. In the same way, it took root and began to grow in you, when you first heard and understood the truth about the gift of Creator’s great kindness.

Walks in Beauty (Epaphras) was the seed planter who first taught you these things. He is a faithful servant of the Chosen One, for your sakes, and also a much-loved helper who walks beside us on the road of life.
He is the one who told us about the love of the Spirit that is in you.

verses.heading: SENDING UP PRAYERS / SENDING UP PRAYERS
verses.text: Ever since we heard about you, we have never stopped praying for you. When we send our voices to the Great Spirit, we ask that he will fill your heart and mind with the knowledge you need to walk in his ways with all spiritual wisdom and understanding.

That you will walk in a manner that is worthy of our Honored Chief, making his heart glad and bearing good fruit as you walk the path he has chosen for you. In this way, you will grow wise in your understanding of our Great Creator.

We pray that you will grow strong with the strength that comes from the honor and shining-greatness of his power. Then you will be able to stand firm in a calm and unhurried manner, as you give thanks with glad hearts to the Great Spirit who is our Father from above. For he is the one who has made you ready to take your place on this road of life, a place he prepared for you among all the holy ones who walk in his light.

verses.heading: SET FREE BY THE SON / SET FREE BY THE SON
verses.text: The Giver of Life has set us free from the dark ruler of this world. He has brought us safely onto his good road to walk it together with Creator’s much-loved Son.
He is the one who paid a great price to release us from our bad hearts and broken ways.
He is the visible representation of our invisible Creator. All that the Father has belongs to this Son. He existed before creation and is above all created things.

For it was in him that all things in the spirit-world above and on the earth below were created, all things seen and unseen. Yes, even governments, rulers, powers, and authorities were all created by him and for him.

verses.heading: HE GIVES ALL THINGS THEIR FULL MEANING / HE GIVES ALL THINGS THEIR FULL MEANING
verses.text: He is the one who is in first place and the head of all things. It is in him that all things come together and find their full meaning and purpose.

He is also the head of his body on earth, the sacred family. He is in first place before all other things, the first to rise to life from among those who have died. In this way, he remains chief in all things.
verses.html: He is also the head of his body on earth, the sacred family. He is in first place before all other things, the first to rise to life from among those who have died. In this way, he remains chief in all things.

verses.text: It made our Great Father’s heart glad to have all that he is living in his Son.
Through his Son he brought together everything in the spirit-world above and on the earth below into harmony with himself, making peace through his lifeblood poured out on the cross.

verses.heading: OUTSIDERS BECOME INSIDERS / OUTSIDERS BECOME INSIDERS
verses.text: At one time you were outsiders, separated from Creator by your hostile thoughts that led to evil ways.

But now in the physical body of the Chosen One, through his death, he has turned you from an enemy into a friend. He did this so that you can stand without shame before the Great Spirit as a people who have been made holy, washed clean from guilt and free from all accusation.

Yes, all this is yours as you make your path straight on the road that leads to this hope, trusting in the good story that you have heard. This is the same story that is being told to all in creation who live under the spirit-world above. And I, Small Man (Paul), have dedicated my life to serve this good story.

verses.heading: SUFFERING WITH THE CHOSEN ONE / SUFFERING WITH THE CHOSEN ONE
verses.text: Even though I have been suffering for you, it makes my heart glad. There are still many things that the Chosen One must suffer through his sacred family in his body on earth. My suffering, in my human body, is my part in bringing full meaning and purpose to these remaining afflictions. This I gladly do for the sake of the sacred family, the body of the Chosen One.

verses.heading: A GREAT MYSTERY REVEALED / A GREAT MYSTERY REVEALED
verses.text: The Great Spirit has given me the solemn task of serving his sacred family, the family you are now part of, by teaching you the full meaning and purpose of Creator’s message.
This message is a mystery that was hidden for many ages and generations but now has been made clear to his holy ones.

Creator also did this to show the Outside Nations the mystery of the beauty and honor he has bestowed on them. This mystery is that Chosen One also lives in you, the Outside Nations. For the Chosen One in you is the hope of this beauty and honor.
Yes, he is the one we tell others about, teaching and instructing them with wise counsel, so that they may stand tall as mature human beings, like the Chosen One.
I give all I am to this task, drawing my strength from the Great Spirit who works so powerfully in me.

verses.heading: SPIRITUAL WARFARE / SPIRITUAL WARFARE
verses.text: I want you to know about the fierce spiritual battle that I fight for you who live in Village of Giants (Colossae). I also fight for you who live in the village of The People Will Decide (Laodicea) and for all who have never seen me face to face.

I pray that all of you would have strong hearts that beat together with the love of the Great Spirit. Then your understanding will grow strong and you will see clearly into the mystery of our Father the Great Spirit, and this mystery is the Chosen One.

verses.heading: TREASURES OF WISDOM AND KNOWLEDGE / TREASURES OF WISDOM AND KNOWLEDGE
verses.text: For the Great Spirit has hidden all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge in the Chosen One.
I am making this known to you so that no humans behaving like tricksters will fool you with their smooth words and sly arguments.
For even though my body may be far away, in my spirit I am close to you. I can see you standing strong and walking a straight path with firm steps as you trust in the Chosen One.

verses.heading: WALKING THE GOOD ROAD / WALKING THE GOOD ROAD
verses.text: So, in the same way you welcomed the Chosen One, Creator Sets Free (Jesus), to be your Honored Chief, continue to walk with him on this road of life.
Let your roots grow deep into him, and then your faith will grow strong and your steps will become firm on this path that you have learned to follow, always giving thanks to the Great Spirit.

verses.heading: WATCH OUT FOR LYING SPIRITS / WATCH OUT FOR LYING SPIRITS
verses.text: Make sure no one steals your faith from you with fine-sounding words spoken with hollow tongues. These people make up their own traditions as they follow the lying spirits of the ways of this world, instead of simply trusting in the Chosen One.
For all that the Great Spirit is fills the physical body of the Chosen One.
He is the one above all other powers and forces, and you have been made complete in him.

verses.heading: CUTTING OFF WEAK HUMAN WAYS / CUTTING OFF WEAK HUMAN WAYS
verses.text: In the Chosen One, you received a spiritual cutting of the flesh ceremony done without human hands. The Chosen One did this for you, by the cutting off of your weak human ways.

This is what happened when you were buried with him during your purification ceremony. You were also raised up with him through your trust in Creator’s great power that raised the Chosen One from the dead.

verses.heading: SILENCING ALL ACCUSATIONS / SILENCING ALL ACCUSATIONS
verses.text: You were spiritually dead because your weak human ways had not yet been cut away and because you were still following your bad hearts, walking in your broken ways. Even so the Great Spirit has made you spiritually alive along with the Chosen One by releasing you from all wrongdoings.
verses.html: You were spiritually dead because your weak human ways had not yet been cut away and because you were still following your bad hearts, walking in your broken ways. Even so the Great Spirit has made you spiritually alive along with the Chosen One by releasing you from all wrongdoings.

verses.text: When Creator did this, he wiped away and silenced every accusation that could be made against us for not following tribal law. When the Chosen One was nailed to the cross, the accusations the law made against us were nailed there with him, releasing us from those charges.

verses.heading: VICTORY DANCE / VICTORY DANCE
verses.text: This is how the Great Spirit, through what the Chosen One did on the cross, defeated the spiritual powers that ruled over us by using our tribal law to accuse us and hold us captive. He now dances the victory dance with us, for the whole world to see, to celebrate the defeat of those powers!
verses.html: This is how the Great Spirit, through what the Chosen One did on the cross, defeated the spiritual powers that ruled over us by using our tribal law to accuse us and hold us captive. He now dances the victory dance with us, for the whole world to see, to celebrate the defeat of those powers!

verses.heading: NO MORE SHADOWS / NO MORE SHADOWS
verses.text: From now on do not accept anyone’s accusation against you for not following laws about what you should eat or drink, or whether you participate in celebrating festivals, or New Moon ceremonies, or a Day of Resting.
These laws and ceremonies were only dim shadows of what was coming, but the reality is found in the Chosen One.

verses.heading: HOLD ON FIRMLY TO THE CHOSEN ONE / HOLD ON FIRMLY TO THE CHOSEN ONE
verses.text: Do not permit anyone to talk you out of what the Chosen One has done for you. That kind of humility is only a mask to fool you into humbling yourselves before wayward spirit-messengers. The visions they claim to have seen are only puffed-up images that come from their own prideful imaginations and weak ways of thinking.

These people have lost their way because they did not hold on firmly to the Chosen One, who is the head of his body, the sacred family. When the members of this body depend on the Chosen One, they are nourished and held together by the body’s joints and tendons. This is how Creator helps them grow into maturity.
verses.html: These people have lost their way because they did not hold on firmly to the Chosen One, who is the head of his body, the sacred family. When the members of this body depend on the Chosen One, they are nourished and held together by the body’s joints and tendons. This is how Creator helps them grow into maturity.

verses.heading: FOLLOWING THE CHOSEN ONE INSTEAD OF RULES / FOLLOWING THE CHOSEN ONE INSTEAD OF RULES
verses.text: If you have died with the Chosen One to the powers and ideas that rule the ways of this world, why would you follow the kind of rules these people require?
Rules like, “Do not handle this! Do not taste that! Do not go near this!”
The problem is, these things they make rules about eventually get used up and ultimately fade away, because they are only rules and instructions made up by weak human beings.

They may put on a show of wisdom and humble, self-imposed spirituality, along with harsh treatment of their bodies, but these rules are without honor and have no power to keep us from following our broken human ways.

verses.heading: KEEP LOOKING UP / KEEP LOOKING UP
verses.text: Since you have been raised up to a new life with the Chosen One, then keep looking upward toward him into the spirit-world above, where he sits in the place of greatest honor at Creator’s right hand.
Keep your thoughts and desires centered on the spirit-world above, not on the things from the earth below.

verses.heading: HIDDEN IN THE CHOSEN ONE / HIDDEN IN THE CHOSEN ONE
verses.text: You died with the Chosen One, and now your life is hidden with the Chosen One in the Great Spirit.
When the Chosen One is revealed, then you will be revealed with him and share in his beauty and honor.

verses.heading: THINGS THAT MUST DIE / THINGS THAT MUST DIE
verses.text: So let the death of the Chosen One kill in you all that is of the ways of this world. These are things such as improper sexual desires, spiritual impurity, uncontrolled emotions that lead to wrong desires, evil ways, and always wanting more than you need. These desires come from listening to lying spirits.
It is things such as these that will bring down the great anger of Creator on the ones who refuse to follow his ways.
All of you once followed this dark path when you walked in these ways,

but it is now time to walk away from these things, things such as uncontrolled anger that turns into rage, dark selfish desires, speaking lies against others, and insulting them with foul words from mouths that have no respect.

verses.heading: WALKING THE NEW PATH / WALKING THE NEW PATH
verses.text: So stop lying to each other and speaking with forked tongues! These bad-hearted ways must come to an end, for they no longer represent who you are. The person you were has died, so quit walking the path like that worn-out person you used to be.
Instead, begin to walk in the ways of the new person you have been created to be. This new person is being created to look like the Great Spirit and to think his thoughts.

verses.heading: THE CHOSEN ONE IS ALL IN ALL / THE CHOSEN ONE IS ALL IN ALL
verses.text: In the Chosen One there are no longer Insiders or Outsiders, or those who ceremonially cut the flesh and those who do not. We no longer see ourselves or others as uncivilized, ruffians, slaves or free. For there is only the Chosen One. All are in him, and he is in all!

verses.heading: NEW REGALIA FOR A NEW LIFE / NEW REGALIA FOR A NEW LIFE
verses.text: The Great Spirit has chosen you to be his holy and deeply loved children, so put on the new regalia he has provided for you. Put on deep feeling for the pain of others, kindness, humbleness of heart, gentleness of spirit, and be patient with one another.
If there are any complaints against each other, then carry that burden basket and learn to forgive. For we must forgive others in the same manner that our Honored Chief has freely forgiven us.
When all this new regalia is in place, let the love of the Great Spirit gather all the loose threads and braid them together in unity with one another.
Let the Chosen One guide you on the path of peace and harmony, and then as his one body this peace will be the guiding light in your hearts as you give thanks to the Great Spirit.

verses.heading: DANCING OUR PRAYERS / DANCING OUR PRAYERS
verses.text: Let the message of the Chosen One become a deep watering hole inside you. It will then become a refreshing spring as you teach and guide one another with wisdom and understanding. You will sing traditional prayers, sacred chants, and spiritual songs, as you dance your prayers before the Great Spirit with glad and thankful hearts.
verses.html: Let the message of the Chosen One become a deep watering hole inside you. It will then become a refreshing spring as you teach and guide one another with wisdom and understanding. You will sing traditional prayers, sacred chants, and spiritual songs, as you dance your prayers before the Great Spirit with glad and thankful hearts.

verses.text: Every step taken and each word spoken should be done to represent our Honored Chief Creator Sets Free (Jesus), as you dance your prayers and give thanks through him to our Father the Creator.

verses.heading: GUIDANCE FOR FAMILY MEMBERS / GUIDANCE FOR FAMILY MEMBERS
verses.text: Wives, listen to and follow the loving guidance of your husbands, for this is a good thing in Creator’s sight.
Husbands, love your wives in the same manner that Creator loves you, and never let bitter roots grow in your heart toward them.
verses.html: Husbands, love your wives in the same manner that Creator loves you, and never let bitter roots grow in your heart toward them.

verses.text: Children, follow the wise guidance of your parents in all you do, for this will make Creator’s heart glad.
verses.html: Children, follow the wise guidance of your parents in all you do, for this will make Creator’s heart glad.

verses.text: Fathers, do not push your children too hard, for this may make their hearts fall to the ground.

verses.heading: GUIDANCE FOR SLAVES AND MASTERS / GUIDANCE FOR SLAVES AND MASTERS
verses.text: If you are a slave, then do everything your earthly master tells you to do, not just when he has his eye on you but from a good heart and out of deep respect for the Great Spirit.
Do everything from a strong heart, knowing you are serving our Creator and not weak human beings.
For you know it is our Honored Chief, the Chosen One, whom you serve, who will honor you with all that he has promised.
It does not matter whether one is master or slave: if wrong is done, then wrong will come back—full circle. Creator will not favor one over another.
verses.html: It does not matter whether one is master or slave: if wrong is done, then wrong will come back—full circle. Creator will not favor one over another.

verses.text: If you are a master, then treat your slaves in Creator’s right ways, with respect and honor, for you know that you also have a Master in the spirit-world above.

verses.heading: NEVER GIVE UP PRAYING / NEVER GIVE UP PRAYING
verses.text: When you send your voice to the Great Spirit, stay alert and never give up praying and giving thanks.

Keep us in your thoughts and prayers also. Ask Creator to open the way for our message to be heard, and that I would clearly make known the mystery of the Chosen One. It is for this reason that I have been captured and put in chains.
Use great wisdom as you walk among those who are not yet part of the sacred family, and make full use of every opportunity as you represent our Honored Chief.
verses.html: Use great wisdom as you walk among those who are not yet part of the sacred family, and make full use of every opportunity as you represent our Honored Chief.

verses.text: Think before you speak and let your words be clear. Then, like salt that brings out the good flavor, you will know how to give each person the right answer.

verses.heading: FINAL WORDS AND FAREWELLS / FINAL WORDS AND FAREWELLS
verses.text: I am sending He Is at Ease (Tychicus) to you, a much-loved spiritual brother, one who faithfully serves our Honored Chief by also serving others. I am sending him to bring you news about me, so you will know how we are doing and that your hearts may be lifted up and made strong.
verses.html: I am sending He Is at Ease (Tychicus) to you, a much-loved spiritual brother, one who faithfully serves our Honored Chief by also serving others. I am sending him to bring you news about me, so you will know how we are doing and that your hearts may be lifted up and made strong.

verses.text: Along with him is He Is Helpful (Onesimus), a much-loved and faithful spiritual brother, who is also from the sacred family that meets in your village. They will give you a full report about everything here.
verses.html: Along with him is He Is Helpful (Onesimus), a much-loved and faithful spiritual brother, who is also from the sacred family that meets in your village. They will give you a full report about everything here.

verses.text: I send you greetings from Good Chief (Aristarchus), who is in prison with me. War Club (Mark), the cousin of Son of Comfort (Barnabas), also sends his greetings. He is the one I already instructed you about. If he comes to you, welcome him.

Creator Rescues (Jesus), who is also named Stands Upright (Justus), also sends his greetings. These are the only Tribal Members who walk with me on Creator’s good road, working with me side by side. They have been a great comfort to me.

Walks in Beauty (Epaphras), who is a member of the sacred family of your village, sends his greetings also. He is a true servant of the Chosen One, Creator Sets Free (Jesus). He wrestles for you in his prayers, that you will stand strong and walk Creator’s path with firm steps as you grow into mature human beings.
I speak from my heart, he has worked with all his strength for you and for those who live in the village of The People Will Decide (Laodicea) and in Medicine Village (Hierapolis).
Our much-loved friend Shining Light (Luke), the medicine man, sends you his greetings, along with Leader of the People (Demas).
Send my greetings to the sacred family members in the village of The People Will Decide (Laodicea), to Bride Woman (Nympha), and to the sacred family members that gather in her home.

After you who live in Village of Giants (Colossae) have read this message from me, make sure it is also read by the sacred family at The People Will Decide (Laodicea), and then you can also read the message I sent to them.
Give this message to Horse Chief (Archippus), “See to it that you finish the work our Honored Chief entrusted to you.”
I, Small Man (Paul), write this greeting with my own hand. Remember me in my chains! May the gift of Creator’s great kindness rest on you. Aho! May it be so!
verses.html:
I, Small Man (Paul), write this greeting with my own hand. Remember me in my chains! May the gift of Creator’s great kindness rest on you.
Aho! May it be so!

verses.heading: GREETINGS / GREETINGS
verses.text: From Small Man (Paul), Forest Walker (Silvanus), and He Gives Honor (Timothy). To the sacred family that gathers in the village of False Victory (Thessalonica), who belong to our Father the Great Spirit and to our Honored Chief, Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One. We greet you with the gift of Creator’s great kindness and peace.
verses.html:
From Small Man (Paul), Forest Walker (Silvanus), and He Gives Honor (Timothy).
To the sacred family that gathers in the village of False Victory (Thessalonica), who belong to our Father the Great Spirit and to our Honored Chief, Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One. We greet you with the gift of Creator’s great kindness and peace.

verses.text: We never stop giving thanks for you, speaking your names as we send our voice to the Great Spirit.

We remember how your trust became a labor of love and how hope kept you hand in hand with our Honored Chief, Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One, as you walked under the shadow of the Great Spirit, who is our Father from above.
verses.html: We remember how your trust became a labor of love and how hope kept you hand in hand with our Honored Chief, Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One, as you walked under the shadow of the Great Spirit, who is our Father from above.

verses.heading: WELCOMING THE GOOD STORY / WELCOMING THE GOOD STORY
verses.text: My sacred family members who are loved by Creator, we know he has chosen you to be his own.
For when we told you the good story, it was not with words only but with the power and assurance that comes from the Holy Spirit. For you know that we lived and walked among you in a good way.
So you followed in our footsteps and those of our Honored Chief, welcoming the good story in a time of much hardship and trouble with the joy of the Holy Spirit.
In this way, you became an example for all the members of the sacred family in Land of Tall People (Macedonia) and in Land of Sorrow (Achaia).

The message from our Honored Chief has sounded out from you, not only in Land of Tall People (Macedonia) and Land of Sorrow (Achaia), but everywhere we go the word has gone out about your trust in Creator, and we have nothing to add to what has been said.
They keep talking about the kind of welcome you gave us. They tell how you walked away from spirit-images to serve the living and true Great Spirit

and how you now wait for his Son Creator Sets Free (Jesus), the one he raised up from the dead, to return from the spirit-world above. He is the one who rescues us from the coming storm of Creator’s anger.
verses.html: and how you now wait for his Son Creator Sets Free (Jesus), the one he raised up from the dead, to return from the spirit-world above. He is the one who rescues us from the coming storm of Creator’s anger.

verses.heading: SEEKING TO PLEASE THE GREAT SPIRIT / SEEKING TO PLEASE THE GREAT SPIRIT
verses.text: So then, my sacred family members, you can see that our time with you did not fail in its purpose.
For you already know about the mistreatment and insults we faced at Village of Horses (Philippi). But in the midst of such hostility Creator gave us the boldness to tell you his good story.
Our message to you had no false purpose. We were not trying to trick or fool anyone.

For it is the Great Spirit himself who has approved and entrusted us with the good story. We do not speak to please human beings but to please the Great Spirit, the one who puts our hearts to the test.
As you know, we did not try to sweet-talk you into giving us your possessions. Creator is our witness.
We were not looking for you or anyone else to give us honor,
even though as message bearers of the Chosen One we could have required it. Instead, we were as gentle among you as a nursing mother caring for her own children.
verses.html: even though as message bearers of the Chosen One we could have required it. Instead, we were as gentle among you as a nursing mother caring for her own children.

verses.text: We cared so much for you that we were willing to share with you not only Creator’s good story but our own lives as well. That is how deep our love for you has become.

verses.heading: WORKING HARD, NIGHT AND DAY / WORKING HARD, NIGHT AND DAY
verses.text: My sacred family members, I am sure you remember how hard we worked night and day so we would not be a burden to anyone as we told Creator’s good story to you.
Along with the Great Spirit, you who trust our message are witnesses to the honest, good, and blameless ways we walked among you.
For you know that we treated you as parents would treat their own children. We begged and comforted and urged you
to walk in ways that bring honor to Creator, the one who chose you to walk his good road that shines like the sun.

This is why we never stop giving thanks to the Great Spirit for the manner in which you welcomed his message. You received it for what it truly is, the word of Creator and not the word of human beings. His word is now at work in you who trust in its message.

verses.heading: HOSTILE TO THE GOOD STORY / HOSTILE TO THE GOOD STORY
verses.text: You, my spiritual relatives, have followed in the footsteps of Creator’s sacred families who gather in Land of Promise (Judea), who are also joined together in Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One. For you have suffered mistreatment at the hands of your people, just as they did from their own Tribal Members.
They are the ones who killed our Honored Chief Creator Sets Free (Jesus) and the prophets and have driven us away. They fail to please the Great Spirit and are hostile to all humankind.

They try to keep us from telling the Outside Nations the good story so they can be set free and made whole. Their broken ways have always taken them down the wrong path, but now the storm of Creator’s great anger is catching up with them, leading to a bad end.
verses.html: They try to keep us from telling the Outside Nations the good story so they can be set free and made whole. Their broken ways have always taken them down the wrong path, but now the storm of Creator’s great anger is catching up with them, leading to a bad end.

verses.heading: HINDERED FROM COMING TO YOU / HINDERED FROM COMING TO YOU
verses.text: My sacred family members, we may have been physically separated from you, but you were still in our hearts. This made us long for you even more and to try to see you face to face.
Our desire was to come to you. I, Small Man (Paul), tried more than once, but Accuser (Satan) held us back.
For who else but you will be our headdress of honor making our hearts glad before our Honored Chief Creator Sets Free (Jesus) when he appears?
Yes, you are our honor and our joy!

verses.heading: FACING HARD TIMES / FACING HARD TIMES
verses.text: When we could not wait any longer to see you, we felt it was best to stay alone in Wondering Place (Athens) and send He Gives Honor (Timothy) to you.
He is our spiritual brother who works hand in hand with Creator telling the good story of the Chosen One. We sent him to lift you up and strengthen you in your spiritual ways,
so that no one would be shaken by the hard times we are facing. For you know that this is the path Creator has chosen for us.
verses.html: so that no one would be shaken by the hard times we are facing. For you know that this is the path Creator has chosen for us.

verses.text: When we were with you, we made it clear that a trail of sorrow and trouble lay ahead of us. As you know, we had to walk that path.

verses.heading: A GOOD REPORT FROM HE GIVES HONOR / A GOOD REPORT FROM HE GIVES HONOR
verses.text: So because I could not bear waiting any longer, I sent He Gives Honor (Timothy) to see whether you were still walking in our spiritual ways. For I feared that the evil trickster may have drawn you away, and our work among you would come to nothing.

But He Gives Honor (Timothy) has now come back from you and brought the good news that you still walk in love and in our spiritual ways. He told us that you have good thoughts about us and long to see us as much as we long to see you.
So, my sacred family members, this good news about your spiritual walk has comforted us during all the trouble and suffering we have faced.
We came to life when we heard that you are standing firm trusting in our Honored Chief.
When we stand in prayer before Creator, we cannot thank him enough for all the joy you have brought to us.
verses.html: When we stand in prayer before Creator, we cannot thank him enough for all the joy you have brought to us.

verses.text: With all our heart we send up prayers night and day, asking to see you face to face, so we can give you all you need to further strengthen your spiritual ways.
Now may our Father the Great Spirit himself and Creator Sets Free (Jesus) our Honored Chief guide our steps to you.
May our Honored Chief make your love for each other and for all people grow deep and wide, just as our love does for you.
This love will give you strong hearts, so you will be able to stand holy and pure before our Father the Great Spirit when our Honored Chief Creator Sets Free (Jesus) appears with all his holy ones.

verses.heading: KEEP WALKING IN A SACRED WAY / KEEP WALKING IN A SACRED WAY
verses.text: My sacred family members, I have more I want to say to you. You are walking in a way that makes Creator’s heart glad, the way we taught you to walk. Now our firm counsel to you from our Honored Chief Creator Sets Free (Jesus) is that you must keep walking more and more in this way.
For the instructions we gave you came from Creator Sets Free (Jesus) our Honored Chief himself.
Our Creator wants you to walk in a sacred way, keeping yourself free from sexual impurity.
He wants each of you to control your own body in a sacred manner with honor and respect,
not with uncontrolled desire, like the people from the Outside Nations who do not know the Great Spirit.
No one should abuse a sacred family member in this manner, for our Honored Chief will punish those who do, just as we have already solemnly warned you.
verses.html: No one should abuse a sacred family member in this manner, for our Honored Chief will punish those who do, just as we have already solemnly warned you.

verses.text: For our Creator has not called us to walk in impurity but in a sacred manner.
So the one who turns away from this instruction is not turning away from a human being, but from Creator himself, who has given his Holy Spirit to you.

verses.heading: LOVING EACH OTHER / LOVING EACH OTHER
verses.text: There is no need for us to instruct you about the love we share as sacred family members. Creator himself has taught you how to love each other.
It is clear that you show love to all the sacred family throughout Land of Tall People (Macedonia). So then, my sacred family members, keep loving like this more and more.
Make it your aim to live a quiet and peaceful life, to mind your own business, and to work with your own hands, just as we have instructed.
By walking in this good way, you will win the respect of outsiders and not have to look to others for your needs.

verses.heading: ABOUT THOSE WHO HAVE DIED / ABOUT THOSE WHO HAVE DIED
verses.text: Now, my sacred family members, we want you to understand what will happen to those who have walked on so that you will not be filled with sorrow like the others who have no hope.
We believe that Creator Sets Free (Jesus) died and rose again. We can be just as sure that the Great Spirit will, along with him, bring back to life those who when they died were trusting in him.
verses.html: We believe that Creator Sets Free (Jesus) died and rose again. We can be just as sure that the Great Spirit will, along with him, bring back to life those who when they died were trusting in him.

verses.text: What we are telling you comes from the words of our Honored Chief. We who remain alive until his coming will not come face to face with him ahead of the ones who have walked on.

For our Honored Chief himself will come down from the spirit-world above with a war cry. The voice of the chief spirit-messenger will join with him, and the eagle bone whistle will sound. First, the ones who died trusting in the Chosen One will rise.
Then, together with them, we who have remained alive will be taken up into the clouds to meet our Honored Chief in the air. Then we will always be with him.
Use these words to lift up each other’s hearts.

verses.heading: THE DAY OF OUR HONORED CHIEF / THE DAY OF OUR HONORED CHIEF
verses.text: Now, my sacred family members, we have no need to write to you about the times and seasons that have been set in place by our Creator.
verses.html: Now, my sacred family members, we have no need to write to you about the times and seasons that have been set in place by our Creator.

verses.text: For you know very well that the day of our Honored Chief will come without warning like a thief in the night.
verses.html: For you know very well that the day of our Honored Chief will come without warning like a thief in the night.

verses.text: At a time when people are saying, “Peace and safety,” sudden destruction will come down on their heads, like the pains of birth that come upon a woman with child, and there will be no way to escape.
But that day should not catch you off guard like a thief in the night. For you, my sacred family members, are children of the light. You belong to the day. We are not of the night, nor of darkness.
So let us not fall asleep as others do. Instead, we should stay sober and alert.
For it is during the night that people sleep or get drunk.
But since we are children of the day, let us walk in sobriety and put on faith and love as a breastplate, and for a headdress let us put on the hope of being set free and made whole.

For the Great Spirit has not chosen us as targets for his great anger, but as targets for his great love. He will set us free and make us whole through our Honored Chief Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One.
verses.html: For the Great Spirit has not chosen us as targets for his great anger, but as targets for his great love. He will set us free and make us whole through our Honored Chief Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One.

verses.text: He died for us so that we might live together with him, whether we remain alive until he comes or have died and walked on.
verses.html: He died for us so that we might live together with him, whether we remain alive until he comes or have died and walked on.

verses.text: So encourage each other and help each other grow strong, just as you are already doing.

verses.heading: WISE COUNSEL AND LAST WORDS / WISE COUNSEL AND LAST WORDS
verses.text: So, my sacred family members, we have something to ask of you. Honor the spiritual leaders who work hard among you. For they watch over you and give you wise and firm counsel as they serve our Honored Chief.
Treat them with great respect and love for the work they do, and be at peace with each other.

Now, my sacred family members, we call on you to give firm and wise counsel to those whose hands do nothing. Comfort those whose hearts are on the ground. Help the ones who are weak, and be patient with everyone.
Make sure no one gives back to anyone evil for evil. Instead, seek to walk in a good way with each other and with all people.
Dance for joy at all times!
Never stop sending up prayers.
Give thanks to the Great Spirit in all things, for this is what he wants from you as you dance in step with Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One.
Do not put out the fire of the Holy Spirit.
verses.html: Do not put out the fire of the Holy Spirit.

verses.text: Do not look down on or turn away from words spoken as prophecies,
but think deeply about what is said and hold firmly to what is good.
Make sure to turn away from all kinds of evil.

verses.heading: PRAYERS AND BLESSINGS / PRAYERS AND BLESSINGS
verses.text: Now may the Giver of Peace, Creator himself, make you holy in every way. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be kept pure and without blame at the coming of our Honored Chief, Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One.
The one who called you is faithful, and he will do it.
My sacred family members, keep sending up prayers for us,
and greet all the members of the sacred family with a holy kiss.
Give me your solemn promise that you will read this letter to all of them.
May the gift of great kindness from Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One be with you all. Aho! May it be so!
verses.html:
May the gift of great kindness from Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One be with you all.
Aho! May it be so!

verses.heading: GREETINGS / GREETINGS
verses.text: From Small Man (Paul), Forest Walker (Silvanus), and He Gives Honor (Timothy). To the sacred family that gathers in village of False Victory (Thessalonica) who belong to our Father the Great Spirit and to Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One.
We greet you with the gift of great kindness and peace that comes from our Father the Great Spirit and from our Honored Chief, Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One.
verses.html: We greet you with the gift of great kindness and peace that comes from our Father the Great Spirit and from our Honored Chief, Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One.

verses.heading: GIVING THANKS FOR YOU / GIVING THANKS FOR YOU
verses.text: My sacred family members, it is only right and good that we are always giving thanks to Creator for you. We give thanks for the way your trust in him and your love for each other keeps growing stronger day by day.
verses.html: My sacred family members, it is only right and good that we are always giving thanks to Creator for you. We give thanks for the way your trust in him and your love for each other keeps growing stronger day by day.

verses.text: We tell the other Sacred Families of Creator about you, bragging about the way you keep trusting even when the path you walk is full of pain and trouble from others.

verses.heading: CREATOR WILL HONOR YOU / CREATOR WILL HONOR YOU
verses.text: Creator will honor you as you walk his good road even when it means suffering. This shows that it is right for Creator to punish those who have made you suffer.

It is also right that he will bring comfort to all of us who share in these troubles. This will happen when our Honored Chief Creator Sets Free (Jesus) is revealed from the spirit-world above along with all his powerful spirit-messengers. In flaming fire
he will punish the ones who refuse to see who Creator truly is, and those who do not respect and follow the good story of our Honored Chief Creator Sets Free (Jesus).
They will come to a bad end and to a punishment that will last beyond the end of all days. They will be removed far away from the beauty and power that shines from the face of our Honored Chief.

This will happen on the day he comes to be honored by all his holy people and to be looked on in amazement by all who have trusted in him. This includes you, because you trusted the truth we told you.
verses.html: This will happen on the day he comes to be honored by all his holy people and to be looked on in amazement by all who have trusted in him. This includes you, because you trusted the truth we told you.

verses.heading: SENDING UP PRAYERS / SENDING UP PRAYERS
verses.text: This is the reason we never stop sending our voice to the Great Spirit for you. We pray that our Creator will give you what you need to walk with honor on the path he has chosen for you. We pray that, as you trust in his power, he will fulfill every desire you have to walk in a good way.

We also pray that you will show the beauty that is in the name of our Honored Chief Creator Sets Free (Jesus) and that his beauty will be seen in you. He will do this by the gift of Creator’s great kindness that comes through our Honored Chief, Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One.
verses.html: We also pray that you will show the beauty that is in the name of our Honored Chief Creator Sets Free (Jesus) and that his beauty will be seen in you. He will do this by the gift of Creator’s great kindness that comes through our Honored Chief, Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One.

verses.heading: THE DAY OF OUR HONORED CHIEF / THE DAY OF OUR HONORED CHIEF
verses.text: My sacred family members, we have something to say to you about the time when our Honored Chief, Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One, will appear and we will all be gathered around him.

Do not be suddenly shaken in your mind or troubled if you hear that the day of our Honored Chief has already arrived. It does not matter whether you hear it by a prophecy or a spoken word or by a written message that someone says came from us.
verses.html: Do not be suddenly shaken in your mind or troubled if you hear that the day of our Honored Chief has already arrived. It does not matter whether you hear it by a prophecy or a spoken word or by a written message that someone says came from us.

verses.heading: BEFORE THAT DAY COMES / BEFORE THAT DAY COMES
verses.text: Do not be fooled by anyone. Before that day comes, there must first be an uprising —a turning away from Creator. Then the man who respects no law will be revealed, the son whose father is destruction.
verses.html: Do not be fooled by anyone. Before that day comes, there must first be an uprising —a turning away from Creator. Then the man who respects no law will be revealed, the son whose father is destruction.

verses.text: He will speak out against and consider himself to be greater than all the so-called powerful spirit-beings and all that is seen as sacred or holy. He will even set himself up in Creator’s sacred lodge and represent himself as the Great Spirit.
Have you forgotten that when I was still with you I told you about these things?

verses.heading: MORE ABOUT THE LAWLESS ONE / MORE ABOUT THE LAWLESS ONE
verses.text: You know what it is that now holds him back until it is time for him to be revealed.
For the mysterious power of the lawless one is already at work in secret. The lawless one is ready and waiting to be revealed, but not until the one who holds him back steps out of the way.

Then the mask will come off and the lawless one will be revealed. And when Creator Sets Free (Jesus) our Honored Chief comes, he will destroy him with the breath of his mouth and put an end to him with the light that shines from his face.
verses.html: Then the mask will come off and the lawless one will be revealed. And when Creator Sets Free (Jesus) our Honored Chief comes, he will destroy him with the breath of his mouth and put an end to him with the light that shines from his face.

verses.text: This lawless one will come performing all kinds of misleading signs and wonders, but the one who gives him this power is Accuser (Satan) the evil trickster.
verses.html: This lawless one will come performing all kinds of misleading signs and wonders, but the one who gives him this power is Accuser (Satan) the evil trickster.

verses.text: He will use his trickster ways to lead people down a path to a bad end. They will follow him because they did not love the truth that would rescue them and set them free.
Because they did not love the truth, the Great Spirit will give them over to the full power of this lie, so they will believe it.
verses.html: Because they did not love the truth, the Great Spirit will give them over to the full power of this lie, so they will believe it.

verses.text: In this way, all who did not trust the truth but instead found joy in wrongdoing will come to the bad end they deserve.

verses.heading: STAND STRONG AND HOLD ON FIRMLY / STAND STRONG AND HOLD ON FIRMLY
verses.text: My sacred family members loved by our Honored Chief, we owe thanks to the Great Spirit for you. He has chosen you to be first among those he will set free and make whole, as you trust in the truth through his Spirit who makes you holy.
Creator used our telling of the good story to call you to himself so that you would share in the honor that shines from the face of our Honored Chief, Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One.
So then, my sacred family members, stand strong and hold firmly to the traditions we taught you, either by voice or by letter.

We are loved by our Honored Chief, Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One, and by our Father the Great Spirit. It is through the gift of his great kindness that he has given us good hope and comfort that will never fade away.
We pray that he will now lift up your hearts and strengthen you in all the good things you do or say.
verses.html: We pray that he will now lift up your hearts and strengthen you in all the good things you do or say.

verses.heading: MORE PRAYER IS NEEDED / MORE PRAYER IS NEEDED
verses.text: Now, my sacred family members, I have some final things to write to you. Would you send up prayers for us asking that the message of our Honored Chief will run like the wind and be given honor in the same way it has among you?
Pray that we will be rescued from bad-hearted and evil men—for not all follow our spiritual ways.
But our Honored Chief is trustworthy. He will set your feet on solid ground and protect you from the evil one.
The trust we have in our Honored Chief makes us feel sure that you will keep following all the instructions we gave you.
So we pray that he will guide your hearts into the path of Creator’s love and help you walk in the steady steps of the Chosen One.

verses.heading: FOLLOW THE TRADITIONS WE GAVE YOU / FOLLOW THE TRADITIONS WE GAVE YOU
verses.text: So, my sacred family members, as we represent our Honored Chief, Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One, we instruct you to keep away from any sacred family member who walks in a bad way and fails to follow the traditions we gave you.
For you all know that you should walk in our footsteps. We walked in a good way when we were with you.
We did not expect people to feed us for free. Instead, we wore ourselves out working hard night and day so we would not be a burden to anyone.
We had the right not to work, but we wanted to set a good example for you to follow.
Do you remember when we were still with you, we gave you the instruction, “The ones who will not work should not be fed”?
verses.html: Do you remember when we were still with you, we gave you the instruction, “The ones who will not work should not be fed”?

verses.text: We say this because we hear that there are some among you who are walking in a bad way. They do nothing but put their noses into the business of others.
So, representing our Honored Chief, Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One, we speak firmly to those who walk in this way, “Settle down, go to work, and quietly earn your own food.”
verses.html: So, representing our Honored Chief, Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One, we speak firmly to those who walk in this way, “Settle down, go to work, and quietly earn your own food.”

verses.heading: WORDS OF ENCOURAGEMENT / WORDS OF ENCOURAGEMENT
verses.text: But to the rest of you, my sacred family members, do not let your hearts fall to the ground as you keep walking in a good way.
Take note of any among you who do not follow these instructions. Have nothing to do with them, so they will feel the shame of their ways.
Do not see them as enemies, but give them this firm and wise counsel as members of the sacred family.

verses.heading: FINAL WORDS / FINAL WORDS
verses.text: Now may our Honored Chief of peace give his peace to you at all times and in every way. May our Honored Chief be with you all.
I, Small Man (Paul), write this final greeting with my own hand. Take note of how I sign my letters. This way you will know the letter is from me.
verses.html: I, Small Man (Paul), write this final greeting with my own hand. Take note of how I sign my letters. This way you will know the letter is from me.

verses.text: May the gift of great kindness that comes from our Honored Chief, Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One, be with you all. Aho! May it be so!
verses.html:
May the gift of great kindness that comes from our Honored Chief, Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One, be with you all.
Aho! May it be so!

verses.heading: GREETINGS / GREETINGS
verses.text: From Small Man (Paul), a message bearer of Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One. I was instructed to be a message bearer by the Great Spirit himself, our Sacred Deliverer, and by Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One, our hope.

To He Gives Honor (Timothy), my true spiritual son. I greet you with the gift of great kindness, mercy, and peace that comes from our Father the Great Spirit and from Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One, our Honored Chief.

verses.heading: SMALL MAN’S WISE COUNSEL BEGINS / SMALL MAN’S WISE COUNSEL BEGINS
verses.text: When I left to travel to Land of Tall People (Macedonia), I urged you to remain at Village of Desire (Ephesus) to instruct certain people not to teach things that are not true

and to turn away from stories with no meaning and from long ancestral histories. These things only cause arguments and confuse people instead of helping them to trust in the good road of the Great Spirit.
verses.html: and to turn away from stories with no meaning and from long ancestral histories. These things only cause arguments and confuse people instead of helping them to trust in the good road of the Great Spirit.

verses.text: My aim in telling you these things is that you would walk the path of love with a pure heart, being true to what you trust in and honest to who you are deep inside.
For there are some who have wandered from this good path and turned aside to nothing but worthless talk.
They want to be seen as teachers of our tribal law, but they do not understand the words they speak or the things they so boldly teach.

verses.heading: USING THE LAW IN THE RIGHT WAY / USING THE LAW IN THE RIGHT WAY
verses.text: We know that the law is good if it is used in the right way.

For we understand that the law was not made for those who walk in a good way. The law was made for outlaws, rebels, and those who follow their bad hearts and have no respect for what is spiritual. It was made for the unholy ones who walk in worthless ways, and for the ones who kill their own fathers or mothers and take the lives of others.

The law was made for men who sell their bodies for sex or abuse the sacred gift of sex with each other, for slave traders, forked-tongue talkers, those who tell lies about their fellow human beings, and for anything else that goes against the kind of teaching
found in the good story that shows the beauty of the Blessed One, our Creator. This is the teaching that was entrusted to me.
verses.html: found in the good story that shows the beauty of the Blessed One, our Creator. This is the teaching that was entrusted to me.

verses.heading: SMALL MAN TELLS ABOUT HIMSELF / SMALL MAN TELLS ABOUT HIMSELF
verses.text: I give thanks to the Chosen One, Creator Sets Free (Jesus) our Honored Chief, for the strength he gives me to walk out this sacred task.

He chose me even though I used to speak evil against him. I even hunted down and attacked his followers. But he took pity on me because I did not know what I was doing and did not yet believe who he was.
The gift of Creator’s great kindness overflowed to me along with the trust and love found in Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One.
Here is a saying that you can be sure of: Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One came into this world to set bad-hearted people free from their broken ways—and I am the worst one of all.

But I was shown mercy so that in me Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One could show that he does not give up on even the worst bad-hearted person. In this way, I became an example of his patience that never runs dry for the ones who would put their trust in him for the life of the world to come that never fades away, full of beauty and harmony.

verses.heading: HONORING OUR GREAT CHIEF / HONORING OUR GREAT CHIEF
verses.text: So let us honor the Great Chief of all the ages, the one whom death has no power over, who cannot be seen with human eyes. He is the only true and Great Spirit. All honor and shining-greatness belong to him to the time beyond the end of all days. Aho! May it be so!

verses.heading: MORE WISE COUNSEL / MORE WISE COUNSEL
verses.text: Now, He Gives Honor (Timothy) my spiritual son, the instructions I give you are the same ones that were spoken over you as prophecies. Use these as weapons to keep fighting this spiritual battle in a good way.
verses.html: Now, He Gives Honor (Timothy) my spiritual son, the instructions I give you are the same ones that were spoken over you as prophecies. Use these as weapons to keep fighting this spiritual battle in a good way.

verses.text: Keep your trust in the Chosen One strong and follow what you know deep inside to be true. Some have not listened to this inner voice, and their trust in the Chosen One has fallen to the ground.
verses.html: Keep your trust in the Chosen One strong and follow what you know deep inside to be true. Some have not listened to this inner voice, and their trust in the Chosen One has fallen to the ground.

verses.text: This happened to Sings with a Glad Heart (Hymenaeus) and Man Fighter (Alexander). I had to hand them over to Accuser (Satan) that they might learn not to speak against the Great Spirit.

verses.heading: GUIDANCE FOR SENDING UP PRAYERS / GUIDANCE FOR SENDING UP PRAYERS
verses.text: First of all, I call on you to send your voice to the Great Spirit with many kinds of prayer. Give thanks as you ask him to bless all people everywhere with the things they need.
Send up prayers for rulers and all governing authorities, so we may live our lives in a peaceful and sacred way, walking together with harmony and respect.
This will make Creator’s heart glad and will be seen as a good thing by the one who sets us free and makes us whole.

verses.heading: CREATOR LONGS FOR ALL PEOPLE TO BE FREE / CREATOR LONGS FOR ALL PEOPLE TO BE FREE
verses.text: Our Creator longs to set all people free and guide them into the full understanding of the truth.
For there is only one Great Spirit, and only one who can bring the Great Spirit and human beings together in peace. That one is Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One, who is himself human.
He gave up his own life to set all people free, so that, when the time was right, this truth would be made clear to all humankind.

The reason I was given the sacred task of a truth teller and a message bearer is to tell others this good story. I am not speaking with a forked tongue! Creator has sent me to be a faithful and true wisdomkeeper to the Outside Nations.

verses.heading: GUIDANCE FOR MEN AND WOMEN / GUIDANCE FOR MEN AND WOMEN
verses.text: So in every place you gather as a sacred family, I want the men who pray to lift up their hands in a sacred manner, putting away all anger and disagreement.
verses.html: So in every place you gather as a sacred family, I want the men who pray to lift up their hands in a sacred manner, putting away all anger and disagreement.

verses.text: In the same way, I want the women who pray in the sacred family gathering to wear clothes that represent them well. They should dress in a modest and respectful manner. There is no need to try to look better than others with fancy hair, or with gold, pearls, or clothes that cost too much.
verses.html: In the same way, I want the women who pray in the sacred family gathering to wear clothes that represent them well. They should dress in a modest and respectful manner. There is no need to try to look better than others with fancy hair, or with gold, pearls, or clothes that cost too much.

verses.text: It is only right that a woman who represents herself as walking in a sacred manner should show her beauty in the good things she does for others.
At our sacred family gatherings, a woman should remain quiet while learning from those who teach and humbly follow their instructions.
verses.html: At our sacred family gatherings, a woman should remain quiet while learning from those who teach and humbly follow their instructions.

verses.text: I do not permit a woman to teach or take over for a man, but to listen quietly.
For Red Clay (Adam) was formed first and then Life Bearer (Eve).
Also, Red Clay (Adam) was not fooled by the evil trickster. It was the woman who was fooled and walked where she should not.
verses.html: Also, Red Clay (Adam) was not fooled by the evil trickster. It was the woman who was fooled and walked where she should not.

verses.text: But since being set free and made whole came through a woman giving birth to a child, women will be kept safe through the pain and labor of childbirth if they keep walking a sacred path of trust, love, and self-control.
verses.html: But since being set free and made whole came through a woman giving birth to a child, women will be kept safe through the pain and labor of childbirth if they keep walking a sacred path of trust, love, and self-control.

verses.heading: GUIDELINES FOR SPIRITUAL LEADERS / GUIDELINES FOR SPIRITUAL LEADERS
verses.text: It is a true saying that anyone who desires the solemn task of watching over the sacred family desires a good thing.
Elders like this must be free from accusation, faithful in marriage, clear-minded, self-controlled, honorable, welcoming to strangers, and able to teach others.
They must not be heavy drinkers, nor given to violence, but gentle peacemakers who are free from the love of possessions.
These elders must guide their own families in a good way, having children who are respectful and well-behaved.
verses.html: These elders must guide their own families in a good way, having children who are respectful and well-behaved.

verses.text: For if they cannot guide their own families, how will they take care of Creator’s sacred family?
They also should not be new followers of Creator Sets Free (Jesus), or they might get a big head and give the evil trickster the right to accuse them.
verses.html: They also should not be new followers of Creator Sets Free (Jesus), or they might get a big head and give the evil trickster the right to accuse them.

verses.text: And last of all, they must have a good reputation with those who are outside the sacred family, so they will not be shamed and fall into the trap set by the evil trickster.
verses.html: And last of all, they must have a good reputation with those who are outside the sacred family, so they will not be shamed and fall into the trap set by the evil trickster.

verses.heading: GUIDELINES FOR SACRED SERVANTS / GUIDELINES FOR SACRED SERVANTS
verses.text: In the same way, those who have the sacred task of helping others must walk in an honorable way, not be double-tongued, nor heavy drinkers, and not greedy for possessions.
From deep within they must hold firm to the mystery of our spiritual ways.
They must first prove themselves. Then if they are found to be free from blame, let them walk true to the sacred task of serving others.
Their wives must walk with dignity, never speak evil of others, and be clear-minded and faithful in every way.
These sacred servants must also be faithful in marriage and guide their own families in a good way.
The ones who have served well as helpers gain the respect of others, and their trust in Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One will grow strong.
I hope to come to you soon. But I am writing this letter to you
so that, if I am held back, you will know how to live together in Creator’s household. This household is the sacred family of the Living Great Spirit, the family that holds high the truth.

verses.heading: A GREAT MYSTERY MADE KNOWN / A GREAT MYSTERY MADE KNOWN
verses.text: The mystery of this great and sacred truth has now been made known. He who appeared as a human being was shown to be in the right by the Spirit. He was seen by spirit-messengers, made known among the nations, trusted in by people in the world, and taken up to be honored in the spirit-world above.
verses.html: The mystery of this great and sacred truth has now been made known. He who appeared as a human being was shown to be in the right by the Spirit. He was seen by spirit-messengers, made known among the nations, trusted in by people in the world, and taken up to be honored in the spirit-world above.

verses.heading: WARNINGS ABOUT THE LAST TIMES / WARNINGS ABOUT THE LAST TIMES
verses.text: The Spirit clearly says that in the last times some will turn away from their trust in Creator Sets Free (Jesus) and listen to lying spirits and their evil teachings.
It is through people with forked tongues and false faces that these lies will be spoken. The truth inside them has been burned away until they no longer know right from wrong.

They stop people from getting married and tell people to stay away from eating certain kinds of foods. These foods were created by the Great Spirit to be received with grateful hearts by those who trust in and know the truth.
For all of his creation is good, and nothing is to be refused if it is received with a grateful heart.
For it is made holy and good to eat by Creator’s word and prayer.

verses.heading: SERVING THE SACRED FAMILY / SERVING THE SACRED FAMILY
verses.text: If you make these things clear to the members of the sacred family, you will be a good servant of Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One. This shows that the trust you have in the message of our spiritual ways and the good teaching you have been following has helped you to grow spiritually strong.
verses.html: If you make these things clear to the members of the sacred family, you will be a good servant of Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One. This shows that the trust you have in the message of our spiritual ways and the good teaching you have been following has helped you to grow spiritually strong.

verses.text: Have nothing to do with made-up stories and worn-out tales that have been passed on from long ago. Instead, learn to walk in a sacred manner.
Physical discipline is good for the life we now live, but spiritual discipline is good in every way, since it holds promise not only for this life but also for the life of the world to come.
verses.html: Physical discipline is good for the life we now live, but spiritual discipline is good in every way, since it holds promise not only for this life but also for the life of the world to come.

verses.text: This saying is honorable and should be fully welcomed by all.

verses.heading: THE ONE WHO SETS ALL PEOPLE FREE / THE ONE WHO SETS ALL PEOPLE FREE
verses.text: This is the reason we struggle and work so hard, for we have put our hope in the Living Great Spirit. He is the one who sets free and makes whole all of humankind, but first and foremost those who put their trust in him.
Teach and instruct others in all these things.
Let no one look down on you because you are young. Lead the way for others in all that you say and do, and also by trusting, loving, and walking with a pure heart.
Until I come to see you, make sure you read the Sacred Teachings out loud at our sacred family gatherings, and teach with words that lift people’s spirits high.

verses.heading: DO NOT NEGLECT YOUR SPIRITUAL GIFT / DO NOT NEGLECT YOUR SPIRITUAL GIFT
verses.text: Do not neglect the spiritual gift that is in you. This gift came to you through a word of prophecy that was given when the council of elders laid their hands on you to set you in place as a spiritual leader.
verses.html: Do not neglect the spiritual gift that is in you. This gift came to you through a word of prophecy that was given when the council of elders laid their hands on you to set you in place as a spiritual leader.
