verses.text: Meditate on these things. Give all your time and energy to doing them. In this way, everyone will see how far down the good road you have traveled.
Keep a close watch on yourself and on what you are teaching. Keep doing all that I have told you. In this way, you will set free and make whole not only yourself but all who listen to you.
verses.html: Keep a close watch on yourself and on what you are teaching. Keep doing all that I have told you. In this way, you will set free and make whole not only yourself but all who listen to you.

verses.heading: HONORING THE ELDERS / HONORING THE ELDERS
verses.text: Never speak sharp words to a man who is your elder. Instead, speak respectfully to him as to a father. Speak to the younger men as brothers,
to the women elders as mothers, and to the young women as sisters, keeping your thoughts pure.

verses.heading: THE CARE OF WIDOWS / THE CARE OF WIDOWS
verses.text: Honor and take care of the women whose husbands have walked on, if they truly need help.
But if any among them have children or grandchildren, they should take care of her with respect as she once did for them, for this is what Creator wants them to do.
The sacred family should take care of women who have no one to care for them as long as they are looking to Creator for their help and continue to send up prayers night and day.
verses.html: The sacred family should take care of women who have no one to care for them as long as they are looking to Creator for their help and continue to send up prayers night and day.

verses.text: But the ones who live only to please themselves are spiritually dead even while they live.
verses.html: But the ones who live only to please themselves are spiritually dead even while they live.

verses.text: Instruct the sacred family members about these things, so no one will have a reason to accuse or look down on them.
verses.html: Instruct the sacred family members about these things, so no one will have a reason to accuse or look down on them.

verses.text: For all who fail to care for the members of their own family have denied the truth of our spiritual ways and are worse than an outsider who does not trust as we do.

verses.heading: WIDOWS WHO ARE ELDERLY / WIDOWS WHO ARE ELDERLY
verses.text: To be counted as a widow to be taken care of by the sacred family, a woman must be an elder of sixty winters or older who was faithful to her husband.
verses.html: To be counted as a widow to be taken care of by the sacred family, a woman must be an elder of sixty winters or older who was faithful to her husband.

verses.text: She must also have a reputation for doing good. Has she raised her children in a good way? Has she welcomed travelers into her home? Has she washed the feet of Creator’s holy ones? Has she offered help to people during hard times? Has she always been willing to do good for others?

verses.heading: WIDOWS WHO ARE YOUNG / WIDOWS WHO ARE YOUNG
verses.text: Do not include the younger widows for this kind of care. For when their natural human desires draw them away from their devotion to the Chosen One, they will want to get married.
verses.html: Do not include the younger widows for this kind of care. For when their natural human desires draw them away from their devotion to the Chosen One, they will want to get married.

verses.text: Then they will be found guilty of breaking the sacred promise they made to remain unmarried.
verses.html: Then they will be found guilty of breaking the sacred promise they made to remain unmarried.

verses.text: They make a habit of going around from home to home doing nothing and helping no one. Not only that, they talk about people behind their backs, stick their noses into places they do not belong, and say things that should not be said.
That is why I want the younger widows to get married, have children, and take good care of their own families. Then the enemy will have nothing to say against them.
For some of the younger widows have already wandered away to follow Accuser (Satan) the evil trickster snake.
verses.html: For some of the younger widows have already wandered away to follow Accuser (Satan) the evil trickster snake.

verses.text: If sacred family members have a widow in the family, let them take her in and care for her. This will lift the burden from the sacred family so the widows who have no family will be cared for.

verses.heading: HONORING THE SPIRITUAL LEADERS / HONORING THE SPIRITUAL LEADERS
verses.text: The elders who are spiritual leaders are to be given double honor—most of all, the ones who work hard at instructing and teaching others.

For our Sacred Teachings tell us, “When an ox is used to harvest corn, do not cover its mouth and keep it from eating,” and “Those who work hard should be given the honor and goods they have worked hard for.”
If someone accuses an elder who is a spiritual leader with wrongdoing, do not listen unless two or three others say the same thing.
Even so, a spiritual leader who continues in wrongdoing must be brought before all of the council of elders for correction as a warning to others.
verses.html: Even so, a spiritual leader who continues in wrongdoing must be brought before all of the council of elders for correction as a warning to others.

verses.heading: MORE WORDS OF WISDOM AND COUNSEL / MORE WORDS OF WISDOM AND COUNSEL
verses.text: With the Great Spirit as my witness, along with Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One and his chief spirit-messengers, I call on you, He Gives Honor (Timothy), to follow my instructions by treating everyone the same and not taking the side of one over another.
verses.html: With the Great Spirit as my witness, along with Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One and his chief spirit-messengers, I call on you, He Gives Honor (Timothy), to follow my instructions by treating everyone the same and not taking the side of one over another.

verses.text: Do not be in a hurry to lay your hands on others to choose them as spiritual leaders. Do not take part in the broken ways of others. Keep yourself pure.
verses.html: Do not be in a hurry to lay your hands on others to choose them as spiritual leaders. Do not take part in the broken ways of others. Keep yourself pure.

verses.text: No longer drink only water, and from now on use a little wine to purify the water. This will be good medicine for the times you have a bad stomach.
verses.html: No longer drink only water, and from now on use a little wine to purify the water. This will be good medicine for the times you have a bad stomach.

verses.text: Some people’s broken ways are plain to see even before their guilt is decided. The guilt of others becomes clear later on.
In the same way, the good deeds of some are clearly seen, and even if they are not clear for all to see, they will not be hidden for long.

verses.heading: INSTRUCTIONS FOR SLAVES / INSTRUCTIONS FOR SLAVES
verses.text: Any sacred family members who are slaves should treat their earthly masters with respect. In this way Creator will not be given a bad reputation, and no one will speak against him or what we teach.
verses.html: Any sacred family members who are slaves should treat their earthly masters with respect. In this way Creator will not be given a bad reputation, and no one will speak against him or what we teach.

verses.text: Those who are slaves to masters who are sacred family members should not for that reason look down on them. Instead, they should serve them all the more, for the ones who benefit from their service are also much-loved sacred family members. Teach and urge others to walk in these ways.

verses.heading: A WARNING ABOUT TROUBLEMAKERS / A WARNING ABOUT TROUBLEMAKERS
verses.text: There are some who teach things that are not in agreement with the good words spoken by our Honored Chief, Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One, and with the teaching that keeps us walking in a sacred way.

Teachers like this think they know it all, but they really understand nothing. There is a sickness in the way they think. They argue over the meaning of words, which takes people down a path of envy, fighting, name-calling, and evil mistrust of each other.

They keep stirring up trouble between people whose minds have wandered away from the truth. They even think that walking in the ways of the Great Spirit is a path to getting more and more possessions.
It is true that following the ways of the Great Spirit will lead to great possessions, but only when people are at peace with what they have.
For we came into this world with nothing and can take nothing with us when we leave it.
So, as long as we have food to eat and a roof over our heads, we should be at peace with what we have.

verses.heading: A WARNING TO THOSE WHO LONG TO BE RICH / A WARNING TO THOSE WHO LONG TO BE RICH
verses.text: Those who long for more and more possessions stumble into temptation and are trapped by many foolish desires that drag them down and take them to a bad end.

For the love of possessions is the root of many evil, thorny branches. Some, who have made possessions their aim in life, have walked away from the good road and have been pierced by thorns that bring them much pain and sorrow.

verses.heading: FIGHT THE GOOD FIGHT OF TRUSTING / FIGHT THE GOOD FIGHT OF TRUSTING
verses.text: But you, O man who follows the Great Spirit, run away from these things and pursue doing what is right, living in a sacred way, trusting, loving, never giving up, and walking softly and in a humble manner.

Fight the good fight of trusting Creator. Get a firm hold on the life of the world to come that never fades away, full of beauty and harmony. The Great Spirit called you to this life when you said yes to him and made it known before many people that you had chosen to walk the good road with Creator Sets Free (Jesus)the Chosen One.
verses.html: Fight the good fight of trusting Creator. Get a firm hold on the life of the world to come that never fades away, full of beauty and harmony. The Great Spirit called you to this life when you said yes to him and made it known before many people that you had chosen to walk the good road with Creator Sets Free (Jesus)the Chosen One.

verses.text: As you stand before the Great Spirit who gives life to all things, and before Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One, who told the truth in a good way when he stood before Spear of the Great Waters (Pilate), I call on you

to follow through with this way of life to which he has called you. Keep walking a path that no one can find fault with until the day comes when our Honored Chief, Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One, will appear.

verses.heading: THE GRAND CHIEF ABOVE ALL CHIEFS / THE GRAND CHIEF ABOVE ALL CHIEFS
verses.text: That day will be revealed when the time is right by the Blessed One who alone rules above all others, the Grand Chief Above All Chiefs.

He is the only one over whom death has no power. His life shines so bright no one can even come near him, and no human eye has ever been able to fully see him. To him belongs all honor and power to the time beyond the end of all days. Aho! May it be so!
verses.html: He is the only one over whom death has no power. His life shines so bright no one can even come near him, and no human eye has ever been able to fully see him. To him belongs all honor and power to the time beyond the end of all days. Aho! May it be so!

verses.heading: FOR THOSE WHO HAVE MANY POSSESSIONS / FOR THOSE WHO HAVE MANY POSSESSIONS
verses.text: Instruct the ones who have many possessions in this present world not to see themselves as better than others. They must not put their hope in their many possessions, which cannot be depended on, but in the Great Spirit, who, from his great possessions, provides all we need to enjoy life.
Instruct them to walk in a good way, to possess many good deeds, and to be willing and ready to share with those in need.
verses.html: Instruct them to walk in a good way, to possess many good deeds, and to be willing and ready to share with those in need.

verses.text: In this way, they will be storing up and preparing themselves for the life of the world to come, the true life of beauty and harmony that never grows old or fades away.
verses.html: In this way, they will be storing up and preparing themselves for the life of the world to come, the true life of beauty and harmony that never grows old or fades away.

verses.heading: CLOSING WORDS / CLOSING WORDS
verses.text: O He Gives Honor (Timothy), keep a close watch over the things that you have been entrusted with. Turn away from foolish and empty talk and arguments about what is falsely called knowledge.

For there are some who, having held this “knowledge” to be true, have strayed away from the good road in which we trust. May the gift of Creator’s great kindness walk with you on the road of life. Aho! May it be so!
verses.html:
For there are some who, having held this “knowledge” to be true, have strayed away from the good road in which we trust. May the gift of Creator’s great kindness walk with you on the road of life.
Aho! May it be so!

verses.heading: GREETINGS / GREETINGS
verses.text: From Small Man (Paul), a message bearer for Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One. The Great Spirit chose me to be a message bearer in harmony with the life he has promised through Creator Sets Free (Jesus) our Honored Chief.

To He Gives Honor (Timothy), my much-loved spiritual son. I greet you with the gift of Creator’s great kindness, mercy, and peace that comes from our Father the Great Spirit and from Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One, our Honored Chief.
verses.html: To He Gives Honor (Timothy), my much-loved spiritual son. I greet you with the gift of Creator’s great kindness, mercy, and peace that comes from our Father the Great Spirit and from Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One, our Honored Chief.

verses.heading: NIGHT-AND-DAY PRAYER / NIGHT-AND-DAY PRAYER
verses.text: When I send my voice to the Great Spirit, I speak your name before him as I give thanks to him night and day. I serve Creator with a pure heart, doing what I know deep inside to be good and right, just as my ancestors did.
Oh how I long to see you! I look back on your tears, which makes me want to see you again so that my heart will dance for joy.

verses.heading: FAN INTO FLAME CREATOR’S GIFT / FAN INTO FLAME CREATOR’S GIFT
verses.text: I remember how deep your faith truly is. That faith was alive first in your grandmother Woman Who Walks with Kindness (Lois), then in your mother Woman Who Wins (Eunice). I know that this same faith lives in you as well.
This is why I now remind you to fan into flame the gift Creator gave you when I laid my hands on you as you were set in place as a spiritual leader.
verses.html: This is why I now remind you to fan into flame the gift Creator gave you when I laid my hands on you as you were set in place as a spiritual leader.

verses.text: Creator has not given us a timid spirit but one of power, love, and clear thinking.

verses.heading: DEATH DEFEATED / DEATH DEFEATED
verses.text: So do not be timid in telling others about our Honored Chief or that I am in prison because of him. But walk with me on this road of suffering for the sake of the good story as Creator gives us strength.

For he is the one who has made us whole and called us to walk a sacred path. He did not choose us because of any good thing we have done. He chose us in harmony with his own purpose and by the gift of his great kindness. This gift was given to us through Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One before time began.

But now that the Chosen One has appeared, his purpose has been made clear. For he has defeated death and has, through the good story, brought into the light the kind of life that will never again taste death.

verses.heading: NOT ASHAMED / NOT ASHAMED
verses.text: He chose me to be a message bearer and a wisdomkeeper so I could make this good story known to all.

This is the reason I walk a path of hardship and suffering. But I am not ashamed, for I know the one in whom I have put my trust. I am sure that he will watch over me as I walk this sacred path toward that day.
Hold true to the words of good medicine you have heard from me, for they came from the trust and love found in Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One.
Watch over these sacred truths by the Holy Spirit who lives in us.

verses.heading: BETRAYAL AND COURAGE / BETRAYAL AND COURAGE
verses.text: As you know, almost everyone in Land of the Rising Sun (Asia) turned away from me, along with Man Who Runs Away (Phygelus) and Born with Good Luck (Hermogenes).
verses.html: As you know, almost everyone in Land of the Rising Sun (Asia) turned away from me, along with Man Who Runs Away (Phygelus) and Born with Good Luck (Hermogenes).

verses.text: May our Honored Chief show kindness to the family of Bringer of Good Things (Onesiphorus), for he was like a drink of cool water to me and was never ashamed to visit me in prison.
When he was in Village of Iron (Rome), he searched hard until he found me.
I pray that our Honored Chief will show kindness to him when that day comes. For you know very well the many ways he helped me at Village of Desire (Ephesus).
So then, my spiritual son, let the gift of great kindness from Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One be your strength.
verses.html: So then, my spiritual son, let the gift of great kindness from Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One be your strength.

verses.text: You have heard the things I have spoken of as we sat together with many others who heard the same things. Pass these teachings on to those who can be trusted to teach the same to others.
verses.html: You have heard the things I have spoken of as we sat together with many others who heard the same things. Pass these teachings on to those who can be trusted to teach the same to others.

verses.heading: STAND STRONG / STAND STRONG
verses.text: Walk with me on this path of suffering as a good spiritual warrior of Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One.
verses.html: Walk with me on this path of suffering as a good spiritual warrior of Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One.

verses.text: During times of war, no warrior gets involved in everyday life, for he must please the war-chief who chose him.
Those who run in a race must follow the rules in order to win.
The one who works hard to plant a field should be the first to share in the harvest.
Think about what I am saying, and our Honored Chief will help you to understand these things.
Keep your thoughts centered on Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One, who was raised from the dead and is a descendant of Chief Much Loved One (David). This is the good story that I tell.
verses.html: Keep your thoughts centered on Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One, who was raised from the dead and is a descendant of Chief Much Loved One (David). This is the good story that I tell.

verses.text: It has taken me down a troubled path, one that includes being put in chains as an outlaw. But Creator’s message can never be locked up.

So I keep walking through these troubled times for the sake of the ones whom the Great Spirit has chosen as his own. I want them to be set free and made whole through Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One and be honored with him to the time beyond the end of all days.

verses.heading: A VERY WISE SAYING / A VERY WISE SAYING
verses.text: Here is a wise saying you can fully trust: If we died with him, we will live with him.
If we never give up, we will share in his chiefly rule. If we deny him, he will deny us.
If we fail to trust him, he will remain faithful, for he cannot deny himself.

Keep reminding others about these things. Warn them in the sight of the Great Spirit not to fight over the meaning of words, for these are empty arguments that only bring a bad end to those who listen.
Make it your aim to present yourself to Creator as one who is tried and true, a hard worker, without shame, who guides Creator’s message of truth down a straight path.

verses.heading: WORTHLESS AND EMPTY TALK / WORTHLESS AND EMPTY TALK
verses.text: Turn away from worthless and empty talk, for it will take people down a path far away from what is sacred and pure.
Talk like this will spread like a disease that eats away at the body. Sings with a Glad Heart (Hymenaeus) and Friendly Man (Philetus) are two men who have been talking like this.
They have turned away from the truth, saying that the rising of the dead has already taken place, harming the faith of some.

But the solid rock of Creator’s truth stands firm. Carved into it are these words: “Our Honored Chief knows the ones who belong to him,” and “All those who say they honor his name must turn away from all wrongdoing.”

verses.heading: VESSELS OF HONOR AND DISHONOR / VESSELS OF HONOR AND DISHONOR
verses.text: In a great lodge there are not only vessels made of gold and silver but also pots made of wood and clay. Some are for special use and others for ordinary use. This is true in the lodge that is Creator’s sacred family.
verses.html: In a great lodge there are not only vessels made of gold and silver but also pots made of wood and clay. Some are for special use and others for ordinary use. This is true in the lodge that is Creator’s sacred family.

verses.text: Those who wash themselves clean from these worthless ways will be vessels of honor, made holy for the Headman’s use and ready to do many good deeds.
So flee from youthful desires and pursue right living, trusting, love, and peace, along with all who call out to our Honored Chief from a pure heart.
Have nothing to do with foolish and ignorant disputes, knowing that they stir up further arguments.
For Creator’s sacred servant must not be eager to argue but kind to all. He must also be a good and patient teacher,
humbly instructing those who stand against him. For it could be that Creator will return them to the right way of thinking and lead them back to the path of truth.
Then they will come to their senses and escape the trap of the evil trickster, who held them captive to serve his purposes.

verses.heading: WARNINGS ABOUT THE LAST DAYS / WARNINGS ABOUT THE LAST DAYS
verses.text: I want you to remember that the last days will be violent and dangerous times.
People will love only themselves and possessions. They will be puffed up, big-headed, troublemakers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, and unspiritual.
People will be cold-hearted, merciless, full of accusations, without self-control, savage, and haters of what is good.
They will be traitors, reckless and arrogant people who love pleasure more than they love the Great Spirit.
Stay clear of people like this, for they make a big show of being spiritual but deny its true power.
verses.html: Stay clear of people like this, for they make a big show of being spiritual but deny its true power.

verses.text: Some of these are men who trick their way into people’s families to manipulate vulnerable women who have given themselves over to broken ways to be burdened down with all kinds of evil desires.
They are always looking to learn new things but never able to find and understand the truth.

In the same way that Greedy Man (Jannes) and Hostile Man (Jambres) stood against Drawn from the Water (Moses), these men also stand against the truth. They are men of bent and twisted minds, whose understanding of our spiritual ways is worthless.
But they will not fool many, for their trickery will be easy to see, just as it was for Greedy Man (Jannes) and Hostile Man (Jambres).

verses.heading: SMALL MAN’S WALK OF SUFFERING / SMALL MAN’S WALK OF SUFFERING
verses.text: But you, He Gives Honor (Timothy), have followed my teachings, my way of life, my purpose, and what I believe. You know how patient I am, how much I love others, and how I have never given up.
verses.html: But you, He Gives Honor (Timothy), have followed my teachings, my way of life, my purpose, and what I believe. You know how patient I am, how much I love others, and how I have never given up.

verses.text: You also know how much I suffered when I was at Stands Against (Antioch), Spirit Village (Iconium), and Set Free (Lystra), how they hunted me down to bring harm to me. But our Honored Chief rescued me in each of those places.
It is a true saying that all who want to live their lives in harmony with Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One will suffer harm at the hands of those who stand against him.

verses.heading: SACRED TEACHINGS WILL MAKE YOU WISE / SACRED TEACHINGS WILL MAKE YOU WISE
verses.text: Bad-hearted people will go from bad to worse. These are humans behaving like tricksters who lead people down the same kind of path they have been tricked into walking.
But you should keep following the ways you have been taught, the teachings you are sure of, for you know who it was who taught you.

From the time you were a young boy you have known the Sacred Teachings that are able to make you wise as you trust in the one who has set you free and made you whole, Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One.

All the Sacred Teachings come from the breath of the Great Spirit and help us to teach others about Creator’s ways. They help us correct wrong thinking and bring lives into balance. They show the good and right way to walk the road of life.
In this way, those who walk with the Great Spirit will have everything that is needed to do good things for others.

verses.heading: MAKE HIS MESSAGE KNOWN / MAKE HIS MESSAGE KNOWN
verses.text: When the Chosen One appears, he will decide the fate of the living and the dead and bring his good road to us in all its fullness. In light of these things and in the sight of the Great Spirit and Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One, I call on you to complete the sacred task
of making his message known! Be ready whether the time seems right or not. Patiently instruct others. Give strong counsel, warnings, and firm words to strengthen their hearts.
For a day will come when people will not listen to good teaching. They will gather around themselves teachers who will tell them what their itching ears want to hear.
They will turn their ears away from the truth and believe made-up stories.

verses.heading: BE A GOOD STORYTELLER / BE A GOOD STORYTELLER
verses.text: But you must remain clear-minded in every way, stand strong in hard times, and do the work of a good storyteller. Keep doing what Creator has called on you to do.
For my life is already being poured out like a ceremonial drink offering, and the time for me to walk on has come.
verses.html: For my life is already being poured out like a ceremonial drink offering, and the time for me to walk on has come.

verses.text: I have fought the good fight. I have walked the good road to its end and stayed true to our spiritual ways.

There is a chief’s headdress for doing what is right waiting for me in the spirit-world above. Our Honored Chief, whose decisions are always right, will honor me with a headdress on that day, and not only me but also all who have loved his appearing.

verses.heading: CLOSING WORDS AND WARNINGS / CLOSING WORDS AND WARNINGS
verses.text: Try to come and see me soon.

For Leader of the People (Demas), because he loved this present world, has run away to village of False Victory (Thessalonica) and left me alone. He Grows More (Crescens) has gone to Land of Pale Skins (Galatia), and Big Man (Titus) to Land of Holy Robes (Dalmatia).
Only Shining Light (Luke) is with me. When you come, bring War Club (Mark) with you, for he is a good help to me as I serve our Creator.
I sent He Is at Ease (Tychicus) to Village of Desire (Ephesus).
And I left my coat at Cut Through (Troas) with He Grows Good Fruit (Carpus). So when you come, bring it to me along with the books, and above all bring the animal-skin scrolls.
Man Fighter (Alexander), who works with copper, did much harm to me. Our Honored Chief will do to him what he has done to hurt others.
Be on the lookout for him, for he stands strongly against all we teach.
At my first council hearing, no one spoke up for me and everyone left me alone. May this not be counted against them.
But Our Honored Chief stood with me and gave me strength, so that through me the Outside Nations would hear the whole good story. I was set free from the mouth of the lion.
Our Honored Chief will rescue me from every evil scheme and carry me safely onto his good road from above. All honor belongs to him to all the ages. Aho! May it be so!

verses.heading: FINAL WORDS / FINAL WORDS
verses.text: I send greetings to Lives Long (Priscilla) and Strong Eagle (Aquila) and to the family of Bringer of Good Things (Onesiphorus).
Much Desired (Erastus) remained behind at Village of Pleasure (Corinth), and He Eats Well (Trophimus) was sick so I left him at White Sheep Wool (Miletus).

Try to come to me before winter. Wise Counselor (Eubulus) sends greetings to you, along with Hides His Face (Pudens), Sweet Grass (Linus), Limping Woman (Claudia), and all the members of the sacred family.
May our Honored Chief be with your spirit, and may the gift of his great kindness rest on you. Aho! May it be so!
verses.html:
May our Honored Chief be with your spirit, and may the gift of his great kindness rest on you.
Aho! May it be so!

verses.heading: GREETINGS / GREETINGS
verses.text: From Small Man (Paul), a sacred servant of the Great Spirit and a message bearer for Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One. I have been sent to strengthen the spiritual ways of Creator’s chosen ones and their understanding of the truth that guides them on this sacred path.
verses.html: From Small Man (Paul), a sacred servant of the Great Spirit and a message bearer for Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One. I have been sent to strengthen the spiritual ways of Creator’s chosen ones and their understanding of the truth that guides them on this sacred path.

verses.text: This way of trusting and understanding rest on the hope of the life of the world to come that never fades away, full of beauty and harmony. It was long ago, before the beginning of time, that the Great Spirit, who always speaks the truth, promised this life to us.
So when the time was right, the Great Spirit, who is our Sacred Deliverer, trusted me with this message and told me to make it known to all who will hear.
verses.html: So when the time was right, the Great Spirit, who is our Sacred Deliverer, trusted me with this message and told me to make it known to all who will hear.

verses.text: To Big Man (Titus), my true son in our spiritual ways. I greet you with the gift of great kindness that comes from our Father the Great Spirit and from Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One, our Sacred Deliverer.

verses.heading: CHOOSING SPIRITUAL LEADERS / CHOOSING SPIRITUAL LEADERS
verses.text: I left you behind at Flesh Eater Island (Crete) so you would finish setting things in order for the sacred family who gathers there and put in place the elders who will be the spiritual leaders in all the villages, just as I have instructed you.
verses.html: I left you behind at Flesh Eater Island (Crete) so you would finish setting things in order for the sacred family who gathers there and put in place the elders who will be the spiritual leaders in all the villages, just as I have instructed you.

verses.text: These spiritual leaders must be free from accusation, faithful in marriage, and have children who are not wild and rebellious, but respectful followers of our spiritual ways.

Because they represent the Great Spirit, the elders who watch over the sacred family must have a good reputation with outsiders. They must not be stubborn, hot-headed, heavy drinkers, violent, or greedy for possessions.
verses.html: Because they represent the Great Spirit, the elders who watch over the sacred family must have a good reputation with outsiders. They must not be stubborn, hot-headed, heavy drinkers, violent, or greedy for possessions.

verses.text: Instead, they must be willing to open their homes to others, love what is good, and think clearly. With self-discipline, they must walk with a good heart in our sacred ways

and stay true to the faithful message they have been taught. Then these elders will be able to encourage others by teaching the truth about our spiritual ways. Then they will be able to stand up to and prove wrong those who oppose them.
verses.html: and stay true to the faithful message they have been taught. Then these elders will be able to encourage others by teaching the truth about our spiritual ways. Then they will be able to stand up to and prove wrong those who oppose them.

verses.heading: A WARNING ABOUT TROUBLEMAKERS / A WARNING ABOUT TROUBLEMAKERS
verses.text: There are many troublemakers with forked tongues and empty words. Most of them are from our own Tribal Members, flesh cutters who require others to participate in the cutting of the flesh ceremony.
verses.html: There are many troublemakers with forked tongues and empty words. Most of them are from our own Tribal Members, flesh cutters who require others to participate in the cutting of the flesh ceremony.

verses.text: These men must be silenced, for they are troubling whole families by teaching wrong things. They are behaving like tricksters using people for their own gain.
One of their own prophets said, “People from Flesh Eater Island (Crete) always speak with forked tongues. They are evil beasts who are lazy and eat too much.”
I have found this to be true of some of them. So speak sharply to them, that they may learn to find health in our spiritual ways.
verses.html: I have found this to be true of some of them. So speak sharply to them, that they may learn to find health in our spiritual ways.

verses.text: Tell them not to listen to made-up stories from our Tribal Members or to instructions from those who are turning away from the truth.

To the pure, all things are pure. But to those who are unclean because they do not believe the truth, nothing is pure, for both in their minds and deep within their hearts they have been made unclean.
They represent themselves as those who know the Great Spirit, but the path they walk proves they do not. They show themselves to be disgusting, rebellious, and worthless for any kind of good deed.

verses.heading: GUIDANCE FOR THE SACRED FAMILY / GUIDANCE FOR THE SACRED FAMILY
verses.text: But as for you, teach those things that lead to a healthy spiritual walk.
Expect the older men to be sober-minded, worthy of respect, and self-disciplined as they walk with firm steps on a path of trust and love.
In the same way, expect the elder women to walk a sacred path. They should not talk in a bad way about others or be heavy drinkers. They should be wisdomkeepers,
teaching young women to love their husbands and their children.

They should show the young women how to be self-disciplined, pure-minded, working at home, kind, and following the loving guidance of their husbands. In this way, they will not bring dishonor to the message of the Great Spirit.
verses.html: They should show the young women how to be self-disciplined, pure-minded, working at home, kind, and following the loving guidance of their husbands. In this way, they will not bring dishonor to the message of the Great Spirit.

verses.text: In the same manner, urge the young men to be self-disciplined in every way.
As for yourself, be an example to them by the good deeds you do, and in the heartfelt and respectful ways you teach.
verses.html: As for yourself, be an example to them by the good deeds you do, and in the heartfelt and respectful ways you teach.

verses.text: Speak with firm words and with an honesty that cannot be spoken against, so that those who oppose will be put to shame, with nothing bad to say about you.
As for those sacred family members who are slaves, teach them to do all that their masters require in a good way, and not to argue
verses.html: As for those sacred family members who are slaves, teach them to do all that their masters require in a good way, and not to argue

verses.text: or steal from them. Instead, they should show that they can be fully trusted. In this way, they will properly show the beauty of the teaching of the Great Spirit, our Sacred Deliverer.

verses.heading: WALKING WITH WISDOM / WALKING WITH WISDOM
verses.text: For the gift of Creator’s great kindness that sets people free has shined its light on all human beings.

It instructs us to turn away from all that does not honor our Creator and from the desire to walk in the ways of this world. It instructs us to walk with straight and firm steps on a good and sacred path in this present world.
For we are looking and waiting for the blessing of the bright-shining appearance of the one who set us free and made us whole—our Great Spirit, Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One.
He paid the highest price to set us free from all our wrongdoings and purify for himself a people whose hearts burn with fire to do good deeds.
So speak out boldly about these things. Strengthen the hearts of the ones who are doing good and set straight the ones who are doing wrong. Let no one ignore you.

verses.heading: MORE GUIDANCE AND WISDOM / MORE GUIDANCE AND WISDOM
verses.text: Remind the sacred family members to give way to the powers and authorities that rule the land. They must follow their laws and be ready to do any good deed.
verses.html: Remind the sacred family members to give way to the powers and authorities that rule the land. They must follow their laws and be ready to do any good deed.

verses.text: Make sure they do not speak evil of anyone. Instead, they should be peacemakers who are gentle and humble toward all people.

For it was not that long ago that we were also foolish and misled rebels who let our evil desires rule over us. Some of us were even bad-hearted, jealous troublemakers, hated by others and hating each other.
But then the kindness of the Great Spirit who sets us free and makes us whole appeared, along with his love for all human beings.
verses.html: But then the kindness of the Great Spirit who sets us free and makes us whole appeared, along with his love for all human beings.

verses.text: He set us free from our bad hearts and broken ways, not because of any good thing we did to deserve this, but because in his love he took pity on us. He set us free by the washing that birthed us into a new life through the power of the Holy Spirit.
verses.html: He set us free from our bad hearts and broken ways, not because of any good thing we did to deserve this, but because in his love he took pity on us. He set us free by the washing that birthed us into a new life through the power of the Holy Spirit.

verses.text: Creator freely rained down his Spirit on us through Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One, our Sacred Deliverer.
verses.html: Creator freely rained down his Spirit on us through Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One, our Sacred Deliverer.

verses.text: We have been given good standing by his great kindness, so that we now can have our share in the hope of the life of the world to come that never fades away, full of beauty and harmony.

verses.heading: STAY AWAY FROM FOOLISH ARGUMENTS / STAY AWAY FROM FOOLISH ARGUMENTS
verses.text: You can be sure that the things I have told you are true and good and helpful for everyone. I want you to speak boldly about these things, so that those who trust in Creator will give themselves to doing good things for others.
But stay away from foolish arguments about ancestors, from things that cause division, and from conflicts about our tribal law. Arguments like these are worthless and will not help anyone.
If anyone among you keeps stirring up division, warn him once, then a second time. After that have nothing more to do with him.
For you know that people like this are walking in broken and twisted ways that show how guilty they are.

verses.heading: FINAL WORDS / FINAL WORDS
verses.text: After I send Free from Harm (Artemas) or He Is at Ease (Tychicus) to you, make it your aim to come to me at Village of Victory (Nicopolis). I have decided to stay there for the winter.
Do all you can to give traveling help to Counsel Giver (Zenas), who is an expert in tribal law, and He Tears Down (Apollos), so they will have all they need.
Our sacred family members must learn to give themselves to doing good for others when they are in need. In this way, they will not fail to bear good fruit in their lives.
verses.html: Our sacred family members must learn to give themselves to doing good for others when they are in need. In this way, they will not fail to bear good fruit in their lives.

verses.text: All who are with me send greetings to you. Pass on our greetings to all who share our deep friendship in our spiritual ways. May the gift of Creator’s great kindness rest on all of you. Aho! May it be so!
verses.html:
All who are with me send greetings to you. Pass on our greetings to all who share our deep friendship in our spiritual ways. May the gift of Creator’s great kindness rest on all of you.
Aho! May it be so!

verses.heading: GREETINGS / GREETINGS
verses.text: From Small Man (Paul), a prisoner of Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One, and from He Gives Honor (Timothy) our spiritual brother. To He Shows Kindness (Philemon), our much-loved friend who works side by side with us as we walk the good road.
verses.html:
From Small Man (Paul), a prisoner of Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One, and from He Gives Honor (Timothy) our spiritual brother.
To He Shows Kindness (Philemon), our much-loved friend who works side by side with us as we walk the good road.

verses.text: And also to our spiritual sister Protected One (Apphia), to Horse Chief (Archippus) our fellow warrior, and to all the sacred family members who gather for ceremony at your house.
verses.html: And also to our spiritual sister Protected One (Apphia), to Horse Chief (Archippus) our fellow warrior, and to all the sacred family members who gather for ceremony at your house.

verses.text: I greet you with peace and the gift of great kindness that comes from our Father the Great Spirit and from our Honored Chief, Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One.

verses.heading: SENDING UP PRAYERS / SENDING UP PRAYERS
verses.text: When I send my voice to the Great Spirit, I always remember to thank him for you.
For I keep hearing about the trust you have toward our Honored Chief Creator Sets Free (Jesus) and the love you have for all his holy ones.
I pray that as you share with others the trust you have in the Chosen One, your understanding of all the good things we have in him will keep growing deeper and stronger.
verses.html: I pray that as you share with others the trust you have in the Chosen One, your understanding of all the good things we have in him will keep growing deeper and stronger.

verses.text: The love you have shown toward others, my much-loved spiritual brother, has encouraged me and made my heart glad and has refreshed the hearts of Creator’s holy ones.
verses.html: The love you have shown toward others, my much-loved spiritual brother, has encouraged me and made my heart glad and has refreshed the hearts of Creator’s holy ones.

verses.heading: A PERSONAL REQUEST / A PERSONAL REQUEST
verses.text: I have the freedom in the Chosen One to boldly order you to do the right thing,
but instead, I am asking for your help out of love. I ask as Small Man (Paul), your elder, who is a prisoner because of Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One.
I call on you for the sake of He Is Helpful (Onesimus) my spiritual child, to whom I have become a spiritual father while in prison.
verses.html: I call on you for the sake of He Is Helpful (Onesimus) my spiritual child, to whom I have become a spiritual father while in prison.

verses.text: In the past he was not helpful to you, but he has now become helpful to both you and me.
I am now sending him back to you, and with him I send my own heart.
I would have liked to keep him here with me, so that while I am in prison for telling the good story he would take your place in serving me.
But I do not want to do anything unless you agree to it. In this way, you will help me willingly and not because you think you must.
It may be that he was away from you for a little while so he can remain with you from now on.

Treat him not as a slave, but as more than your slave—treat him as a much-loved spiritual brother. If he is loved by me in this way, he should be loved all the more by you, both as a human being and as one who belongs to our Honored Chief.
verses.html: Treat him not as a slave, but as more than your slave—treat him as a much-loved spiritual brother. If he is loved by me in this way, he should be loved all the more by you, both as a human being and as one who belongs to our Honored Chief.

verses.text: So if you think of me as a fellow traveler on the good road, then welcome him the same way you would welcome me.
If he has done you any wrong or owes you anything, tell me how much is owed and I will make it right.
I, Small Man (Paul), write this with my own hand—I will pay what is owed. But must I remind you that you owe me your whole life as well?
Yes, I am asking you to do this for me as a brother in the family of our Honored Chief. Then you will make this old heart glad in the Chosen One.

verses.heading: FINAL WORDS / FINAL WORDS
verses.text: I write this letter to you knowing you will do all I have asked and much more.
I also ask you to get a guest room ready for me, for my hope is that through your prayers I will be given back to you.
Walks in Beauty (Epaphras), my fellow prisoner in Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One, sends his greetings to you,
along with War Club (Mark), Good Chief (Aristarchus), Leader of the People (Demas), and Shining Light (Luke), who work side by side with me.
May the gift of great kindness that comes from our Honored Chief, Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One, be with your spirit. Aho! May it be so!
verses.html:
May the gift of great kindness that comes from our Honored Chief, Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One, be with your spirit.
Aho! May it be so!

verses.heading: THE GREAT SPIRIT SPEAKS THROUGH HIS SON / THE GREAT SPIRIT SPEAKS THROUGH HIS SON
verses.text: Long ago, in many ways and at many times, the Great Spirit spoke to our tribal ancestors through the prophets.

But now, in these last days, he has spoken to us through his Son—the one he has chosen to give all things to. It is through his Son that the Great Spirit made the world that is, the world that was, and the one that is coming.

This Son is the light coming from the face of the Great Spirit in all its bright-shining beauty. What is true about the Great Spirit is true about the Son, for he represents Creator in every way. It is his powerful word that holds the stars above, the earth below, and all things seen and unseen in their place. He came into this world to purify the bad hearts and broken ways of all people. When he was finished, he returned to the One Above Us All to sit in the place of greatest honor at the right hand of the Great Mystery.
verses.html: This Son is the light coming from the face of the Great Spirit in all its bright-shining beauty. What is true about the Great Spirit is true about the Son, for he represents Creator in every way. It is his powerful word that holds the stars above, the earth below, and all things seen and unseen in their place. He came into this world to purify the bad hearts and broken ways of all people. When he was finished, he returned to the One Above Us All to sit in the place of greatest honor at the right hand of the Great Mystery.

verses.heading: GREATER THAN SPIRIT-MESSENGERS / GREATER THAN SPIRIT-MESSENGERS
verses.text: The Son was lifted up to a higher place than all the spirit-messengers, for the name that he was given has much more beauty and honor than theirs.
For did the Great Spirit ever say to a spirit-messenger, “You are my Son. Today I make it known that I am your Father”? Or again, “I will be a Father to him, and he will be a Son to me”?
And again, when the Great Spirit was about to bring his honored Son into the world above, he said, “Let all of Creator’s spirit-messengers honor and serve him.”
verses.html: And again, when the Great Spirit was about to bring his honored Son into the world above, he said, “Let all of Creator’s spirit-messengers honor and serve him.”

verses.text: When speaking of his spirit-messengers the Sacred Teachings tell us, “He makes the winds his spirit-messengers, and flames of fire to be his servants.”

But when speaking of the Son the Sacred Teachings tell us, “O Great Spirit, your seat of honor will last beyond the end of all days. Your chief’s staff is your walking stick on the good road where you make wrongs right again.
You love right ways and hate wrong ways. So the Great Spirit, your Creator, has chosen you to be a Chief, by pouring the oil of joy on you, honoring you more than all who walk the road with you.”
Our Sacred Teachings have also said of the Son, “O Honored Chief, in the beginning it was you who formed the earth and sky.
verses.html: Our Sacred Teachings have also said of the Son, “O Honored Chief, in the beginning it was you who formed the earth and sky.

verses.text: They will fade away, but you will live on. They will become old, and you will roll them up like a worn-out blanket. You will take them off like old, ragged clothes. But you remain the same, and your years will never come to an end.”
Has the Great Spirit said this to any spirit-messenger, “Sit down beside me at my right hand, my place of greatest honor, until I defeat your enemies and humble them before you”?
Are not all spirit-messengers spirits who have been sent out with the sacred task of serving those who will share in the blessings of being set free and made whole?

verses.heading: WALKING WITH FIRM STEPS / WALKING WITH FIRM STEPS
verses.text: This is the reason we, who are followers of the Chosen One, must walk with firm steps, holding true to what we have heard, so we will not wander away from the good road.
verses.html: This is the reason we, who are followers of the Chosen One, must walk with firm steps, holding true to what we have heard, so we will not wander away from the good road.

verses.text: For if the message of our tribal law, spoken to us by spirit-messengers, has always stood firm, and every failure to walk in that law was given the punishment deserved,
verses.html: For if the message of our tribal law, spoken to us by spirit-messengers, has always stood firm, and every failure to walk in that law was given the punishment deserved,

verses.text: how will we escape if we do not honor such a great and powerful way to be set free and made whole? It was our Honored Chief Creator Sets Free (Jesus) himself who first spoke about this. Then those who heard him clearly passed on to us what they heard.
The Great Spirit also confirmed the truth of what they were saying with many signs, wonders, and works of power. He also gave them gifts of the Holy Spirit in harmony with his desire.

verses.heading: WHY CARE ABOUT HUMAN BEINGS? / WHY CARE ABOUT HUMAN BEINGS?
verses.text: The Great Spirit did not put the world that is coming, which we will now speak about, under the guidance of spirit-messengers.
Instead, somewhere in our Sacred Teachings it has been said, “O Great Spirit, why do you think so much of humanity? Why do you watch over human beings so carefully?
verses.html: Instead, somewhere in our Sacred Teachings it has been said, “O Great Spirit, why do you think so much of humanity? Why do you watch over human beings so carefully?

verses.text: For a short time you made them a little lower than the spirit-messengers. You placed a headdress of honor on their heads

and made them the caretakers over all things.” When Creator gave human beings the sacred calling of being the caretakers over all things, he left nothing that was not under their care. But we still do not see all things under the care of humankind.

verses.heading: THE TRUE HUMAN BEING / THE TRUE HUMAN BEING
verses.text: But we can see that there is one human being who has taken on himself this sacred calling—Creator Sets Free (Jesus). For a short time he was made a little lower than the spirit-messengers so that by the gift of Creator’s great kindness, he might taste death for everyone. Because he did this, he has been highly honored with the headdress of a chief.
verses.html: But we can see that there is one human being who has taken on himself this sacred calling—Creator Sets Free (Jesus). For a short time he was made a little lower than the spirit-messengers so that by the gift of Creator’s great kindness, he might taste death for everyone. Because he did this, he has been highly honored with the headdress of a chief.

verses.text: The Great Spirit is the maker and upholder of all things. So it was only right that he would be the one to lift his children back up to the honored place for which he created them. The one who would blaze the trail before them had to suffer, so he would be fully prepared to set them free and make them whole.
Creator Sets Free (Jesus) is the one who makes people holy, and those he makes holy are all from one Father. For this reason he is not ashamed to call them his family.
verses.html: Creator Sets Free (Jesus) is the one who makes people holy, and those he makes holy are all from one Father. For this reason he is not ashamed to call them his family.

verses.text: For Creator Sets Free (Jesus) speaks to us through our Sacred Teachings, saying, “O Great Spirit, I will honor your name before my brothers and sisters. I will sing sacred songs to you when we gather as a sacred family.”
verses.html: For Creator Sets Free (Jesus) speaks to us through our Sacred Teachings, saying, “O Great Spirit, I will honor your name before my brothers and sisters. I will sing sacred songs to you when we gather as a sacred family.”

verses.text: He also says, “I will trust in the Great Spirit.” And again he says, “Behold! Here I am standing side-by-side with the brothers and sisters of the sacred family Creator has given to me.”
verses.html: He also says, “I will trust in the Great Spirit.” And again he says, “Behold! Here I am standing side-by-side with the brothers and sisters of the sacred family Creator has given to me.”

verses.text: So then, since these brothers and sisters all share in what it means to be weak human beings, he also became a weak human being just like them. He did this so that by dying he would bring an end to the one who holds the power of death—the evil trickster.
He died to set all people free who have lived their lives as slaves to the evil trickster because of their fear of death.
verses.html: He died to set all people free who have lived their lives as slaves to the evil trickster because of their fear of death.

verses.text: It is clear that he did not come for spirit-messengers, but he came to set free the descendants of Father of Many Nations (Abraham).

I am saying that Creator Sets Free (Jesus) needed to become fully and truly human. In this way, he could serve as Creator’s honorable and merciful chief holy man and perform the ancient mercy-seat ceremony one last time to heal the bad hearts and broken ways of the people.
verses.html: I am saying that Creator Sets Free (Jesus) needed to become fully and truly human. In this way, he could serve as Creator’s honorable and merciful chief holy man and perform the ancient mercy-seat ceremony one last time to heal the bad hearts and broken ways of the people.

verses.text: Since Creator Sets Free (Jesus) suffered temptation, he is able to help all who are being tempted. The tribes of Wrestles with Creator (Israel) were given this mercy-seat ceremony to show that the Great Spirit had washed them clean from their bad hearts and broken ways. Once a year the chief holy man would take the blood of a ceremonial animal into the Most Holy Place in Creator’s sacred lodge and sprinkle the blood onto the lid of a wooden box covered with gold. The lid of this wooden box was called the mercy seat.
verses.html:
Since Creator Sets Free (Jesus) suffered temptation, he is able to help all who are being tempted.
The tribes of Wrestles with Creator (Israel) were given this mercy-seat ceremony to show that the Great Spirit had washed them clean from their bad hearts and broken ways. Once a year the chief holy man would take the blood of a ceremonial animal into the Most Holy Place in Creator’s sacred lodge and sprinkle the blood onto the lid of a wooden box covered with gold. The lid of this wooden box was called the mercy seat.

verses.heading: A NEW AND GREATER CHIEF HOLY MAN / A NEW AND GREATER CHIEF HOLY MAN
verses.text: So then, my sacred family members, you who share in Creator’s high calling, take a good look at Creator Sets Free (Jesus). He is the great message bearer and chief holy man of our spiritual ways.
verses.html: So then, my sacred family members, you who share in Creator’s high calling, take a good look at Creator Sets Free (Jesus). He is the great message bearer and chief holy man of our spiritual ways.

verses.text: He stayed true to the purpose for which he was chosen, just as Drawn from the Water (Moses) stayed true to serving the people of Creator’s lodge.
But Creator Sets Free (Jesus) has been given greater honor than Drawn from the Water (Moses), just as the maker of a lodge is given more honor than the lodge itself.
Now every lodge has a builder, but the builder and maker of all things is the Great Spirit.
Drawn from the Water (Moses), as Creator’s family servant, stayed true to Creator’s family. He was a truth teller who prophesied about what would be said in the last days.
But the Chosen One is Creator’s own Son, the headman who stayed true to the people of Creator’s lodge, and we are his people if we keep holding firmly and honorably to our hope in him.
verses.html: But the Chosen One is Creator’s own Son, the headman who stayed true to the people of Creator’s lodge, and we are his people if we keep holding firmly and honorably to our hope in him.

verses.heading: CREATOR’S PLACE OF REST / CREATOR’S PLACE OF REST
verses.text: So then, we should do what the Holy Spirit, through our Sacred Teachings, tells us. He says, “Today, when you hear his voice

do not harden your hearts as your ancestors did when they turned away from me and put me to the test in the desert wilderness. It was there that they tested my patience and saw the powerful things I did for forty winters.
I became angry with them and said, ‘You are a people with wandering hearts who have not learned my ways.’
Then in my great anger, I made a solemn promise that they would not enter my place of rest.”
verses.html: Then in my great anger, I made a solemn promise that they would not enter my place of rest.”

verses.text: So then, my sacred family members, make sure none of you have wandering hearts that fail to trust, hearts that turn you away from our living Creator.
Speak courage to each other every day, as long as it is still called “today,” so that no one’s heart will grow hard and be led astray by broken ways.
As long as we keep walking this road with firm steps from beginning to end, we will share in all the blessings of the Chosen One.
The Sacred Teachings tell us, “Today, when you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts as your ancestors did when they turned away from me and put me to the test.”
Who were these people who heard Creator’s voice and turned away from him? Was it not all of those who followed Drawn from the Water (Moses) out from Black Land (Egypt)?
And who was it who angered the Great Spirit for forty winters? Was it not the ones who followed their bad hearts and broken ways, whose dead bodies lay scattered across the desert?
And to whom did Creator make the solemn promise that they would not enter into his rest? It was to the ones who did not trust him and do what he said.
So we can see that our tribal ancestors did not enter into Creator’s place of rest because they failed to trust him.
verses.html: So we can see that our tribal ancestors did not enter into Creator’s place of rest because they failed to trust him.

verses.heading: THE PROMISE OF REST REMAINS OPEN / THE PROMISE OF REST REMAINS OPEN
verses.text: So then, my sacred family members, since the promise of entering into Creator’s place of rest still remains open, we must take care that none of you would fail to enter into this promised rest.
verses.html: So then, my sacred family members, since the promise of entering into Creator’s place of rest still remains open, we must take care that none of you would fail to enter into this promised rest.

verses.text: For this good message has been told to us, just as it was told to our tribal ancestors. But the message they heard did them no good, because they failed to put their trust in the one who gave them the promise.

So then, we are the ones who will enter into this promised rest, but only if we keep trusting in the Great Spirit. For he said, “In my great anger, I made a solemn promise that they would not enter my place of rest.” He said this, even though his work was finished from the time the world was formed.
verses.html: So then, we are the ones who will enter into this promised rest, but only if we keep trusting in the Great Spirit. For he said, “In my great anger, I made a solemn promise that they would not enter my place of rest.” He said this, even though his work was finished from the time the world was formed.

verses.text: As for the seventh day, it has been said in the Sacred Teachings, “The Great Spirit rested on the seventh day from all his work.”
And again as he already said, “They will never enter into my rest.”
This shows us that there are still some who will enter his rest. Since those who first heard this good message did not enter because they failed to trust,

many winters later Creator chooses another day and calls it “today,” as he speaks through the mouth of Much Loved One (David) and says again, “Today, when you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts.”
verses.html: many winters later Creator chooses another day and calls it “today,” as he speaks through the mouth of Much Loved One (David) and says again, “Today, when you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts.”

verses.text: If Creator Gives Freedom (Joshua) had led our ancestors into their place of rest, then Creator would not have spoken through Chief Much Loved One (David) of another day of rest for his people.
verses.html: If Creator Gives Freedom (Joshua) had led our ancestors into their place of rest, then Creator would not have spoken through Chief Much Loved One (David) of another day of rest for his people.

verses.text: There now remains a sacred rest, a true and spiritual Day of Resting, for the people of the Great Spirit.
verses.html: There now remains a sacred rest, a true and spiritual Day of Resting, for the people of the Great Spirit.

verses.text: For just as Creator rested from his work after creating the world, the ones who enter into Creator’s promised rest have also rested from their work.
verses.html: For just as Creator rested from his work after creating the world, the ones who enter into Creator’s promised rest have also rested from their work.

verses.text: So then, let us pour all of our strength into entering Creator’s rest. In this way, no one will stumble away from the path of trusting, like our ancestors did.

verses.heading: CREATOR’S LIVING WORD / CREATOR’S LIVING WORD
verses.text: For the Word of the Great Spirit is alive, powerful, and sharper than any two-edged long knife. His Word cuts deep into the inner being, separating soul from spirit and joints from marrow. His Word uncovers the true nature of the human heart, its thoughts and intentions.
Not one thing in all creation is hidden from his sight. All things are stripped bare before the eyes of the one to whom we must give an answer for how we have walked on this earth.
verses.html: Not one thing in all creation is hidden from his sight. All things are stripped bare before the eyes of the one to whom we must give an answer for how we have walked on this earth.

verses.heading: A NEW CHIEF HOLY MAN / A NEW CHIEF HOLY MAN
verses.text: Seeing that we are served by such a great chief holy man who has walked the road of the spirit-world above, Creator Sets Free (Jesus), the Son of the Great Spirit, let us walk true to this way of life in which we have put our trust.
For we do not have a chief holy man who is unable to feel the same kind of pain and sorrow we feel. Even though he faced the same temptations we face, he never gave in to them or did anything wrong.
So with brave hearts let us come before Creator’s seat of honor to receive mercy and the gift of his great kindness to help us in our time of need.

verses.heading: HOW A CHIEF HOLY MAN IS CHOSEN / HOW A CHIEF HOLY MAN IS CHOSEN
verses.text: Among the tribes of Wrestles with Creator (Israel) every chief holy man is chosen from among the men of his tribe. He is given the sacred task of representing the people to the Great Spirit by offering ceremonial gifts and sacrifices for the people’s bad hearts and broken ways.
verses.html: Among the tribes of Wrestles with Creator (Israel) every chief holy man is chosen from among the men of his tribe. He is given the sacred task of representing the people to the Great Spirit by offering ceremonial gifts and sacrifices for the people’s bad hearts and broken ways.

verses.text: Since the chief holy man is also a weak human being, he can take pity on those whose understanding is weak and have lost their way.
And because he is a weak human being, he must first offer sacrifices for his own broken ways and then for the broken ways of the people.
verses.html: And because he is a weak human being, he must first offer sacrifices for his own broken ways and then for the broken ways of the people.

verses.text: No one chooses this honor for himself. It is the Great Spirit who chooses a chief holy man, just as he chose the first chief holy man Light Bearer (Aaron).
verses.html: No one chooses this honor for himself. It is the Great Spirit who chooses a chief holy man, just as he chose the first chief holy man Light Bearer (Aaron).

verses.heading: CHOSEN TO BE A HOLY MAN / CHOSEN TO BE A HOLY MAN
verses.text: In the same way, the Chosen One did not take for himself the honor of being the chief holy man. It was the Great Spirit who chose him by saying to him, “You are my Son. Today I make it known that I am your Father.”
And in another place Creator says to him, “You are a holy man whose days will never end. The same kind of holy man as Chief Who Stands for What Is Right (Melchizedek).”
verses.html: And in another place Creator says to him, “You are a holy man whose days will never end. The same kind of holy man as Chief Who Stands for What Is Right (Melchizedek).”

verses.text: In the days when Creator Sets Free (Jesus) walked among us as a human being, he sent his voice to the Great Spirit with tears and loud cries to the only one who could rescue him from death. His prayers were heard because of the honor and respect he showed to the One Above Us All.
verses.html: In the days when Creator Sets Free (Jesus) walked among us as a human being, he sent his voice to the Great Spirit with tears and loud cries to the only one who could rescue him from death. His prayers were heard because of the honor and respect he showed to the One Above Us All.

verses.text: Even though he was Creator’s Son, he still had to learn, through suffering, what it means to stay true to the ways of the Great Spirit.
verses.html: Even though he was Creator’s Son, he still had to learn, through suffering, what it means to stay true to the ways of the Great Spirit.

verses.text: When he was fully prepared, he became the one through whom all people who listen and do what he says will be set free and made whole, to the time beyond the end of all days.
This is because the Great Spirit chose him to be a chief holy man just like Chief Who Stands for What Is Right (Melchizedek).

verses.heading: SPIRITUAL MILK OR SOLID FOOD / SPIRITUAL MILK OR SOLID FOOD
verses.text: I have much more I would like to say about this, but it is hard to make the meaning clear because your ears have become slow to hear.

By now you should be able to teach others, but instead you need someone to teach you the simple spiritual truths of Creator’s message all over again. You are like children who need milk and are not ready for solid food.
For all those who drink only milk are still like nursing babies who have not yet learned how to walk in right ways.
But solid food is for those who are mature. For the ones who have walked the road many times have learned the difference between what is right and what is wrong.

verses.heading: WALKING TOWARD MATURITY / WALKING TOWARD MATURITY
verses.text: It is time for us to move beyond the beginning spiritual truths of the teachings that prepared the way of the Chosen One and start to see things through more mature eyes. There is no need to go back to the beginning of the trail to learn things all over again. You have already been taught to turn away from meaningless efforts to please the Great Spirit and to simply trust him.
verses.html: It is time for us to move beyond the beginning spiritual truths of the teachings that prepared the way of the Chosen One and start to see things through more mature eyes. There is no need to go back to the beginning of the trail to learn things all over again. You have already been taught to turn away from meaningless efforts to please the Great Spirit and to simply trust him.

verses.text: You have been given instructions about different kinds of ceremonies for purification and for laying on of hands. You have also been taught about the rising of the dead and the final judgment.
verses.html: You have been given instructions about different kinds of ceremonies for purification and for laying on of hands. You have also been taught about the rising of the dead and the final judgment.

verses.text: So then, as the Great Spirit permits, we will now walk forward toward more mature teachings.

verses.heading: WALKING AWAY FROM THE GOOD PATH / WALKING AWAY FROM THE GOOD PATH
verses.text: For there are some who once walked in the light. They tasted the gift that comes from the spirit-world above. They shared together with us in the Holy Spirit.
They tasted Creator’s good word and the powers of the world to come.

If people like this walk away from the path, it is not possible to bring them back. For to their own harm they are nailing the Son of the Great Spirit to the cross again and shaming him before others.
The ground that drinks the rain that often falls on it and grows many plants that are useful for those who work the ground shares in the blessings of the Great Spirit.
But if the ground grows only thorns and thistles, it has failed in its purpose, and will soon be seen as cursed and its crops burned.

verses.heading: BETTER THINGS FOR YOU / BETTER THINGS FOR YOU
verses.text: My much-loved relatives, even though we are speaking in this way, we are sure of much better things about you, the things that come from being set free and made whole.

The Great Spirit will not fail to do what is right. He will not forget how hard you have worked and how much love you have shown in representing him. He sees how you have served his holy ones, in the past and even now.
It is our desire that you walk with firm steps, keeping your eyes straight, as you travel this sure path of hope to its end.
Do not limp along, dragging your feet, but follow firmly in the footsteps of those who through trust and patience share in the promises.
When the Great Spirit made his promise to Father of Many Nations (Abraham), it was a solemn promise. And since there was no one greater to hold him to his promise, he held himself to it.
He said, “I give you my word of honor that I will greatly bless you and give you many descendants.”
So by staying true to the path and never giving up, Father of Many Nations (Abraham) received what had been promised.

verses.heading: A SOLEMN PROMISE FROM THE GREAT SPIRIT / A SOLEMN PROMISE FROM THE GREAT SPIRIT
verses.text: When people give their word of honor and make a solemn promise, they make it before someone who is greater than themselves. This kind of promise brings an end to all disagreements.
The Great Spirit wanted to prove to his people that his promise would remain true and never change, so he made this kind of solemn promise.

The Great Spirit cannot speak with a forked tongue! So his word of honor and his solemn promise are two things that can never be changed. This gives us, the ones who have taken shelter under his wings, brave hearts to take a firm hold on the hope he has set before us.

This hope is like a tent-stake, holding our lives firmly and safely in place. This hope goes behind the blanket that hangs in the sacred lodge and reaches into the Most Holy Place in the spirit-world above. Creator’s sacred lodge on earth had a blanket that separated the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place. This earthly lodge was a symbol of the true sacred lodge in the spirit-world above spoken of here.
verses.html:
This hope is like a tent-stake, holding our lives firmly and safely in place. This hope goes behind the blanket that hangs in the sacred lodge and reaches into the Most Holy Place in the spirit-world above.
Creator’s sacred lodge on earth had a blanket that separated the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place. This earthly lodge was a symbol of the true sacred lodge in the spirit-world above spoken of here.

verses.text: Creator Sets Free (Jesus) is the one who was first to enter into this Most Holy Place in the spirit-world above to open the way for us to follow. For he has been made chief holy man whose days will never end, the same kind of holy man as Chief Who Stands for What Is Right (Melchizedek).

verses.heading: A DIFFERENT KIND OF HOLY MAN / A DIFFERENT KIND OF HOLY MAN
verses.text: Chief Who Stands for What Is Right (Melchizedek) was both the chief of a village named Peace (Salem) and a holy man of Creator Most High. When Father of Many Nations (Abraham) was returning from the battle where he defeated many warring chiefs, Chief Who Stands for What Is Right (Melchizedek) met with him and blessed him.

Then Father of Many Nations (Abraham) gave him a tenth of all the spoils of war. The meaning of the name of Chief Who Stands for What Is Right (Melchizedek) comes first from his being a chief who stands for what is right, and then also from being chief of Salem, which means chief of peace.

There is no record of his father or mother or a family ancestry of any kind. No one knows when his life began or when it ended. In this way, he is like the Son of the Great Spirit, whose place as a holy man continues without end.
Can you see how great this man was? Our ancestor, Father of Many Nations (Abraham), gave him a tenth of the best of the spoils of war!

Our tribal law instructs the descendants of He Brings Together (Levi), who are the holy men of our tribes, to receive a tenth from their own tribal family—even though our tribal family is also descended from Father of Many Nations (Abraham).

But this man, Chief Who Stands for What Is Right (Melchizedek), received a tenth from Father of Many Nations (Abraham), even though he is not descended from He Brings Together (Levi), and he blessed the one to whom the Great Spirit gave the promises.
Everyone knows that the one with the power to bless is greater than the one to whom the blessing is given.
There is another way to see what I am saying. Our tribes pay a tenth to holy men who die, but here a tenth is paid to a holy man who, we are told, continues to live.
verses.html: There is another way to see what I am saying. Our tribes pay a tenth to holy men who die, but here a tenth is paid to a holy man who, we are told, continues to live.

verses.text: It could be said that He Brings Together (Levi), the ancestor of the tribe of holy men who receive a tenth, also paid a tenth through Father of Many Nations (Abraham),
because he was still in the body of his ancestor when Chief Who Stands for What Is Right (Melchizedek) met Father of Many Nations (Abraham).

verses.heading: A NEW KIND OF HOLY MAN AND A NEW LAW / A NEW KIND OF HOLY MAN AND A NEW LAW
verses.text: So then, if Creator’s full purpose was to come through the holy men who are descended from He Brings Together (Levi), for our tribal law was given in harmony with these holy men, why would there be a need for another holy man to appear, one like Chief Who Stands for What Is Right (Melchizedek), instead of one who is descended from Light Bearer (Aaron)?
For if the way to become a holy man has changed, then it means our tribal law must also change.
Now Creator Sets Free (Jesus), the one spoken of here, is not from the tribe that holy men come from. He is from another tribe, and no one from that tribe has ever served at the ceremonial altar.
verses.html: Now Creator Sets Free (Jesus), the one spoken of here, is not from the tribe that holy men come from. He is from another tribe, and no one from that tribe has ever served at the ceremonial altar.

verses.text: We all know that our Honored Chief Creator Sets Free (Jesus) is descended from Give Him Praise (Judah), and Drawn from the Water (Moses) never said anything about holy men coming from that tribe.
verses.html: We all know that our Honored Chief Creator Sets Free (Jesus) is descended from Give Him Praise (Judah), and Drawn from the Water (Moses) never said anything about holy men coming from that tribe.

verses.text: So if another holy man appears, one who is like Chief Who Stands for What Is Right (Melchizedek), it becomes even more clear
that it is the power of a life that can never end that makes him a holy man, not a law about physical ancestry.
For it says in our Sacred Teachings, “You are a holy man whose days will never end, the same kind of holy man as Chief Who Stands for What Is Right (Melchizedek).”
Because it was weak and useless, the former instruction had to be done away with.

For our tribal law could not bring anyone or anything to full meaning and purpose. But the Chosen One has brought to us an even greater hope, and it is this hope that moves us to draw near to the Great Spirit.

Under our tribal law no one was ever made a holy man by a solemn promise. But it was by a solemn promise that the Chosen One was made a holy man, when it was said to him, “The Great Spirit has made a solemn promise and will never change his mind, ‘You are a holy man whose days will never end.’”
In this way, Creator Sets Free (Jesus) has become the promise keeper of a better peace treaty.

verses.heading: A CHIEF HOLY MAN WHO WILL NEVER DIE / A CHIEF HOLY MAN WHO WILL NEVER DIE
verses.text: The holy men who came before were many in number, because death kept them from continuing.
But since Creator Sets Free (Jesus) will never die, his place as a holy man will never come to an end.
This means he is able to fully set free and make whole all who draw near to the Great Spirit through him, since he always lives to pray and represent them in a good way.

This kind of chief holy man is just what we weak human beings need. One who remains holy, blameless and pure. One who differs from weak human beings because he has a good heart with no broken ways. One who has been lifted up to the highest place in the spirit-world above.
