He has no need to make offerings every day like other chief holy men. They make offerings first for their own broken ways, and then for the broken ways of the people. But when Creator Sets Free (Jesus) offered himself on the cross, he performed a ceremony—once for all time—to set people free from their bad hearts and broken ways.
verses.html: He has no need to make offerings every day like other chief holy men. They make offerings first for their own broken ways, and then for the broken ways of the people. But when Creator Sets Free (Jesus) offered himself on the cross, he performed a ceremony—once for all time—to set people free from their bad hearts and broken ways.

verses.text: So you can see that our tribal law chooses weak human beings with broken ways to be chief holy men. But it was a solemn promise, given many winters after our tribal law, that chose the Son of the Great Spirit. His suffering has fully prepared him to be a chief holy man whose days will never end.
verses.html: So you can see that our tribal law chooses weak human beings with broken ways to be chief holy men. But it was a solemn promise, given many winters after our tribal law, that chose the Son of the Great Spirit. His suffering has fully prepared him to be a chief holy man whose days will never end.

verses.heading: THE NEW CHIEF HOLY MAN / THE NEW CHIEF HOLY MAN
verses.text: The heart of what I am saying is that we now have this kind of chief holy man, one who has taken his place in the spirit-world above at the right hand of the seat of honor held by the Great Honored One.
He serves as a holy man in the true sacred tent, the one pitched by our Honored Chief and not by human beings.
Every chief holy man is chosen to offer ceremonial gifts and sacrifices, so our chief holy man must also have something to offer.
Remember, if he were on earth, he would not be a holy man, seeing that there are holy men on earth who offer gifts required by our tribal law.
verses.html: Remember, if he were on earth, he would not be a holy man, seeing that there are holy men on earth who offer gifts required by our tribal law.

verses.text: But these holy men serve in a sacred tent that is only a dim shadow of the one in the spirit-world above. For Drawn from the Water (Moses) was given this counsel by the Great Spirit just before he completed making the sacred tent, “Make sure that everything you make follows the pattern that was shown to you on the mountain.”

verses.heading: A NEW AND BETTER PEACE TREATY / A NEW AND BETTER PEACE TREATY
verses.text: So you can see that the Chosen One has been given a more honorable place as chief holy man than all the others. In the same way, the peace treaty he made for us with the Great Spirit is better than the first one, for it depends on better promises.
For if there had been nothing wrong with the first peace treaty, then there would have been no need to look for a second one.

But finding something wrong, the Great Spirit said to his people, “Behold! The time is coming when I will make a new peace treaty with the northern tribes of Wrestles with Creator (Israel) and the southern tribes of Give Him Praise (Judah).
verses.html: But finding something wrong, the Great Spirit said to his people, “Behold! The time is coming when I will make a new peace treaty with the northern tribes of Wrestles with Creator (Israel) and the southern tribes of Give Him Praise (Judah).

verses.text: This peace treaty will not be like the one I made with their ancestors when I took them by the hand to walk them out of Black Land (Egypt). They did not honor that peace treaty, so I let them go their own way.

“But here is the new peace treaty I will make with the tribes of Wrestles with Creator (Israel) after that time. I will plant my laws in their minds and carve them into their hearts. I will be their Great Spirit, and they will be my people, my sacred family.
verses.html: “But here is the new peace treaty I will make with the tribes of Wrestles with Creator (Israel) after that time. I will plant my laws in their minds and carve them into their hearts. I will be their Great Spirit, and they will be my people, my sacred family.

verses.text: There will be no need to teach others to know their Honored Chief, for all, whether small or great, will know me.
I will take pity on wrongdoers, and their broken ways I will remember no more.”
When Creator tells of a new peace treaty, this means he has done away with the first one—for it is old, worn out, and ready to fade away.

verses.heading: CEREMONIES AND THE FIRST PEACE TREATY / CEREMONIES AND THE FIRST PEACE TREATY
verses.text: Under the first peace treaty, there were instructions for ceremonies and a sacred lodge tent that is of this world.
The first room in the sacred lodge tent was called the Holy Place. In that room, there was a lampstand and a table for the sacred bread and other ceremonial items.
verses.html: The first room in the sacred lodge tent was called the Holy Place. In that room, there was a lampstand and a table for the sacred bread and other ceremonial items.

verses.text: A blanket was hung between the Holy Place and the next room, which was called the Most Holy Place.

In this room, there was a sacred altar for the burning of sweet-smelling herbs and spices, and a cedar box of the peace treaty that was covered with gold on all sides. Inside the cedar box was a golden pot filled with the mysterious bread, the walking stick of Light Bearer (Aaron) that blossomed, and the stone tablets of the peace treaty.
Above the cedar box were the bright-shining winged ones whose wings overshadowed the mercy seat. But we cannot speak at length about these things at this time.
When all these things had been made ready in a good way, the holy men would go into the outer room of the sacred lodge tent over and over again to perform the sacred ceremonies.

But only the chief holy man could enter into the second room, the Most Holy Place, and then only once a year. He must also take blood from a sacrificed animal in with him to offer first for himself and then for the wrongs the people did not mean to do.

verses.heading: A NEW WAY IS REVEALED / A NEW WAY IS REVEALED
verses.text: By all these things the Holy Spirit is showing us that the way into the Most Holy Place in the spirit-world above was not yet open as long as the first sacred lodge tent in this world was still standing.
verses.html: By all these things the Holy Spirit is showing us that the way into the Most Holy Place in the spirit-world above was not yet open as long as the first sacred lodge tent in this world was still standing.

verses.text: This has spiritual meaning for the time we live in. It shows us that the gifts and offerings made in the sacred lodge tent that now stands cannot truly set free the heart and mind of the one who brings the offerings.
verses.html: This has spiritual meaning for the time we live in. It shows us that the gifts and offerings made in the sacred lodge tent that now stands cannot truly set free the heart and mind of the one who brings the offerings.

verses.text: These things are only concerned with food and drink and different kinds of ceremonial washings—rules about outward things. They were needed until it was time for a new way to be revealed.
verses.html: These things are only concerned with food and drink and different kinds of ceremonial washings—rules about outward things. They were needed until it was time for a new way to be revealed.

verses.text: But now the Chosen One has appeared as the chief holy man of the good things that have now come. He entered into the true and greater sacred tent lodge, the one not made with human hands, meaning not of this creation. He entered into the Most Holy Place once for all time and for all people.
He did not go in with the blood of goats and calves but with his own lifeblood. In doing so, he paid the highest price to set us free and make us whole for all time.

verses.heading: A ONCE-FOR-ALL-TIME CEREMONY / A ONCE-FOR-ALL-TIME CEREMONY
verses.text: If the blood of goats and young bulls and the ashes of a young cow sprinkled on those who are ceremonially unclean can purify our bodies,

then how much more will the lifeblood of the Chosen One accomplish? Through the eternal Spirit he offered his life to the Great Spirit to purify our hearts and minds from the meaningless things we have done to try to please the Great Spirit. Now we can serve the living Creator with the life that comes from him!
verses.html: then how much more will the lifeblood of the Chosen One accomplish? Through the eternal Spirit he offered his life to the Great Spirit to purify our hearts and minds from the meaningless things we have done to try to please the Great Spirit. Now we can serve the living Creator with the life that comes from him!

verses.text: This is why it must be the Chosen One who makes a new peace treaty between human beings and the Great Spirit. His death was the price he paid to release people from their failure to walk true to the first peace treaty. This new peace treaty was needed so that those who answer his call will share in all the promised blessings that will never fade away.
verses.html: This is why it must be the Chosen One who makes a new peace treaty between human beings and the Great Spirit. His death was the price he paid to release people from their failure to walk true to the first peace treaty. This new peace treaty was needed so that those who answer his call will share in all the promised blessings that will never fade away.

verses.heading: DEATH AND THE NEW PEACE TREATY / DEATH AND THE NEW PEACE TREATY
verses.text: This kind of peace treaty does not begin while the one who made it remains alive. It begins after the death of the one who made it.
This is why even the first peace treaty required blood to be shed.

Drawn from the Water (Moses) told the people all that our tribal law required them to do. Then he used red wool and a hyssop branch to sprinkle the book of the law and the people with water and the blood of bulls and goats.
He said to our people, “This is the blood of the peace treaty the Great Spirit has made with you. You must do all that it says.”
In the same way, he sprinkled the sacred lodge tent and all the ceremonial objects with blood.
So then, according to our tribal law, almost all things need to be washed clean with blood, and unless lifeblood has been poured out in death there is no being set free from broken ways.
verses.html: So then, according to our tribal law, almost all things need to be washed clean with blood, and unless lifeblood has been poured out in death there is no being set free from broken ways.

verses.text: If the earthly copies of what is in the spirit-world above needed purification in this way, then better offerings are needed to purify the things in the spirit-world above.

verses.heading: HE REPRESENTS US / HE REPRESENTS US
verses.text: For the Chosen One did not go into a Holy Place made with human hands—an earthly copy of the true Holy Place. He went into the spirit-world above, where he now represents us before the Great Spirit.
verses.html: For the Chosen One did not go into a Holy Place made with human hands—an earthly copy of the true Holy Place. He went into the spirit-world above, where he now represents us before the Great Spirit.

verses.text: He did not go in to offer himself again and again like the chief holy man who every year goes into the earthly Holy Place with lifeblood that is not his own.
verses.html: He did not go in to offer himself again and again like the chief holy man who every year goes into the earthly Holy Place with lifeblood that is not his own.

verses.text: For then, from the time when the world was formed, he would have had to suffer over and over again. But now, at the fullness of the ages, he appeared to bring an end to broken ways by performing the once-for-all-time ceremony when he offered himself.
Human beings die once, and then they must stand before the one who decides what they have done right and what they have done wrong.

So the Chosen One also died once when he took on himself the bad hearts and broken ways of many people. He will appear a second time, not to die for broken ways but to set free and make whole all who keep their eyes wide open as they wait for him.

verses.heading: A DIM SHADOW / A DIM SHADOW
verses.text: Our tribal law is only a dim shadow of the good things to come, not the things themselves. The ceremonial sacrifices and offerings required by our law are repeated over and over again year after year. These ceremonies cannot fully set free and make whole those who draw near to the Great Spirit.

If they could, would they not have stopped offering them? For once the ceremonies had been performed, the people would be purified in their hearts and minds, and no longer feel the guilt of their broken ways.
But these yearly ceremonies keep reminding the people that their bad hearts and broken ways have not been fully purified.
For it is not possible for the blood of bulls and goats to take away bad hearts and broken ways.

verses.heading: NO MORE SACRIFICES / NO MORE SACRIFICES
verses.text: So then, when the Chosen One came into this world, he said, “O Great Spirit, sacrifice and offering is not what you want, but you have given me a human body to bring an end to these sacrifices once and for all.
verses.html: So then, when the Chosen One came into this world, he said, “O Great Spirit, sacrifice and offering is not what you want, but you have given me a human body to bring an end to these sacrifices once and for all.

verses.text: Burnt animal sacrifices and other offerings for broken ways do not make your heart glad.”
Then the Chosen One said, “In the Sacred Book, it has been written about me. ‘Behold! I have come to do what you want done, O Great Spirit.’”
verses.html: Then the Chosen One said, “In the Sacred Book, it has been written about me. ‘Behold! I have come to do what you want done, O Great Spirit.’”

verses.text: First, the Chosen One said that “the Great Spirit does not want sacrifices and offerings, nor is he pleased with them,” even though they are required by our tribal law.

Then he said, “Behold, I have come to do what you, the Great Spirit, wants done.” This means that he has taken away the first peace treaty with its law of sacrifices and offerings to put in its place the second.
verses.html: Then he said, “Behold, I have come to do what you, the Great Spirit, wants done.” This means that he has taken away the first peace treaty with its law of sacrifices and offerings to put in its place the second.

verses.text: The Chosen One did what Creator wanted when he made us holy by offering his body once for all time.
Under our tribal law holy men keep performing the same ceremonies day after day and making the same sacrifices over and over again. Those sacrifices can never take away bad hearts and broken ways.
verses.html: Under our tribal law holy men keep performing the same ceremonies day after day and making the same sacrifices over and over again. Those sacrifices can never take away bad hearts and broken ways.

verses.text: But the Chosen One, after performing the once-for-all-time ceremony to heal our broken ways, sat down at Creator’s right hand—the place of greatest honor.
He now rules from there and waits until all his enemies have been defeated and humbled.
verses.html: He now rules from there and waits until all his enemies have been defeated and humbled.

verses.text: For by this one offering he has for all time completely set free the ones he is making holy.
The Holy Spirit tells us the same truth. First, he says,
“‘This is the peace treaty I will make with them in the coming days,’ says the Great Spirit Chief. ‘I will carve my laws on their hearts and plant them into their minds.’”
Then he says, “And their broken ways and wrongdoings I will remember no more.”
Now when broken ways and wrongdoings have been forgiven like this, there is no longer any need for further offerings.

verses.heading: A NEW AND LIVING WAY / A NEW AND LIVING WAY
verses.text: So then, my sacred family members, since Creator Sets Free (Jesus) has offered his own lifeblood in this way, this gives us the courage to walk boldly into the Most Holy Place.
He has made a new and living way for us to pass through the blanket—that is, his human body—to go into the Most Holy Place.
verses.html: He has made a new and living way for us to pass through the blanket—that is, his human body—to go into the Most Holy Place.

verses.text: Since we have such a great chief holy man, who is headman of Creator’s family lodge,
let us draw near with honest hearts, trusting fully in what the Chosen One has done. For our hearts have been washed clean from guilt and shame and our bodies washed with pure water.
verses.html: let us draw near with honest hearts, trusting fully in what the Chosen One has done. For our hearts have been washed clean from guilt and shame and our bodies washed with pure water.

verses.text: Let us get a firm and steady hold on this hope we say is ours, for the one who made the promise to us can be fully trusted.
We should think about how to stir each other up toward love and doing good.
To do this, we must never give up on gathering together, as some have. Instead, we should encourage each other, and all the more as you see the day of his appearing coming near.
For if we keep stubbornly walking in broken ways after the truth has been made clear to us, then no further sacrifice can be made for our broken ways.
All that remains is to wait for the fiery judgment that will burn up all who are hostile to Creator’s right ways.
Under the law given by Drawn from the Water (Moses), anyone who set aside that law was put to death without pity on the word of two or three witnesses.

How much worse punishment do you think is deserved by the one who has trampled underfoot the Son of the Great Spirit, who treats the lifeblood of the peace treaty that makes us holy as having no value, and treats with disrespect the Spirit who gives us the gift of his great kindness?

For we know Creator has said, “Punishment for wrongs belongs to me. I will make sure that wrongs are made right again.” And the Sacred Teachings have also said, “The Great Spirit Chief will decide for all his people who has done right and who has done wrong.”
verses.html: For we know Creator has said, “Punishment for wrongs belongs to me. I will make sure that wrongs are made right again.” And the Sacred Teachings have also said, “The Great Spirit Chief will decide for all his people who has done right and who has done wrong.”

verses.text: It is a fearful thing to come before the living Creator to give an answer for the wrongs we have done.

verses.heading: KEEP WALKING FORWARD / KEEP WALKING FORWARD
verses.text: Remember those early days when you first started walking in the light of the good story. You kept walking the road even when the way forward was a struggle filled with pain and suffering.
verses.html: Remember those early days when you first started walking in the light of the good story. You kept walking the road even when the way forward was a struggle filled with pain and suffering.

verses.text: At times the path was hard to walk, as you faced open shame and insults. At other times you walked side by side with those who were being mistreated.

You shared in the pain of those who were in prison. When your own possessions were stolen, you accepted it with glad hearts, knowing that you have been given better possessions that will never fade away.
So keep your hearts from falling to the ground. Hold your heads high. For a great honor awaits you at the end of the trail.
All you need is to keep walking with firm steps, doing what Creator wants. He will make sure you receive all that he has promised.
For the Sacred Teachings tell us, “It will not be long until the Coming One arrives. He will be here soon!
verses.html: For the Sacred Teachings tell us, “It will not be long until the Coming One arrives. He will be here soon!

verses.text: Until then the ones who are in good standing with Creator will walk the road of life by trusting in him. But he will not be pleased with any who turn back.”
We are not the ones who turn back and lose their way, but we are the ones whose whole beings are kept safe and made whole by trusting in him.

verses.heading: BRAVE ONES WHO TRUSTED CREATOR / BRAVE ONES WHO TRUSTED CREATOR
verses.text: Trusting Creator is the solid ground our hope rests on. It means we can be sure of the things we do not yet see.
For it was this kind of trusting that brought honor to our tribal ancestors.
By trusting, we understand that the Great Spirit, by his voice, created all that we can see. By trusting we understand that the things we see were brought into being by that which we cannot see.

Because he trusted Creator, His Breath Goes Up (Abel) offered a ceremonial gift that was more acceptable to the Great Spirit than the offering of Spear Maker (Cain). Because he trusted, Creator was pleased with his gift, which gave him the reputation of being in good standing. So because he trusted, his voice still speaks to us today, even though he died long ago.

Because he trusted the Great Spirit, Walks with Creator (Enoch) did not die. No one could find him because Creator took him. Before he was taken, he had the reputation of one who makes Creator’s heart glad.
verses.html: Because he trusted the Great Spirit, Walks with Creator (Enoch) did not die. No one could find him because Creator took him. Before he was taken, he had the reputation of one who makes Creator’s heart glad.

verses.text: For no one can make Creator’s heart glad without trusting him. So then, those who draw near to the Great Spirit must believe that he is and that he honors all who truly seek him.

Because he trusted the One Above Us All, One Who Rests (Noah) took to heart the warning given to him by the Great Spirit and made a great wooden canoe for the safety of his family. By trusting he showed the world how terrible their ways had become. By trusting he took his place among those who, by trusting, share in the blessing of good standing with Creator.
verses.html: Because he trusted the One Above Us All, One Who Rests (Noah) took to heart the warning given to him by the Great Spirit and made a great wooden canoe for the safety of his family. By trusting he showed the world how terrible their ways had become. By trusting he took his place among those who, by trusting, share in the blessing of good standing with Creator.

verses.text: Because he trusted the Great Mystery, Father of Many Nations (Abraham) left his homeland to go to another land that was promised to him and his descendants. He followed the voice of the Great Spirit even though he was going to a land he had never been before.
verses.html: Because he trusted the Great Mystery, Father of Many Nations (Abraham) left his homeland to go to another land that was promised to him and his descendants. He followed the voice of the Great Spirit even though he was going to a land he had never been before.

verses.text: By trusting in this way, he lived in the Land of Promise as a stranger in a strange land. Father of Many Nations (Abraham) settled his family in tents, along with his sons, He Made Us Laugh (Isaac) and Heel Grabber (Jacob), who would share with him in the same promise.
verses.html: By trusting in this way, he lived in the Land of Promise as a stranger in a strange land. Father of Many Nations (Abraham) settled his family in tents, along with his sons, He Made Us Laugh (Isaac) and Heel Grabber (Jacob), who would share with him in the same promise.

verses.text: There he waited, for he was looking for a village that would remain—one built on solid ground. A village whose maker and builder is the Great Spirit.
verses.html: There he waited, for he was looking for a village that would remain—one built on solid ground. A village whose maker and builder is the Great Spirit.

verses.text: Because he trusted the Maker of Life, Father of Many Nations (Abraham) was able to father a child, even though his wife Noble Woman (Sarah) was barren and they were both too old. For they were sure the Great Spirit could be trusted to keep the promise he made to them.
verses.html: Because he trusted the Maker of Life, Father of Many Nations (Abraham) was able to father a child, even though his wife Noble Woman (Sarah) was barren and they were both too old. For they were sure the Great Spirit could be trusted to keep the promise he made to them.

verses.text: So from this one man, his body as good as dead, many descendants were born, as many as the stars in the sky and as countless as the sand on the seashore.

verses.heading: LONGING FOR A BETTER LAND / LONGING FOR A BETTER LAND
verses.text: Every one of these people died still trusting in Creator. Even though they did not receive all that had been promised, they took the promises to heart and welcomed them from afar. They said of themselves, “We are strangers and wanderers on the land.”
verses.html: Every one of these people died still trusting in Creator. Even though they did not receive all that had been promised, they took the promises to heart and welcomed them from afar. They said of themselves, “We are strangers and wanderers on the land.”

verses.text: People who say things like this make it clear that they are looking for a land of their own.
If they had been longing for the land from which they had come, they could have returned.
But they are longing for a better land—one from the spirit-world above. That is why Creator is not ashamed to be called their Great Spirit and has prepared for them a village to live in.

verses.heading: MORE EXAMPLES OF TRUSTING / MORE EXAMPLES OF TRUSTING
verses.text: Because he trusted the Giver of Breath, Father of Many Nations (Abraham), when he was tested by the Great Spirit, offered up He Made Us Laugh (Isaac) as a ceremonial sacrifice. For Creator had promised him, “It is through He Made Us Laugh (Isaac) that your descendants will be born.” But there he was, ready to offer up his only son!
verses.html: Because he trusted the Giver of Breath, Father of Many Nations (Abraham), when he was tested by the Great Spirit, offered up He Made Us Laugh (Isaac) as a ceremonial sacrifice. For Creator had promised him, “It is through He Made Us Laugh (Isaac) that your descendants will be born.” But there he was, ready to offer up his only son!

verses.text: For he was sure that Creator had the power to raise him up, even from the dead. So in a spiritual way of thinking, he did receive He Made Us Laugh (Isaac) back from the dead.
Because he trusted the Most Holy One, He Made Us Laugh (Isaac), when he spoke the family blessing over Heel Grabber (Jacob) and his brother Hairy Man (Esau), told them about things to come.
verses.html: Because he trusted the Most Holy One, He Made Us Laugh (Isaac), when he spoke the family blessing over Heel Grabber (Jacob) and his brother Hairy Man (Esau), told them about things to come.

verses.text: Because he trusted the Great Spirit, Heel Grabber (Jacob), at the end of his days, blessed each of the sons of Creator Gives More (Joseph) as he leaned on his walking stick and humbled himself before Creator.
verses.html: Because he trusted the Great Spirit, Heel Grabber (Jacob), at the end of his days, blessed each of the sons of Creator Gives More (Joseph) as he leaned on his walking stick and humbled himself before Creator.

verses.text: Because he trusted the One Above Us All, Creator Gives More (Joseph), at the end of his days, spoke of the time when the children of the tribes of Wrestles with Creator (Israel) would go out from Black Land (Egypt), and he gave instructions about where to bury his bones.
verses.html: Because he trusted the One Above Us All, Creator Gives More (Joseph), at the end of his days, spoke of the time when the children of the tribes of Wrestles with Creator (Israel) would go out from Black Land (Egypt), and he gave instructions about where to bury his bones.

verses.text: Because his parents trusted the Great Mystery, they hid Drawn from the Water (Moses) for three moons. They saw Creator’s beauty in the child and did not fear the instructions of the ruler of Black Land (Egypt).
verses.html: Because his parents trusted the Great Mystery, they hid Drawn from the Water (Moses) for three moons. They saw Creator’s beauty in the child and did not fear the instructions of the ruler of Black Land (Egypt).

verses.text: Because he trusted the Maker of Life, Drawn from the Water (Moses), as a full-grown man, refused to be called the son of the daughter of Great House (Pharaoh), the ruler of Black Land (Egypt).
verses.html: Because he trusted the Maker of Life, Drawn from the Water (Moses), as a full-grown man, refused to be called the son of the daughter of Great House (Pharaoh), the ruler of Black Land (Egypt).

verses.text: He chose to suffer with Creator’s people, rather than finding joy in the passing pleasures of the broken ways of Black Land (Egypt).
verses.html: He chose to suffer with Creator’s people, rather than finding joy in the passing pleasures of the broken ways of Black Land (Egypt).

verses.text: He knew that the honor he would receive by suffering with the Chosen One was greater than all the treasures of Black Land (Egypt), because he kept his eyes on the honor that was to be his.
By trusting he left Black Land (Egypt) without fear of its ruler. He kept walking forward, keeping his eyes on the one who cannot be seen.

Because he trusted the Giver of Breath, Drawn from the Water (Moses) participated in the first Passover while he was still in Black Land (Egypt) when the blood of a lamb was sprinkled on the doorposts. This is how the firstborn sons of the tribes of Wrestles with Creator (Israel) were not killed by the spirit-messenger of death.
verses.html: Because he trusted the Giver of Breath, Drawn from the Water (Moses) participated in the first Passover while he was still in Black Land (Egypt) when the blood of a lamb was sprinkled on the doorposts. This is how the firstborn sons of the tribes of Wrestles with Creator (Israel) were not killed by the spirit-messenger of death.

verses.text: By trusting Creator, the people walked through the Red Sea as if they were on dry land. But when the soldiers of Black Land (Egypt) tried to cross, they were swallowed up by the sea.
verses.html: By trusting Creator, the people walked through the Red Sea as if they were on dry land. But when the soldiers of Black Land (Egypt) tried to cross, they were swallowed up by the sea.

verses.text: Because the people trusted the Great Spirit, they walked around Moon Village (Jericho) for seven days, and the walls fell to the ground.
verses.html: Because the people trusted the Great Spirit, they walked around Moon Village (Jericho) for seven days, and the walls fell to the ground.

verses.text: Boastful Woman (Rahab), who lived in Moon Village (Jericho), made her living by trading her body for possessions. But because she trusted and welcomed the spies with peace, she did not die with the ones who refused to obey Creator.
verses.html: Boastful Woman (Rahab), who lived in Moon Village (Jericho), made her living by trading her body for possessions. But because she trusted and welcomed the spies with peace, she did not die with the ones who refused to obey Creator.

verses.heading: SO MANY BRAVE ONES TO HONOR / SO MANY BRAVE ONES TO HONOR
verses.text: If I had more time, I would tell you about He Tears Down (Gideon), Lightning Flashing Across the Sky (Barak), Strength of the Sun (Samson), and He Breaks Out (Jephthah). I would also tell the stories of Chief Much Loved One (David), of Creator Hears Him (Samuel), and the prophets.
Because men such as these trusted the Great Spirit, they won the victory over nations, made wrongs right again, took hold of promises, and closed the mouths of mountain lions.
verses.html: Because men such as these trusted the Great Spirit, they won the victory over nations, made wrongs right again, took hold of promises, and closed the mouths of mountain lions.

verses.text: They defeated the power of fire and escaped the long knives of their enemies. The weak were made strong and became great warriors who drove their enemies away.
verses.html: They defeated the power of fire and escaped the long knives of their enemies. The weak were made strong and became great warriors who drove their enemies away.

verses.text: Women received their loved ones back from the dead. Others were tortured, refusing to be set free, knowing they would be honored when the dead are raised.
Some were insulted and mocked, whipped with leather straps, or chained and thrown into prison.

Some were killed with rocks. Others were cut in two. Others faced temptation. And some were cut down by long knives. They wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins, hunted down, mistreated, and in need of many things.
They roamed aimlessly through deserts and mountains, living in caves and holes in the ground. The world is not worthy of people like this.

verses.heading: CREATOR PROVIDED SOMETHING BETTER / CREATOR PROVIDED SOMETHING BETTER
verses.text: Even though these faithful ones have been honored for showing what it means to trust Creator, they did not receive all that was promised.
verses.html: Even though these faithful ones have been honored for showing what it means to trust Creator, they did not receive all that was promised.

verses.text: But the Great Spirit has provided something better for us who live in these last days. So now those who came before us can finally see Creator’s promise come to its full meaning and purpose. For without us they would not be complete in the Chosen One.
verses.html: But the Great Spirit has provided something better for us who live in these last days. So now those who came before us can finally see Creator’s promise come to its full meaning and purpose. For without us they would not be complete in the Chosen One.

verses.heading: A GREAT CLOUD OF TRUTH TELLERS / A GREAT CLOUD OF TRUTH TELLERS
verses.text: We are surrounded by a great cloud of truth tellers who have shown us what it means to trust the Great Spirit. So let us lay to the side everything that weighs us down and the broken ways that so easily wrap around our legs to trip us. And let us run as if we are in a long-distance race, setting a steady pace and heading toward the goal.
verses.html: We are surrounded by a great cloud of truth tellers who have shown us what it means to trust the Great Spirit. So let us lay to the side everything that weighs us down and the broken ways that so easily wrap around our legs to trip us. And let us run as if we are in a long-distance race, setting a steady pace and heading toward the goal.

verses.text: This means we must keep our eyes on Creator Sets Free (Jesus), the trailblazer of our spiritual ways, the one who was first to reach the end of the trail. The joy that lay before him gave him the strength to suffer on the cross and willingly bear its shame. He now sits at Creator’s right hand in the place of greatest honor.

If you will keep your thoughts on how much hostility Creator Sets Free (Jesus) endured from those with bad hearts and broken ways, it will keep you from growing weary and your hearts from falling to the ground.
For in your struggle against bad hearts and broken ways you have not yet had to face your own blood being shed.

verses.heading: THE DISCIPLINE OF THE GREAT SPIRIT / THE DISCIPLINE OF THE GREAT SPIRIT
verses.text: Have you forgotten the wise counsel in our Sacred Teachings that speaks to you as mature sons and daughters? “Do not treat lightly the wise counsel of the Great Spirit Chief or let your heart fall to the ground when he shows you where you have gone wrong.
verses.html: Have you forgotten the wise counsel in our Sacred Teachings that speaks to you as mature sons and daughters? “Do not treat lightly the wise counsel of the Great Spirit Chief or let your heart fall to the ground when he shows you where you have gone wrong.

verses.text: For he brings correction to the ones he loves and disciplines every child he takes into his family.”
So accept difficult times as the loving discipline of a parent, for Creator is treating you as one of his children. Are not all children disciplined by their fathers?
But if you never receive the discipline that all take part in, it means you are not truly his children and not part of the family.

When our earthly fathers disciplined us, we respected them for it. So how much more should we accept and respect Creator’s discipline, for he is our spiritual Father and the one who gives us the life of beauty and harmony!
For a short time, our earthly fathers disciplined us as they saw best, but the Great Spirit disciplines us for our own good, so we can be holy like him.
Now, all discipline at the time seems to create more sorrow than joy. But for those who have learned its worth, it grows into a life of peace and doing what is right.
So lift up your arms that hang down and begin using your weak knees.
Make the path you walk straight, so that those with weak knees may not stumble from the path but instead be healed.

verses.heading: WALK IN PEACE WITH EVERYONE / WALK IN PEACE WITH EVERYONE
verses.text: Live in a sacred way by walking the road of peace with all people, for those who fail to walk in this way will not see our Honored Chief.
See to it that no one among you misses out on the gift of Creator’s great kindness and that no bitter root springs up among you, making trouble and poisoning many hearts.
See that no one becomes an impure or unspiritual person like Hairy Man (Esau), who for a single meal traded away his family birthright.
For you know that later on, he wanted it back. But even though he begged his father with many tears, it was too late to undo what he had done.

verses.heading: LEARN FROM THE ANCESTORS / LEARN FROM THE ANCESTORS
verses.text: For you have not come, as your ancestors did, to something that can be touched—a mountain blazing with fire and smoke, with clouds of darkness and gloom, and a windstorm. This happened long ago when Drawn from the Water (Moses) was given the tribal law on Mountain of Small Trees (Sinai).
verses.html:
For you have not come, as your ancestors did, to something that can be touched—a mountain blazing with fire and smoke, with clouds of darkness and gloom, and a windstorm.
This happened long ago when Drawn from the Water (Moses) was given the tribal law on Mountain of Small Trees (Sinai).

verses.text: There the eagle bone whistle was sounded. A voice spoke out from the mountain, but the people begged the voice to stop and not speak to them again.
verses.html: There the eagle bone whistle was sounded. A voice spoke out from the mountain, but the people begged the voice to stop and not speak to them again.

verses.text: For the instruction, “Even if an animal touches the mountain, it must be put to death with stones,” was too much for them to bear.
The vision set before their eyes was so fearful that Drawn from the Water (Moses) cried out, “I am trembling with fear!”

verses.heading: A NEW PEACE TREATY / A NEW PEACE TREATY
verses.text: But you, my much-loved relatives, have not come to a mountain like this. Instead, you have come to Strong Mountain (Zion) and to the Village of Peace (Jerusalem) from the spirit-world above, the village of our Creator who is the Maker of Life. This is where many thousands of the spirit-messengers have gathered to celebrate a great festival!
verses.html: But you, my much-loved relatives, have not come to a mountain like this. Instead, you have come to Strong Mountain (Zion) and to the Village of Peace (Jerusalem) from the spirit-world above, the village of our Creator who is the Maker of Life. This is where many thousands of the spirit-messengers have gathered to celebrate a great festival!

verses.text: This is also a gathering of the great sacred family, who are the firstborn whose names have been written down in the book of life kept in the spirit-world above. You have come to the Great Spirit, the one who decides for everyone who has done right and who has done wrong, and to the ones in good standing whose spirits have been made whole.
verses.html: This is also a gathering of the great sacred family, who are the firstborn whose names have been written down in the book of life kept in the spirit-world above. You have come to the Great Spirit, the one who decides for everyone who has done right and who has done wrong, and to the ones in good standing whose spirits have been made whole.

verses.text: Yes, you have come to Creator Sets Free (Jesus), the peacemaker of the new peace treaty between the Great Spirit and human beings. You have come to the blood that has been sprinkled, which says better things than the blood of His Breath Goes Up (Abel).

verses.heading: A SHAKING OF ALL THINGS / A SHAKING OF ALL THINGS
verses.text: Make sure you do not turn away from the voice of the one who now speaks! For if the ones who turned away from him who warned them on earth did not escape, how will we escape if we turn away the one who speaks from the spirit-world above?
At that time his voice shook the earth, but he has now promised once more to shake both the earth and the spirit-world above.
When he says “once more,” this means he is removing those things that can be shaken, things that are of this creation, so that which cannot be shaken will remain.
So then, since we are welcoming a good road that cannot be shaken, let us give thanks to the Great Spirit and serve him in a good way, with much honor and respect.
For our Creator is an all-consuming fire.

verses.heading: LOVE AS BROTHERS AND SISTERS / LOVE AS BROTHERS AND SISTERS
verses.text: Keep loving each other as brothers and sisters of the sacred family.
verses.html: Keep loving each other as brothers and sisters of the sacred family.

verses.text: Do not forget to be kind and welcoming to strangers, for in this way some have welcomed spirit-messengers without knowing it.
Keep the ones who are in prison in your thoughts as if you were there with them, and those who are mistreated as if you in your own body shared their suffering.
Marriage is honorable, and the marriage bed is pure, but Creator will decide the guilt of all who are sexually impure and unfaithful in marriage.
Keep yourselves free from the love of possessions and be at peace with what you have. For the Great Spirit himself has said, “I will never leave you or give up on you.”
Because of this we can boldly say, “The Great Spirit Chief is the one who stands with me. Why would I fear what human beings can do?”

verses.heading: WISE WORDS OF COUNSEL AND COURAGE / WISE WORDS OF COUNSEL AND COURAGE
verses.text: Never forget the ones who blazed the trail before you, the ones who were first to tell you the message of Creator’s good story. Think deeply about the manner in which they lived and died, and follow in their way of trusting.
verses.html: Never forget the ones who blazed the trail before you, the ones who were first to tell you the message of Creator’s good story. Think deeply about the manner in which they lived and died, and follow in their way of trusting.

verses.text: Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One remains the same yesterday, today, and to the time beyond the end of all days.

Do not let all kinds of strange teachings take you down a wrong path. For our hearts are made strong by the gift of Creator’s great kindness, not from following rules about what foods to eat. These kinds of rules have not helped those who have followed after them.
verses.html: Do not let all kinds of strange teachings take you down a wrong path. For our hearts are made strong by the gift of Creator’s great kindness, not from following rules about what foods to eat. These kinds of rules have not helped those who have followed after them.

verses.text: The ones who still serve in the tent lodge on earth have no right to share in our ceremonial altar.
verses.html: The ones who still serve in the tent lodge on earth have no right to share in our ceremonial altar.

verses.text: For each year the chief holy man takes the blood of animals into the Most Holy Place as an offering for the people’s broken ways. The bodies of those animals are then burned outside the camp.
verses.html: For each year the chief holy man takes the blood of animals into the Most Holy Place as an offering for the people’s broken ways. The bodies of those animals are then burned outside the camp.

verses.text: Creator Sets Free (Jesus) offered his own lifeblood to make the people holy and suffered outside the village gate.
So then, let us join him outside the camp, sharing in the same kind of disrespect and shame that he suffered.
For we are not seeking an earthly village that will fade away. We are seeking the village that is coming down from the spirit-world above, one that will remain.
verses.html: For we are not seeking an earthly village that will fade away. We are seeking the village that is coming down from the spirit-world above, one that will remain.

verses.heading: MORE WISE COUNSEL / MORE WISE COUNSEL
verses.text: So then, through Creator Sets Free (Jesus), let us keep giving thanks as a sacrificial offering to the Great Spirit. This is the fruit of our lips, giving honor to him and all that his name represents.
And do not forget to do good and share with those who are in need, for these are also sacrificial gifts that make Creator’s heart glad.

Follow the guidance of your spiritual leaders and give way to their instructions. For they must give an answer for the guidance they provide. So let them do so with glad hearts and not with sorrow, for that would not be a good thing for you.

verses.heading: KEEP SENDING UP PRAYERS / KEEP SENDING UP PRAYERS
verses.text: Keep sending up prayers for us, for deep inside we are sure that we are walking in a good and honorable way.
I ask you this with all my heart, so that I may soon return to you.

The Great Spirit of Peace is the one who raised up from the dead our Honored Chief Creator Sets Free (Jesus), the Great Shepherd of the sheep. It is through his lifeblood that we now have a peace treaty that will last beyond the end of all days.

May the Great Provider give you everything you need to do what he wants done. He is working, through Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One, to do in us the things that make his heart glad. He is to be given all honor to the time beyond the end of all days. Aho! May it be so!
verses.html: May the Great Provider give you everything you need to do what he wants done. He is working, through Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One, to do in us the things that make his heart glad. He is to be given all honor to the time beyond the end of all days. Aho! May it be so!

verses.heading: FINAL WORDS / FINAL WORDS
verses.text: So now, my relatives, I counsel you to take to heart this short message. I have written it to lift you up and give you strength.
I want you to know that our spiritual brother He Gives Honor (Timothy) has been set free from prison. If he comes soon, we will travel together to see you.
verses.html: I want you to know that our spiritual brother He Gives Honor (Timothy) has been set free from prison. If he comes soon, we will travel together to see you.

verses.text: Greet all your spiritual leaders and all of Creator’s holy ones. I send you greetings from those in Land of Young Bulls (Italy).
May the gift of Creator’s great kindness be with you all. Aho! May it be so!
verses.html:
May the gift of Creator’s great kindness be with you all.
Aho! May it be so!

verses.heading: GREETINGS / GREETINGS
verses.text: From He Leads the Way (James), a sacred servant of the Great Spirit and of our Honored Chief, Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One. To the twelve tribes scattered like seeds among the nations. I send joyful greetings!
verses.html:
From He Leads the Way (James), a sacred servant of the Great Spirit and of our Honored Chief, Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One.
To the twelve tribes scattered like seeds among the nations. I send joyful greetings!

verses.heading: WISDOM FOR TIMES OF TESTING / WISDOM FOR TIMES OF TESTING
verses.text: My sacred family members, whenever your trust in the Great Spirit is tested, count it as a reason to dance for joy.
verses.html: My sacred family members, whenever your trust in the Great Spirit is tested, count it as a reason to dance for joy.

verses.text: For you know that when your trust is put to the test, your ability to stand firm grows stronger.
So keep standing firm until you have passed the test. Then you will have gained all the maturity and strength of character needed to finish walking the good road.
verses.html: So keep standing firm until you have passed the test. Then you will have gained all the maturity and strength of character needed to finish walking the good road.

verses.text: If wisdom is needed, ask the Great Spirit, for he freely gives wisdom to all who ask and never holds back.
But when you ask, you must put all your trust in him without doubting. For the one who doubts is like a wave in the sea tossed about by the wind.
People who doubt should not hope to receive anything from our Honored Chief,
verses.html: People who doubt should not hope to receive anything from our Honored Chief,

verses.text: for they have two minds, not knowing which one to follow.

verses.heading: WISDOM FOR THE POOR AND THE RICH / WISDOM FOR THE POOR AND THE RICH
verses.text: Those sacred family members who have little should take joy in the honor Creator bestows on them.
And the ones who have much should take joy in knowing that they will be humbled because they will fade away like a wildflower in the grass.
verses.html: And the ones who have much should take joy in knowing that they will be humbled because they will fade away like a wildflower in the grass.

verses.text: For the sun rises with its fiery heat and dries up the grass, causing the wildflower to fall to the ground and its beauty to fade away. This is how it will be for those who go about working so hard to get many possessions.
verses.html: For the sun rises with its fiery heat and dries up the grass, causing the wildflower to fall to the ground and its beauty to fade away. This is how it will be for those who go about working so hard to get many possessions.

verses.text: Creator’s blessing rests on the ones who stand firm under testing, for once they have passed the test, they will receive the headdress of life that has been promised to those who love the Great Spirit.

verses.heading: WISDOM FOR TIMES OF TEMPTATION / WISDOM FOR TIMES OF TEMPTATION
verses.text: When tempted, no one should say, “Creator is tempting me.” For the Great Spirit cannot be tempted by evil, nor does he tempt anyone.
We are the ones who tempt ourselves when we are lured away and trapped by our own desires.
When an evil desire takes root in our hearts, it gives birth to broken ways. When these broken ways have taken over, they drag us down a path that leads to death.

verses.heading: GOOD GIFTS COME FROM THE FATHER ABOVE / GOOD GIFTS COME FROM THE FATHER ABOVE
verses.text: Do not be misled, my sacred family members.

Every good and perfect gift comes down from the Father above, who gave us the sun, moon, and stars. But unlike them, the light that comes from the Great Spirit never dims, flickers, or casts a shadow.
verses.html: Every good and perfect gift comes down from the Father above, who gave us the sun, moon, and stars. But unlike them, the light that comes from the Great Spirit never dims, flickers, or casts a shadow.

verses.text: Creator is the one who chose to birth us into being by his word of truth so that we would be the first of all creation to truly be who he made us to be.

verses.heading: TURN AWAY FROM HUMAN ANGER / TURN AWAY FROM HUMAN ANGER
verses.text: Knowing this, my much-loved family members, we must all be quick to listen, slow to speak, and slow to become angry.
For human anger will not take us down the path of Creator’s right ways.
So scrape off all the mud of your evil ways and humbly receive the message that the Great Spirit has planted deep within you. This will set your heart free and make your mind whole.

verses.heading: DO NOT ONLY HEAR THE MESSAGE / DO NOT ONLY HEAR THE MESSAGE
verses.text: But make sure you do not fool yourselves. You must not only hear this message. You must also walk in its truth.
For if you only hear but fail to walk true to the message, you are like a man who sees his own face reflected in a pool of water.
Then, right after looking at himself, he walks away and forgets what he looks like.

But take a good long look into the perfect way of life, the law of love that sets people free. Stay true to its message, not forgetting what you have heard but walking in all its ways, and Creator’s blessing will rest on all you do.
All who represent themselves as spiritual but do not keep their tongue under control are only fooling themselves—their spirituality is worthless.
But the one whose spirituality is pure and spotless before our Father the Great Spirit takes care of widows and orphans, and keeps himself free from the evil ways of this world.

verses.heading: TREAT ALL PEOPLE IN THE SAME WAY / TREAT ALL PEOPLE IN THE SAME WAY
verses.text: My sacred family members, as you trust in our bright and shining Honored Chief, Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One, do not treat one person better than another.
verses.html: My sacred family members, as you trust in our bright and shining Honored Chief, Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One, do not treat one person better than another.

verses.text: Let us say someone comes into your sacred gathering wearing fine clothes and costly jewelry, and some poor person comes in dressed in rags.

Then you give more honor to the one wearing fine clothes, saying, “Come, sit here in this honored place,” but you say to the one dressed in rags, “Go, stand over there,” or, “Sit here on the floor where people lay their feet.”
If you treat people in this way, have you not decided that some among you are better than others and acted like crooked council members with bad hearts?
verses.html: If you treat people in this way, have you not decided that some among you are better than others and acted like crooked council members with bad hearts?

verses.text: Hear me, my much-loved sacred family members! Did not the Great Spirit choose the ones the world looks down on as poor to be rich in trusting and sharers together in the good road that Creator has promised to those who love him?
verses.html: Hear me, my much-loved sacred family members! Did not the Great Spirit choose the ones the world looks down on as poor to be rich in trusting and sharers together in the good road that Creator has promised to those who love him?

verses.text: Why would you show no respect for the poor? Is it not the rich who drag you down and bring you before their own corrupt councils?
verses.html: Why would you show no respect for the poor? Is it not the rich who drag you down and bring you before their own corrupt councils?

verses.text: Are they not the ones who speak evil against the Honorable Name spoken over you?

verses.heading: THE TRUE MEANING AND PURPOSE OF THE LAW / THE TRUE MEANING AND PURPOSE OF THE LAW
verses.text: If you “love your fellow human beings in the same way you love yourselves,” as it says in our Sacred Teachings, you are doing well, for you are walking in the true meaning and purpose of the law of our Honored Chief.
But if you treat one person better than another, you are walking in broken ways and guilty of not following our Sacred Teachings.
For whoever does everything our tribal law requires yet fails in one thing is guilty of breaking all of it.

The one who told us to be faithful in marriage also told us not to take the life of another. If you are faithful in marriage but take away the life of another, you have become one who fails to keep the law.
In all that you say or do, remember that it is the Chosen One’s law of freedom that Creator will use to decide for or against you.
verses.html: In all that you say or do, remember that it is the Chosen One’s law of freedom that Creator will use to decide for or against you.

verses.text: When the Great Spirit decides, no mercy will be shown to those who have not shown mercy. On the other hand, the ones who have shown mercy will have mercy shown to them. So then, mercy wins the victory over judgment.
verses.html: When the Great Spirit decides, no mercy will be shown to those who have not shown mercy. On the other hand, the ones who have shown mercy will have mercy shown to them. So then, mercy wins the victory over judgment.

verses.heading: HARMONY BETWEEN FAITH AND DEEDS / HARMONY BETWEEN FAITH AND DEEDS
verses.text: What good is it, my sacred family members, if a man says “I have faith,” but has no deeds to show for it? Can that kind of “faith” set him free and make him whole?
verses.html: What good is it, my sacred family members, if a man says “I have faith,” but has no deeds to show for it? Can that kind of “faith” set him free and make him whole?

verses.text: If a family member or any human being has no clothes to wear or no food to eat,
verses.html: If a family member or any human being has no clothes to wear or no food to eat,

verses.text: and you say, “Go in peace, stay warm, and eat well,” but fail to give what is needed, what good have you done?
In the same way, without deeds, faith by itself is dead.

But someone will say, “Faith is what is needed,” while another says, “Good deeds are what is needed.” I say that both are needed. You show me your faith without good deeds, and I will show you my faith by the good deeds I have done.
verses.html: But someone will say, “Faith is what is needed,” while another says, “Good deeds are what is needed.” I say that both are needed. You show me your faith without good deeds, and I will show you my faith by the good deeds I have done.

verses.heading: EXAMPLES OF FAITH AND GOOD DEEDS / EXAMPLES OF FAITH AND GOOD DEEDS
verses.text: You believe there is only one Great Spirit. Good! But evil spirits also believe and tremble with fear!
Are you the kind of shallow person who needs to be shown over and over again that faith without good deeds has no worth?

So I ask you, was not Father of Many Nations (Abraham) shown to be in good standing when he put his son He Made Us Laugh (Isaac) on the sacred altar as a sacrifice? Long ago the Great Spirit promised Father of Many Nations (Abraham) a son even though he was too old to father a child. For many winters he kept trusting that the promise would come true. Finally, his promised son was born, the son whom the Great Spirit said his descendants would come from and through whom all nations would be blessed. But Creator told Father of Many Nations (Abraham) to take his son and offer him as a sacrifice. His trust in the Great Spirit was so strong that he believed even if he sacrificed his only son Creator would bring him back from death. So he began to do what he was told, but the Great Spirit sent a spirit-messenger to stop him just as he was about to sacrifice his son.
verses.html:
So I ask you, was not Father of Many Nations (Abraham) shown to be in good standing when he put his son He Made Us Laugh (Isaac) on the sacred altar as a sacrifice?
Long ago the Great Spirit promised Father of Many Nations (Abraham) a son even though he was too old to father a child. For many winters he kept trusting that the promise would come true. Finally, his promised son was born, the son whom the Great Spirit said his descendants would come from and through whom all nations would be blessed. But Creator told Father of Many Nations (Abraham) to take his son and offer him as a sacrifice. His trust in the Great Spirit was so strong that he believed even if he sacrificed his only son Creator would bring him back from death. So he began to do what he was told, but the Great Spirit sent a spirit-messenger to stop him just as he was about to sacrifice his son.

verses.text: It is clear to see that his faith was in harmony with what he did. His faith was completed by his deeds.

This gives full meaning to the Sacred Teaching that says, “Father of Many Nations (Abraham) trusted the Great Spirit, and this gave him good standing in Creator’s eyes.” It was for this reason that he was called the friend of the Great Spirit.
So you can see that human beings do not have good standing only by trusting but also by what they do.

It was the same for Boastful Woman (Rahab), one who traded her body for possessions. Did she not do what was right in Creator’s eyes when she took in the spies that were sent from our tribes and helped them escape by sending them out another way?
verses.html: It was the same for Boastful Woman (Rahab), one who traded her body for possessions. Did she not do what was right in Creator’s eyes when she took in the spies that were sent from our tribes and helped them escape by sending them out another way?

verses.text: In the same way that a body has no life without the spirit, so faith has no life without deeds.

verses.heading: THE POWER OF WORDS / THE POWER OF WORDS
verses.text: My sacred family members, not many of you should become teachers of our spiritual ways. For you know that we who teach will face a stricter judgment.
verses.html: My sacred family members, not many of you should become teachers of our spiritual ways. For you know that we who teach will face a stricter judgment.

verses.text: We all stumble on the path in many ways. But if we could keep our words from hurting others, we would be mature human beings, able to aim our whole lives in the right direction.
verses.html: We all stumble on the path in many ways. But if we could keep our words from hurting others, we would be mature human beings, able to aim our whole lives in the right direction.

verses.text: Those who put bits into the mouths of horses are able to move them in the direction they want them to go.
It is the same with a canoe. Even when a large canoe is being pushed by strong winds, it takes only a small paddle to steer it where someone wants it to go.
In the same way, the tongue is a small part of the body, but it boasts about great things. A large forest can be set on fire by a tiny flame,

and the tongue is itself a flame of fire. The tongue is a world full of evil and spreads its poison throughout the body. The words spoken by the tongue have the power to set on fire the very circle of life itself, and its flames come from the Valley of Smoldering Fire.

verses.heading: NO ONE CAN TAME THE TONGUE / NO ONE CAN TAME THE TONGUE
verses.text: Every kind of four-legged beast or winged one of the air and every reptile or sea creature can be tamed and have been tamed by human beings.
But no one can tame the tongue. It is an evil that never rests, full of deadly poison.
With it we bless the Great Spirit, our Honored Father, and with it we curse human beings who are made in his image.
Blessing and cursing come out of the same mouth. My sacred family members, this should not be.
verses.html: Blessing and cursing come out of the same mouth. My sacred family members, this should not be.

verses.text: Does both sweet and bitter water come from the same spring?
Can olives and figs come from the same tree? Can a grapevine bear figs, my sacred family members? Not at all! And neither can saltwater be used to make water fresh again.
verses.html: Can olives and figs come from the same tree? Can a grapevine bear figs, my sacred family members? Not at all! And neither can saltwater be used to make water fresh again.

verses.heading: TRUE AND FALSE WISDOM / TRUE AND FALSE WISDOM
verses.text: Are any among you wise and understanding? Then show it in the way you live, doing good from a humble and wise heart.
But if your hearts are full of bitter envy and selfish desires, then stop boasting and speaking lies to cover up the truth about yourselves.
verses.html: But if your hearts are full of bitter envy and selfish desires, then stop boasting and speaking lies to cover up the truth about yourselves.

verses.text: This is not the kind of wisdom that comes down from the One Above Us All. Instead, it is from this world. It is unspiritual and of the evil one.
For where there is jealousy and selfish ways, you will also find confusion and all kinds of evil at work.

But the wisdom that comes from the One Above Us All is first of all pure, then peace-loving, gentle, full of mercy, and open to another’s way of seeing and thinking. People with this kind of wisdom are like trees filled with good fruit. They have open hearts with nothing to hide.
This wisdom will bring about a harvest of doing what is right, because they are peacemakers planting seeds of peace.

verses.heading: WARS, FIGHTS, AND ARGUMENTS / WARS, FIGHTS, AND ARGUMENTS
verses.text: Where do the wars, fights, and arguments among you come from? Do they not come from the selfish desires that wage war in your own bodies?

You want what you do not have, so you kill for it. You want what belongs to others, but you cannot get it from them, so you fight and wage war. You do not have because you do not ask the Great Spirit.
When you ask for things, you do not receive them because you ask for the wrong reasons, wanting to satisfy your own selfish desires.
You are unfaithful people! You must know that if you become friends with the ways of this world, you make yourself an enemy of the Great Spirit.
verses.html: You are unfaithful people! You must know that if you become friends with the ways of this world, you make yourself an enemy of the Great Spirit.

verses.heading: HUMBLE YOURSELVES / HUMBLE YOURSELVES
verses.text: Do you think our Sacred Teachings have no meaning when they tell us that Creator’s Spirit in us longs for us to be faithful and true to him?

But his gift of great kindness is more than enough, just as our Sacred Teachings also say, “The Great Spirit stands against the proud and arrogant, but he shows great kindness to the humble of heart.”
So humbly follow all of Creator’s ways. Make your stand against the evil trickster, and he will turn and run from you.
Draw near to the Great Spirit, and he will draw near to you. Wash your hands clean of your broken ways, and purify your hearts and minds from trying to walk two different roads.
Cry out in your misery. Be sad and weep. Turn your laughter into sadness, and your joy into tears.
Humble yourselves in the sight of the Great Spirit, and he will lift you up to a place of honor.
verses.html: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Great Spirit, and he will lift you up to a place of honor.

verses.heading: DO NOT ACCUSE EACH OTHER / DO NOT ACCUSE EACH OTHER
verses.text: My sacred family members, do not speak accusations against each other. If you do, you are putting yourselves above the law, deciding who is guilty or not. When you do this, you are acting against the law itself instead of doing what it says.
verses.html: My sacred family members, do not speak accusations against each other. If you do, you are putting yourselves above the law, deciding who is guilty or not. When you do this, you are acting against the law itself instead of doing what it says.

verses.text: There is only one true Lawgiver and Judge who has the power to decide who has done right or wrong. He is the one with the right to set people free or bring them to a bad end. So who are you to judge a fellow human being?
verses.html: There is only one true Lawgiver and Judge who has the power to decide who has done right or wrong. He is the one with the right to set people free or bring them to a bad end. So who are you to judge a fellow human being?

verses.heading: LOOK OUT FOR EVIL BOASTING / LOOK OUT FOR EVIL BOASTING
verses.text: Listen to me, you who say, “Today or tomorrow we will go to a trading post in some village. There we will stay for a year trading our goods and gaining more than we started with.”
You do not even know what tomorrow will bring. Your life is like the morning mist over a lake that is there for a short time and then gone.
verses.html: You do not even know what tomorrow will bring. Your life is like the morning mist over a lake that is there for a short time and then gone.

verses.text: Instead, here is what you should say, “If it is what Creator wants, then we will live and do these things.”
But as it stands, you are making prideful boasts. All such boasting is evil.
So then, the one who knows to do good but fails to do it is walking in broken ways.

verses.heading: A WARNING TO THOSE WITH GREAT POSSESSIONS / A WARNING TO THOSE WITH GREAT POSSESSIONS
verses.text: Listen to me, you who have great possessions, weep and howl over the times of trouble and sorrow that are coming your way.
Even now your treasured possessions are rotting away and moths are eating your fine garments.
Your gold and silver will waste away. It will be a witness against you and eat your flesh like fire. For you have piled up many possessions in the last days.
Behold! You have held back the goods you owed to the workers who harvest your crops. Their cries for justice have reached the ears of the Chief of Spirit Warriors.
verses.html: Behold! You have held back the goods you owed to the workers who harvest your crops. Their cries for justice have reached the ears of the Chief of Spirit Warriors.

verses.text: Your life on this earth has been one of getting for yourselves whatever you want to satisfy your selfish desires. You have fattened yourselves like an animal prepared for a day of slaughter.
verses.html: Your life on this earth has been one of getting for yourselves whatever you want to satisfy your selfish desires. You have fattened yourselves like an animal prepared for a day of slaughter.

verses.text: You have falsely accused and put to death the innocent, who did not even try to stand against you.

verses.heading: WAITING FOR HIS APPEARING / WAITING FOR HIS APPEARING
verses.text: So be patient, my sacred family members, until our Honored Chief appears. Look at the worker in the field who patiently waits for the seasonal rains to fall so the land can bring forth its fruits.
verses.html: So be patient, my sacred family members, until our Honored Chief appears. Look at the worker in the field who patiently waits for the seasonal rains to fall so the land can bring forth its fruits.

verses.text: In the same way, you must also be patient and stand firm, for the appearing of our Honored Chief is close at hand.
So then, my sacred family members, do not grumble against each other or you may be found guilty. Look! The Judge who decides is right outside, ready to come in.
verses.html: So then, my sacred family members, do not grumble against each other or you may be found guilty. Look! The Judge who decides is right outside, ready to come in.

verses.text: My sacred family members, follow in the footsteps of the prophets who spoke for the Great Spirit. Even in times of suffering, they remained patient and strong.
verses.html: My sacred family members, follow in the footsteps of the prophets who spoke for the Great Spirit. Even in times of suffering, they remained patient and strong.

verses.text: Look at how we honor those who have stood firm in troubled times. You have heard the story of Turns to Creator (Job), how he stood firm to the end and found the Great Spirit to be kind and merciful. The Great Spirit will do the same for you.
verses.html: Look at how we honor those who have stood firm in troubled times. You have heard the story of Turns to Creator (Job), how he stood firm to the end and found the Great Spirit to be kind and merciful. The Great Spirit will do the same for you.

verses.text: The chief thing I want to say to you, my sacred family members, is that you are not to make solemn promises. Do not promise by the spirit-world above, or by the earth below, or make a solemn promise in any other way. Your simple “yes” or “no” is enough. You may be found guilty if you say more.
verses.html: The chief thing I want to say to you, my sacred family members, is that you are not to make solemn promises. Do not promise by the spirit-world above, or by the earth below, or make a solemn promise in any other way. Your simple “yes” or “no” is enough. You may be found guilty if you say more.

verses.heading: THE POWER OF PRAYER / THE POWER OF PRAYER
verses.text: Are you suffering? Send up prayers. Are your hearts glad? Sing traditional songs of honor and praise.
Are any among you sick? Call on the elders of the sacred family to pray over them and smudge them with sweet-smelling smoke in the name of our Honored Chief.

When you send your voice to our Honored Chief, trusting in him, he will heal the sick ones and restore them to health. He will forgive and set free any who have been following their bad hearts and broken ways.
So admit your broken ways one to another and pray for each other that you may be healed. The prayer of one in good standing with Creator is powerful and good medicine.
verses.html: So admit your broken ways one to another and pray for each other that you may be healed. The prayer of one in good standing with Creator is powerful and good medicine.

verses.text: Great Spirit Is Creator (Elijah) was a weak human being, the same as we are. He prayed with much prayer that it would not rain, and for three winters and six moons no rain fell on the land.
Then, when he prayed for the rain to fall, down it came, and once again mother earth gave a harvest of good food.
verses.html: Then, when he prayed for the rain to fall, down it came, and once again mother earth gave a harvest of good food.

verses.heading: FINAL WORDS / FINAL WORDS
verses.text: My sacred family members, has any of you wandered from the truth? Has anyone helped you find the way back?
verses.html: My sacred family members, has any of you wandered from the truth? Has anyone helped you find the way back?

verses.text: If so, then let them know, the one who helps someone return from broken ways has rescued their soul from death and hidden the many paths that lead to broken ways. Aho! May it be so!
verses.html:
If so, then let them know, the one who helps someone return from broken ways has rescued their soul from death and hidden the many paths that lead to broken ways.
Aho! May it be so!

verses.heading: GREETINGS / GREETINGS
verses.text: From Stands on the Rock (Peter), a message bearer from Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One. To Creator’s chosen ones who have been scattered like seeds throughout Land of Black Waters (Pontus), Land of Pale Skins (Galatia), Land of Handsome Horses (Cappadocia), Land of the Rising Sun (Asia), and the territory of Rushing Storm (Bithynia), who live like strangers among them.
verses.html:
From Stands on the Rock (Peter), a message bearer from Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One.
To Creator’s chosen ones who have been scattered like seeds throughout Land of Black Waters (Pontus), Land of Pale Skins (Galatia), Land of Handsome Horses (Cappadocia), Land of the Rising Sun (Asia), and the territory of Rushing Storm (Bithynia), who live like strangers among them.

verses.text: Our Father the Great Spirit knew long ago that he would take you into his family. By his Spirit he is making you holy so you will obey Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One and be sprinkled with his lifeblood. May the gift of his great kindness and peace overflow to you.

verses.heading: SHARED BLESSINGS / SHARED BLESSINGS
verses.text: All blessings belong to the Great Spirit, the Father of our Honored Chief, Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One! In his great mercy, when he raised Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One from the dead, we were given new birth, and our hope came to life. We now share with the Chosen One all the blessings he has received.
These shared blessings are kept safe in the spirit-world above, where they will never grow old, become impure, or fade away.

verses.heading: THE TESTING OF YOUR TRUST / THE TESTING OF YOUR TRUST
verses.text: Creator’s plan to set you free and make you whole is ready to be fully revealed when the time for the end has come. Until then you are kept safe by trusting in Creator’s power.
You dance for joy now because you know that day is coming, even though for a short time you may have to walk a trail of tears because of the many kinds of troubles you are facing.
verses.html: You dance for joy now because you know that day is coming, even though for a short time you may have to walk a trail of tears because of the many kinds of troubles you are facing.

verses.text: These troubles will test the purity of your trust in him, just like fire tests the purity of gold. Your trust in him is worth more than gold that can fade away. After you have passed through the fire and come out pure, it will bring praise, honor, and shining-greatness to Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One when he is revealed.
verses.html: These troubles will test the purity of your trust in him, just like fire tests the purity of gold. Your trust in him is worth more than gold that can fade away. After you have passed through the fire and come out pure, it will bring praise, honor, and shining-greatness to Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One when he is revealed.

verses.text: You have never seen him, yet you love him. You cannot see him now, yet you trust him. This makes your heart so glad that you cannot find words beautiful enough, so you have to dance for joy.
For your trust in him is bringing you to the end of the trail, where your whole being will be set free and made whole.

verses.heading: FORETOLD BY THE PROPHETS / FORETOLD BY THE PROPHETS
verses.text: This time of being set free and made whole was foretold by the prophets, who prophesied about Creator’s gift of great kindness that would come to you. The prophets wondered about these things, so they searched deeply into the meaning of it all.

The Spirit of the Chosen One in them told them ahead of time about the sufferings of the Chosen One and the honor that would follow. They wondered whom the Spirit was speaking about and when these things would take place.

The Spirit made it known to them that the things they searched out were for you and not for themselves. You have now learned these things from those who told you the good story by the Holy Spirit, who was sent down from the spirit-world above. Even the spirit-messengers long to see and understand more about these things.

verses.heading: STAND READY IN YOUR MIND / STAND READY IN YOUR MIND
verses.text: In light of all of this, stand ready in your mind to face what is ahead. Think clearly and set all your hope on the gift of great kindness that will be yours when Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One is revealed.
Because you are the children of the Great Spirit, follow all his instructions. Do not walk with a bad heart, as you did in the past when you did not know the things you know now.
Walk in a sacred manner in everything you do. For you were called away from your old life by the Holy One, who walks ahead of you on a sacred path.
For it is written in our Sacred Teachings, “Be holy, for I am holy.”
verses.html: For it is written in our Sacred Teachings, “Be holy, for I am holy.”

verses.heading: THE PRICE HE PAID TO SET US FREE / THE PRICE HE PAID TO SET US FREE
verses.text: If you call on the Great Spirit as your Father, walk with great respect and awe for him on your journey through this life. Creator decides who has done right or wrong without favoring one person over another.
