verses.text: Keep yourselves deeply rooted in the love of the Great Spirit, as you keep looking and waiting for the mercy of our Honored Chief, Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One, who gives us the life of the world to come that never fades away, full of beauty and harmony.
verses.html: Keep yourselves deeply rooted in the love of the Great Spirit, as you keep looking and waiting for the mercy of our Honored Chief, Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One, who gives us the life of the world to come that never fades away, full of beauty and harmony.

verses.text: Show this same mercy to some among you who are doubting,
and rescue some as if you were snatching them from flames of fire. To others show mercy as you tremble in fear, hating the broken ways that have stained their regalia and ruined their lives.

verses.heading: CLOSING WORDS / CLOSING WORDS
verses.text: Now to the one who is able to keep you from stumbling, who can make you pure and blameless, so that with great joy you can stand before his bright-shining greatness.

To the one Great Spirit, who has set us free and made us whole through our Honored Chief Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One. Bright-shining greatness, beauty, power, and chiefly rule belong to him from the time before all days, today, and to the time beyond the end of all days. Aho! May it be so!
verses.html:
To the one Great Spirit, who has set us free and made us whole through our Honored Chief Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One. Bright-shining greatness, beauty, power, and chiefly rule belong to him from the time before all days, today, and to the time beyond the end of all days.
Aho! May it be so!

verses.heading: OPENING WORDS / OPENING WORDS
verses.text: Written down in this sacred scroll are the things the Great Spirit revealed to Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One. This great revealing was given to the ones who serve him, to show them what will soon happen. He sent his spirit-messenger to He Shows Goodwill (John), his sacred servant, to make this message known to him through signs, omens, and sacred visions.
verses.html: Written down in this sacred scroll are the things the Great Spirit revealed to Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One. This great revealing was given to the ones who serve him, to show them what will soon happen. He sent his spirit-messenger to He Shows Goodwill (John), his sacred servant, to make this message known to him through signs, omens, and sacred visions.

verses.text: He Shows Goodwill (John) as a truth teller wrote down everything he saw and heard as a witness to this message from the Great Spirit and the things told to him by Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One.
Creator’s blessing rests on the one who reads aloud the words of this prophecy, and on those who hear and take to heart what is written in it, for the time it speaks about is almost here.

verses.heading: THE MESSAGE BEGINS / THE MESSAGE BEGINS
verses.text: From He Shows Goodwill (John) to the seven sacred families in Land of the Rising Sun (Asia): I greet you with great kindness and peace from One Who Is and Was and Is to Come, and from the seven spirits who stand face to face with him as he sits in his seat of honor.

I also greet you from Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One. He is the honorable witness, the first to rise from among the dead, and the Grand Chief over all who rule on earth. All honor belongs to the one who loves us, the one who, by giving up his own lifeblood, set us free from our bad hearts and broken ways.

He has made us to be chiefs of a sacred nation of holy men and women who represent the good road of his Father the Great Spirit. All honor and power belong to him from the ages past to the time beyond the end of all days. Aho! May it be so!

verses.heading: CLOUD RIDER IS COMING / CLOUD RIDER IS COMING
verses.text: Behold! He comes riding on the clouds! Every eye will see him, even the ones who pierced him. When all the tribes of the land see him, their hearts will be pierced through with sorrow and fall to the ground. Aho! May it be so.
“I am Alpha and Omega, the one who is before all things and beyond all things,” says the Great Spirit Chief. “I am One Who Is and Was and Is to Come, the All-Powerful One.”

verses.heading: ON THE ISLAND OF WALKING PLACE / ON THE ISLAND OF WALKING PLACE
verses.text: I, He Shows Goodwill (John), am your brother in the sacred family and one who walks a path of suffering with you as we walk the good road with firm steps following Creator Sets Free (Jesus) the Chosen One. I had been banished to the island called Walking Place (Patmos) because I had spoken the truth about Creator Sets Free (Jesus) and his message from the Great Spirit.

verses.heading: A LOUD VOICE SPEAKS / A LOUD VOICE SPEAKS
verses.text: I was taken up into the spirit world on the day we gather in honor of our Great Chief. I heard a loud voice from behind me that sounded like an eagle bone whistle.
verses.html: I was taken up into the spirit world on the day we gather in honor of our Great Chief. I heard a loud voice from behind me that sounded like an eagle bone whistle.

verses.text: The voice said, “Write down in a scroll the things that you see. Send this scroll to the seven sacred family gatherings in Land of the Rising Sun (Asia). “Send it to the sacred family gatherings in Village of Desire (Ephesus), Village of Bitter Herbs (Smyrna), First in Courage (Pergamum), High Rock House (Thyatira), Safe Place (Sardis), Family of Friends (Philadelphia), and The People Will Decide (Laodicea).”

verses.heading: THE TRUE HUMAN BEING IS REVEALED / THE TRUE HUMAN BEING IS REVEALED
verses.text: I turned around to see the voice that was speaking to me. When I turned, I saw seven golden lampstands.
The lampstands encircled one who looked like a True Human Being. His regalia was a robe that reached all the way to his feet. He wore a golden sash that was wrapped across his chest.
The hair on his head was as white as the tip of an eagle’s tail feathers, as white as freshly fallen snow, and his eyes blazed like flames of fire.
His feet glowed like molten bronze purified in a furnace of fire, and his voice roared like the sound of great rushing waters.
In his right hand he was holding seven stars. Out from his mouth came a sharp, two-edged long knife, and his face shone with the full strength of the sun.

verses.heading: I AM FIRST AND LAST / I AM FIRST AND LAST
verses.text: When I saw him, I dropped to the ground and lay at his feet as a dead man. He put his right hand on me and said, “Do not fear!
I am first and last, the Living One, who was dead, and now, behold! I am alive, never to die again. And in my hands I hold the power to free people from the Dark Underworld of Death (Hades).
“So then,” he said to me, “Write down the things you have just seen and the things that will be shown to you.

I will tell you the mystery of the seven stars you saw in my right hand and the mystery of the seven golden lampstands. The seven stars are the messengers of the seven sacred family gatherings, and the seven lampstands are the seven sacred families.

verses.heading: TO VILLAGE OF DESIRE / TO VILLAGE OF DESIRE
verses.text: “Write this to the messenger of the sacred family that gathers in Village of Desire (Ephesus): These are the words of the one who holds the seven stars in his right hand, the one who walks among the seven golden lampstands:

I know what you have been doing, how hard you have worked, and the rough path you have walked with firm steps. I also know that you do not put up with evil and worthless ways. You have put to the test the ones who falsely call themselves message bearers and have proven them to be liars who speak with forked tongues.
verses.html: I know what you have been doing, how hard you have worked, and the rough path you have walked with firm steps. I also know that you do not put up with evil and worthless ways. You have put to the test the ones who falsely call themselves message bearers and have proven them to be liars who speak with forked tongues.

verses.text: I know you have never grown tired of representing me, even when thorns grew across the path.
But I have against you this one thing—you have walked away from the love you had at first.
So remember what made you stumble, go back and find that first love, and do what needs to be done. Unless you change your thinking about this, I will have to come and remove your lampstand.
But you have this in your favor: like me, you hate what the Rulers of the People (Nicolaitans) do.

Let the one who has ears hear and do what the Spirit is saying to the sacred families. To the ones who win the victory, I will give them fruit to eat from the tree of life that grows in Creator’s Beautiful Garden.

verses.heading: TO VILLAGE OF BITTER HERBS / TO VILLAGE OF BITTER HERBS
verses.text: “Write this to the messenger of the sacred family that gathers in Village of Bitter Herbs (Smyrna): These are the words of the one who is the first and last, who died and came back to life.

I know that you have walked a troubled path and that you are poor, but spiritually you are rich. I also know the lies spoken against you by those who claim to be Tribal Members, but they are not. They are a tribal gathering house for Accuser (Satan), and not true-hearted Tribal Members.
verses.html: I know that you have walked a troubled path and that you are poor, but spiritually you are rich. I also know the lies spoken against you by those who claim to be Tribal Members, but they are not. They are a tribal gathering house for Accuser (Satan), and not true-hearted Tribal Members.

verses.text: Do not fear the suffering you must soon face. The evil trickster snake will put you to the test. I tell you, he will have some of you thrown into a prison house, and you will walk a troubled path for ten days. Even if you must face death, stay true to the path, and I will honor you with a headdress of life that has many feathers.
Let the one who has ears hear and do what the Spirit is saying to the sacred families. The ones who win the victory will not be hurt at all by the second death.

verses.heading: TO VILLAGE OF FIRST IN COURAGE / TO VILLAGE OF FIRST IN COURAGE
verses.text: “Write this to the messenger of the sacred family that gathers in the village of First in Courage (Pergamum): These are the words of the one who has the sharp, two-edged long knife:

I know you live where Accuser (Satan) rules. You have stood strong and true, representing my name in the days when Looks Like His Father (Antipas), my truth teller, was killed in your village where Accuser (Satan) makes his home. Even then you refused to turn your back on me and stayed true to my good road.

But even so, I have a few things against you: Some among you walk in the teachings of People Destroyer (Balaam), who instructed People Swallower (Balak) to put stumbling stones before the children of Wrestles with Creator (Israel). He tempted them to ceremonially eat food that had been offered to spirit-images and to give themselves to sexual impurity.
Like them, you also have among you some who follow the teachings of the Rulers of the People (Nicolaitans).
Unless you change your thinking about these things, I will come suddenly to you and make war against them with the words of my mouth that will cut like a two-edged long knife.

Let the one who has ears hear and do what the Spirit is saying to the sacred families. I will give the mysterious bread to the ones who win the victory. I will also give them a new name carved into a white stone. A name known only to the one who receives it.

verses.heading: TO VILLAGE OF HIGH ROCK HOUSE / TO VILLAGE OF HIGH ROCK HOUSE
verses.text: “Write this to the messenger of the sacred family that gathers in the village of High Rock House (Thyatira): These are the words of the Son of the Great Spirit, who has eyes that blaze like flames of fire and feet that glow like molten bronze:
I know how hard you work, how truly you love, how faithfully you serve others, and how you never give up walking the good road. I also know that you are doing even more now than you did at first.

But even so, I have something against you. You permit Bad Spirit Woman (Jezebel), the one who calls herself a prophetess, to teach my sacred servants. She takes them down a path of sexual impurity and teaches them to ceremonially eat food that has been offered to spirit-images.
I have given her time to return to the right way of thinking, but she would not change her mind about her impure ways.
Behold, I am putting her into a bed of sorrow and suffering. And all who participate with her will also suffer greatly, unless they turn from her impure ways.

I will turn her spiritual children over to death. Then all the sacred families will know that I am the one who looks into the thoughts and sees the hearts of all people. I will make sure each person is given what is deserved for all that he has done.
verses.html: I will turn her spiritual children over to death. Then all the sacred families will know that I am the one who looks into the thoughts and sees the hearts of all people. I will make sure each person is given what is deserved for all that he has done.

verses.text: But to the rest of you who live in the village of High Rock House (Thyatira), the ones who do not walk in her ways and know nothing about the so-called deep things of Accuser (Satan), I require nothing more of you,
except to say, Hold tightly to what you already have until I come to you.

To the ones who win the victory and keep walking in my ways to the end of the trail, I will give them the right to rule over all nations with an unbreakable iron chief’s staff, one that can break pots made of clay into pieces.
verses.html: To the ones who win the victory and keep walking in my ways to the end of the trail, I will give them the right to rule over all nations with an unbreakable iron chief’s staff, one that can break pots made of clay into pieces.

verses.text: This is the same right my Father has given to me. I will also gift them with the morning star.
Let the one who has ears hear and do what the Spirit is saying to the sacred families.

verses.heading: TO VILLAGE OF SAFE PLACE / TO VILLAGE OF SAFE PLACE
verses.text: “Write this to the messenger of the sacred family that gathers in the village of Safe Place (Sardis): These are the words of the one who has the seven spirits of the Great Mystery and the seven stars: I know what you have been doing. I know you have a reputation of being alive. But while others may see you as alive, I see you as dead.
Wake up! Do not let death defeat you! Strengthen those things that remain alive before it is too late. For I can see that you have not finished what the Great Spirit has called you to do.

So remember what you have been given and what you have heard. Return to the right way of thinking. Walk with firm steps and do what needs to be done. But if you fail to wake up, you will not be prepared for my coming. Then for you I will be like a thief who comes when you do not expect it.

But there are a few among you in the village of Safe Place (Sardis) with a good reputation, who have not stained their regalia. Dressed in pure white regalia, they will dance by my side in the circle of life, for they are worthy of this honor.

All others who win this victory will also wear pure white regalia. I will not remove their names from the book of life, and I will represent them by speaking their names before my Father and his spirit-messengers.
Let the one who has ears hear and do what the Spirit is saying to the sacred families.

verses.heading: TO VILLAGE OF FAMILY OF FRIENDS / TO VILLAGE OF FAMILY OF FRIENDS
verses.text: “Write this to the messenger of the sacred family that gathers in the village of Family of Friends (Philadelphia): These are the words of the holy and true One, the one who has the rightful power of Much Loved One (David). When he opens the way, no one can close it, and when he closes the way, no one else can open it. This is what the holy and true One has to say:

I know what you have been doing. Behold! I have opened a way before you that no one can block. Even though your strength is small, you have stayed true to my message and have not turned away from representing me.

Look at what I will do to the members of the gathering house of Accuser (Satan) who falsely represent themselves as true-hearted Tribal Members. I will cause them to humble themselves before you to honor you. I will make sure they clearly see that I have loved you.

Because you have walked with firm steps and stayed true to my message, I will watch over you and keep you safe from the time of great trouble that is coming upon the world, to test the ones who walk the land.
It will not be long, for I am coming soon. Hold on to what you already have with a strong hand. Then no one will be able to take your headdress of honor away from you.
verses.html: It will not be long, for I am coming soon. Hold on to what you already have with a strong hand. Then no one will be able to take your headdress of honor away from you.

verses.text: To the ones who win the victory I will make them a strong pole in the sacred lodge of my Father the Great Spirit—and there they will remain. I will carve into them the name of my Father the Great Spirit and the name of his sacred village that comes down from the world above—the new Village of Peace (Jerusalem). I will also carve into them my own new name.
verses.html: To the ones who win the victory I will make them a strong pole in the sacred lodge of my Father the Great Spirit—and there they will remain. I will carve into them the name of my Father the Great Spirit and the name of his sacred village that comes down from the world above—the new Village of Peace (Jerusalem). I will also carve into them my own new name.

verses.text: Let the one who has ears hear and do what the Spirit is saying to the sacred families.

verses.heading: TO THE VILLAGE OF THE PEOPLE WILL DECIDE / TO THE VILLAGE OF THE PEOPLE WILL DECIDE
verses.text: “Write this to the messenger of the sacred family that meets in the village of The People Will Decide (Laodicea): These are the words of Heart Speaker, the one who is the trustworthy and honest truth teller. He is the wellspring and chief of all the Great Spirit has created:
I know what you have been doing, and that spiritually you are neither cold nor hot. How I wish you were either cold or hot!
verses.html: I know what you have been doing, and that spiritually you are neither cold nor hot. How I wish you were either cold or hot!

verses.text: But because you are only warm, neither hot nor cold, I am about to vomit you out of my mouth.

The reason for this is that you say, ‘I have acquired great possessions, more than I could ever need.’ But you cannot see that you are to be pitied, for spiritually you are full of misery—poor and blind and naked.
verses.html: The reason for this is that you say, ‘I have acquired great possessions, more than I could ever need.’ But you cannot see that you are to be pitied, for spiritually you are full of misery—poor and blind and naked.

verses.text: I counsel you to acquire from me gold that has been purified by fire, and then you will truly have great possessions. You must also acquire from me pure white regalia, to hide the shame of your nakedness, and healing ointment to put on your eyes, so you can see.
It is from my love that I speak sharply to you, so that you will learn to follow my ways. And then from your heart you will return to my right ways of thinking and doing.
I stand before the entrance of your tipi, asking you to welcome me in. If any of you welcome me in, I will sit down with you, and we will share a good meal together.
I will give the ones who win the victory the right to sit with me on my seat of honor in the same way that I also won the victory and sat down with my Father on his seat of honor.
Let the one who has ears hear and do what the Spirit is saying to the sacred families.”

verses.heading: THE SACRED VISION BEGINS / THE SACRED VISION BEGINS
verses.text: After this I looked up and in my sacred vision I saw an opening into the spirit-world above. I heard the voice of the one who had spoken to me at first. The voice that sounded like an eagle bone whistle. “Come up here,” the voice said, “and I will show you the things that will take place following what you have seen and heard.”
verses.html:
After this I looked up and in my sacred vision I saw an opening into the spirit-world above. I heard the voice of the one who had spoken to me at first. The voice that sounded like an eagle bone whistle.
“Come up here,” the voice said, “and I will show you the things that will take place following what you have seen and heard.”

verses.heading: A VISION OF THE SEAT OF HONOR / A VISION OF THE SEAT OF HONOR
verses.text: Right then, in my sacred vision, I was taken up through the opening into the spirit-world above. I looked and saw a seat of honor in the world above—and someone was seated on it!
verses.html: Right then, in my sacred vision, I was taken up through the opening into the spirit-world above. I looked and saw a seat of honor in the world above—and someone was seated on it!

verses.text: The one who sat on it had the appearance of a fiery red but clear crystal stone. A rainbow that looked crystal green encircled the seat of honor.
Encircling the seat of honor were twenty-four elders sitting on twenty-four seats of honor. They wore pure white regalia and golden headdresses.

verses.heading: THE SEVEN SPIRITS OF THE GREAT MYSTERY / THE SEVEN SPIRITS OF THE GREAT MYSTERY
verses.text: From the seat of honor came flashes of lightning and rolling thunder. There were seven torches of fire burning before the seat of honor, which are the seven spirits of the Great Mystery.
Before the seat of honor there was what looked like a great sea, smooth and crystal clear. Four living spirit animals, with eyes in the front and back, closely encircled the seat of honor.
verses.html:
Before the seat of honor there was what looked like a great sea, smooth and crystal clear.
Four living spirit animals, with eyes in the front and back, closely encircled the seat of honor.

verses.heading: THE SPIRIT ANIMALS ARE REVEALED / THE SPIRIT ANIMALS ARE REVEALED
verses.text: The first spirit animal was like a lion. The second spirit animal was like a young bison. The third spirit animal had the face of a human being. And the fourth spirit animal was like a soaring eagle.
verses.html: The first spirit animal was like a lion. The second spirit animal was like a young bison. The third spirit animal had the face of a human being. And the fourth spirit animal was like a soaring eagle.

verses.text: These four spirit animals each had six wings and were covered with eyes all around and even under their wings. Day and night they never stop saying, “Holy, holy, holy is the all-powerful Great Spirit, One Who Is and Was and Is to Come!”
verses.html: These four spirit animals each had six wings and were covered with eyes all around and even under their wings. Day and night they never stop saying, “Holy, holy, holy is the all-powerful Great Spirit, One Who Is and Was and Is to Come!”

verses.text: The spirit animals give shining-greatness and honor and thanks to the one who sits in the seat of honor, all to the one who lived before all days and lives beyond the end of all days. Then the twenty-four elders humble themselves, remove their headdresses, and offer them to the one who sits on the seat of honor.
verses.html: The spirit animals give shining-greatness and honor and thanks to the one who sits in the seat of honor, all to the one who lived before all days and lives beyond the end of all days. Then the twenty-four elders humble themselves, remove their headdresses, and offer them to the one who sits on the seat of honor.

verses.text: “All honor belongs to you, O Great Spirit Chief,” the twenty-four elders say with one voice. “For you are the one who made everything there is. It is from your sacred vision that all things came into being and were created!”

verses.heading: A SCROLL WITH SEVEN SEALS / A SCROLL WITH SEVEN SEALS
verses.text: In my sacred vision, I then saw a scroll resting on the right hand of the one sitting on the seat of honor. The scroll was sealed with seven seals, and full of words inside and out.
verses.html: In my sacred vision, I then saw a scroll resting on the right hand of the one sitting on the seat of honor. The scroll was sealed with seven seals, and full of words inside and out.

verses.text: Then I saw a powerful spirit-messenger with a thundering voice saying for all to hear, “Who has gained the honor to take the scroll and break open its seven seals?”
verses.html: Then I saw a powerful spirit-messenger with a thundering voice saying for all to hear, “Who has gained the honor to take the scroll and break open its seven seals?”

verses.text: But no one in the spirit-world above or on the earth below or under the earth was able to open the scroll or see what was inside.
Many tears ran down my face as I wept and cried because there was no one who had gained the honor to open the scroll and look inside.
verses.html: Many tears ran down my face as I wept and cried because there was no one who had gained the honor to open the scroll and look inside.

verses.heading: THE LION WHO IS THE LAMB / THE LION WHO IS THE LAMB
verses.text: But one of the elders came to me. “Do not weep!” he said. “Look, there is the Lion from the tribe of Give Him Praise (Judah), the one who has sprouted from the Root of Much Loved One (David). He has won the victory and gained the honor to take the scroll and break open its seven seals.”
verses.html: But one of the elders came to me. “Do not weep!” he said. “Look, there is the Lion from the tribe of Give Him Praise (Judah), the one who has sprouted from the Root of Much Loved One (David). He has won the victory and gained the honor to take the scroll and break open its seven seals.”

verses.text: Then I looked and saw a Lamb that looked as if he had been violently killed standing in the center near the seat of honor. He stood encircled by the four living spirit animals and the elders. The Lamb had seven horns and seven eyes. These are the seven spirits of Creator that he has sent out into all the earth.
verses.html: Then I looked and saw a Lamb that looked as if he had been violently killed standing in the center near the seat of honor. He stood encircled by the four living spirit animals and the elders. The Lamb had seven horns and seven eyes. These are the seven spirits of Creator that he has sent out into all the earth.

verses.text: Then the Lamb stepped forward and took the scroll from the right hand of the one who sat in the seat of honor.

When he took the scroll, the four living spirit animals and the twenty-four elders all humbled themselves before the Lamb to honor him. They each held a stringed musical instrument and a golden smudge bowl full of sweet-smelling smoke, which are the prayers of Creator’s holy people.
verses.html: When he took the scroll, the four living spirit animals and the twenty-four elders all humbled themselves before the Lamb to honor him. They each held a stringed musical instrument and a golden smudge bowl full of sweet-smelling smoke, which are the prayers of Creator’s holy people.

verses.heading: A NEW SONG FOR THE LAMB / A NEW SONG FOR THE LAMB
verses.text: Then they sang a new song with these words: “To you belongs the honor to take hold of the sacred scroll and break open its seven seals, for you died as a lamb led to the slaughter. You paid the highest price by offering your lifeblood to bring people back to the Great Spirit from every tribe and language and people and nation.
verses.html:
Then they sang a new song with these words:
“To you belongs the honor to take hold of the sacred scroll and break open its seven seals, for you died as a lamb led to the slaughter. You paid the highest price by offering your lifeblood to bring people back to the Great Spirit from every tribe and language and people and nation.

verses.text: You have made them chiefs of a sacred nation of holy men and women who will give guidance to all the earth as they represent the good road of the Great Spirit.”

verses.heading: SPIRIT-MESSENGERS HONOR THE LAMB / SPIRIT-MESSENGERS HONOR THE LAMB
verses.text: Then I heard the sound of countless numbers of spirit-messengers, thousands upon thousands of them, and ten thousand times ten thousand. They made a grand circle around the seat of honor, the spirit animals, and the elders.
verses.html: Then I heard the sound of countless numbers of spirit-messengers, thousands upon thousands of them, and ten thousand times ten thousand. They made a grand circle around the seat of honor, the spirit animals, and the elders.

verses.text: With one thunderous voice, they sang, “The Lamb that was violently killed has been honored with power, riches, wisdom, chiefly rule, respect, blessing, greatness, and praise!”

Then I heard all of creation, those in the spirit-world above, on the earth below, under the earth, and in the sea of great waters. They were singing, “All blessing, respect, honor, and chiefly rule belong to the one who sits on the seat of honor and to the Lamb, to the time beyond the end of all days!”
Then the four spirit animals said, “Aho! May it be so!” And the elders humbled themselves before the Great Spirit and before the Lamb to give them the honor they deserved.
verses.html: Then the four spirit animals said, “Aho! May it be so!” And the elders humbled themselves before the Great Spirit and before the Lamb to give them the honor they deserved.

verses.heading: A WHITE HORSE AND ITS RIDER / A WHITE HORSE AND ITS RIDER
verses.text: I watched as the Lamb broke open the first of the seven seals. Then I heard the first of the four spirit animals speak. “Come forth!” it said with a voice of thunder.
verses.html:
I watched as the Lamb broke open the first of the seven seals. Then I heard the first of the four spirit animals speak.
“Come forth!” it said with a voice of thunder.

verses.text: And when I looked, I saw a white horse with its rider holding a bow. He was given a headdress, and he rode out as a conqueror to conquer again.

verses.heading: A RED HORSE AND ITS RIDER / A RED HORSE AND ITS RIDER
verses.text: When the Lamb broke open the second seal, I heard the voice of the second spirit animal. “Come forth!” it said.
verses.html:
When the Lamb broke open the second seal, I heard the voice of the second spirit animal.
“Come forth!” it said.

verses.text: Another horse came forth—fiery red. Its rider was permitted to take away peace from the land, so that war and violence would break out among the people. And he was given a great and powerful long knife.

verses.heading: A BLACK HORSE AND ITS RIDER / A BLACK HORSE AND ITS RIDER
verses.text: When the Lamb broke open the third seal, I heard the voice of the third spirit animal. “Come forth!” it said. I looked, and there before me was a black horse. Its rider had balancing scales in his hand.
verses.html:
When the Lamb broke open the third seal, I heard the voice of the third spirit animal.
“Come forth!” it said.
I looked, and there before me was a black horse. Its rider had balancing scales in his hand.

verses.text: From the center of the four spirit animals, I heard a sound like a voice. “A small basket of wild rice or three small baskets of corn to trade for a day’s work,” the voice said. “But do no harm to the olive oil and the wine.”
verses.html:
From the center of the four spirit animals, I heard a sound like a voice.
“A small basket of wild rice or three small baskets of corn to trade for a day’s work,” the voice said. “But do no harm to the olive oil and the wine.”

verses.heading: A PALE HORSE AND ITS RIDER / A PALE HORSE AND ITS RIDER
verses.text: When the Lamb broke open the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth spirit animal. “Come forth!” it said.

I looked, and there before me was a sickly pale-green horse. The name of its rider was Death. Following close behind him was the Dark Underworld of Death (Hades). They were given power over a fourth of the land, to kill with the long knife, hunger, deadly disease, and by the wild beasts of the land.
verses.html: I looked, and there before me was a sickly pale-green horse. The name of its rider was Death. Following close behind him was the Dark Underworld of Death (Hades). They were given power over a fourth of the land, to kill with the long knife, hunger, deadly disease, and by the wild beasts of the land.

verses.heading: THE VOICE OF THE HONORED DEAD / THE VOICE OF THE HONORED DEAD
verses.text: When the Lamb broke open the fifth seal, I looked under the sacred altar and saw the souls of the ones who had been killed for remaining true to the message Creator had given them.
They cried out with a loud voice, “O Honored One, who is holy and true! How long will it be before you right the wrong done against us by the people in the land who have shed our blood?”

Then each of them was gifted with white regalia and told to rest for a little while longer. For there were still a number of their brothers and sisters—who also serve the Great Spirit—who must be killed in the same manner they were.

verses.heading: THE DAY OF FIERCE ANGER HAS COME / THE DAY OF FIERCE ANGER HAS COME
verses.text: When the Lamb broke open the sixth seal, I looked, and there was a great earthquake. The sun became as dark as a black cloth, the full moon became blood red,
and, like wild figs flung from a tree shaken by a fierce wind, the stars in the sky fell down on the land.
The sky went away like a scroll being rolled up and set to the side. And every mountain and island was moved from its place.
The chiefs who ruled the land, the headmen and the war chiefs, the rich and powerful, and everyone, slave or free, hid themselves in caves and behind the rocks in the mountains.
“Fall on us!” they said to the mountains and rocks. “Hide us from the face of the one who sits on the seat of honor and from the anger of the Lamb.
For the great day of their fierce anger has come, and who is able to stand against them?”
verses.html: For the great day of their fierce anger has come, and who is able to stand against them?”

verses.heading: THE FOUR WINDS ARE HELD BACK / THE FOUR WINDS ARE HELD BACK
verses.text: After this I saw four spirit-messengers standing at the four corners of the land. They were holding back the four winds of the earth to keep them from blowing on the land, on the sea, or against any tree.

Then I saw another spirit-messenger rising from the place where the sun rises, holding the branding iron of the living Creator. With a loud voice the messenger called out to the four spirit-messengers who were permitted to harm the land and the sea.

verses.heading: THE SEALING OF THE SERVANTS OF CREATOR / THE SEALING OF THE SERVANTS OF CREATOR
verses.text: “Bring no harm to the land, sea, or trees,” the messenger instructed them, “until we have sealed the mark of the Great Spirit on the foreheads of the ones who serve him.”
verses.html: “Bring no harm to the land, sea, or trees,” the messenger instructed them, “until we have sealed the mark of the Great Spirit on the foreheads of the ones who serve him.”

verses.text: I then heard the number that would be sealed—one hundred forty-four thousand—from all of the tribes of children of Wrestles with Creator (Israel).

Twelve thousand were sealed from each of the tribes named and represented here: Give Him Praise (Judah), Son of My Vision (Reuben), Counting Many Coups (Gad), Walks with a Glad Heart (Asher), He Will Wrestle (Naphtali), He Made Them Forget (Manasseh), Creator Hears (Simeon), He Brings Together (Levi), He Is My Reward (Issachar), Honored Dwelling (Zebulun), Creator Gives More (Joseph), Son of My Right Hand (Benjamin).

verses.heading: EVERY TRIBE AND LANGUAGE / EVERY TRIBE AND LANGUAGE
verses.text: After this I saw a great crowd of people, too many to count, from every nation, tribe, clan, and language. They were standing before the seat of honor and before the Lamb, dressed in pure white regalia, holding palm tree branches in their hands.
They lifted their voices and shouted, “The power to set us free and make us whole belongs to the Great Spirit who sits upon the seat of honor, and to the Lamb!”

All the spirit-messengers who encircled the seat of honor, along with the elders and the four living spirit animals, humbled themselves and fell face down on the ground before the Great Spirit to give him the honor that he deserves.
verses.html: All the spirit-messengers who encircled the seat of honor, along with the elders and the four living spirit animals, humbled themselves and fell face down on the ground before the Great Spirit to give him the honor that he deserves.

verses.text: “Aho! It is so!” they said with one voice. “Praise and honor and wisdom and respect and power and strength belong to the Great Spirit to the time beyond the end of all days! Aho! It is so!”
verses.html: “Aho! It is so!” they said with one voice. “Praise and honor and wisdom and respect and power and strength belong to the Great Spirit to the time beyond the end of all days! Aho! It is so!”

verses.heading: WHO ARE THESE PEOPLE? / WHO ARE THESE PEOPLE?
verses.text: Then one of the elders spoke to me, “Who are these people who are dressed in white regalia? And from where did they come?”

“Honored one,” I said to him, “you must know.” Then he said to me, “These are the ones who have come through the time of great trouble and suffering. They have washed their regalia in the lifeblood shed by the Lamb, making their regalia pure white.
verses.html:
“Honored one,” I said to him, “you must know.”
Then he said to me, “These are the ones who have come through the time of great trouble and suffering. They have washed their regalia in the lifeblood shed by the Lamb, making their regalia pure white.

verses.text: “Because of this they stand before the seat of honor, and they serve the Great Spirit day and night in the inner court of his sacred lodge. The one who sits on the seat of honor will spread his sacred tent over them and cover them in the shadow of his wings.
Never again will they hunger or thirst or suffer under the heat of the desert sun.
verses.html: Never again will they hunger or thirst or suffer under the heat of the desert sun.

verses.text: “The Lamb at the center of the seat of honor will watch over them like a shepherd watches over his sheep. He will guide them to springs of life-giving water, and there the Great Spirit will perform the wiping of tears ceremony for each of them.”

verses.heading: SILENCE IN THE WORLD ABOVE / SILENCE IN THE WORLD ABOVE
verses.text: When the Lamb broke open the seventh seal, a powerful silence fell on the spirit-world above that remained for about half an hour.
verses.html: When the Lamb broke open the seventh seal, a powerful silence fell on the spirit-world above that remained for about half an hour.

verses.text: Then I saw the seven spirit-messengers that stand before the Great Spirit. They were given seven eagle bone whistles.

verses.heading: SMOKE AND PRAYERS GO UP / SMOKE AND PRAYERS GO UP
verses.text: Another spirit-messenger, holding a golden smudge bowl in his hands, came and stood before the sacred altar. He was given much incense to burn as a sweet-smelling smoke offering above the sacred golden altar and offer it up along with the prayers of all the holy ones.
verses.html: Another spirit-messenger, holding a golden smudge bowl in his hands, came and stood before the sacred altar. He was given much incense to burn as a sweet-smelling smoke offering above the sacred golden altar and offer it up along with the prayers of all the holy ones.

verses.text: From the golden smudge bowl in the hand of the spirit-messenger the sweet-smelling smoke, mixed with the prayers of Creator’s holy ones, began to rise to the Great Spirit.

verses.heading: PURIFYING FIRE / PURIFYING FIRE
verses.text: Then the spirit-messenger filled the smudge bowl with fiery coals from the sacred altar and threw it down on the land. I heard the crashing and rolling thunder and saw flashes of lightning, and the earth began to shake.
Then the seven spirit-messengers who were holding the seven eagle bone whistles got ready to sound them.

verses.heading: THE SOUNDING OF THE EAGLE BONE WHISTLES / THE SOUNDING OF THE EAGLE BONE WHISTLES
verses.text: The first spirit-messenger sounded his eagle bone whistle, and hail and fire mixed with blood came out from the altar and were thrown down on the land. A third part of the land was burned with fire, and a third of the trees, and all the green grass.
verses.html: The first spirit-messenger sounded his eagle bone whistle, and hail and fire mixed with blood came out from the altar and were thrown down on the land. A third part of the land was burned with fire, and a third of the trees, and all the green grass.

verses.text: The second spirit-messenger sounded his eagle bone whistle, and what looked like a great mountain burning like a wildfire was thrown into the sea. A third of the waters turned into blood,
a third of all the living sea creatures died, and a third of the sea-canoes sank.
The third spirit-messenger sounded his eagle bone whistle, and from the sky came a great star flaming like a torch. The flaming star fell down on a third of the rivers and on the springs of water.
The name of the star was Bitterness, and a third of the waters became bitter, and many people died because the water had been made bitter.

The fourth spirit-messenger sounded his eagle bone whistle, and a third of the sun, moon, and the stars were struck with darkness. So for a third of the day the sun gave no light, and for a third of the night the moon and stars did not shine.

Then I heard the screech of an eagle above me, so I looked up and saw an eagle soaring in the sky. “Warning, warning, warning!” the eagle screeched, “to those who live on the land, because of the remaining eagle bone whistles to be sounded by the last three spirit-messengers!”

verses.heading: THE BOTTOMLESS PIT IS OPENED / THE BOTTOMLESS PIT IS OPENED
verses.text: The fifth spirit-messenger sounded his eagle bone whistle, and I saw a star falling to earth from the spirit-world above. The star was given the power to open the way to the deep, dark underworld.
The star opened the way, and smoke began to rise from the pit, like smoke from a great fiery furnace. The air was filled with the smoke, and the sun was darkened.

verses.heading: FIERCE GRASSHOPPERS EMERGE / FIERCE GRASSHOPPERS EMERGE
verses.text: Out of the smoke came fierce giant grasshoppers on the land. They were given power to sting like earthly scorpions.
verses.html: Out of the smoke came fierce giant grasshoppers on the land. They were given power to sting like earthly scorpions.

verses.text: They were told not to harm any of the earth’s grass or any green plant or tree, but only the human beings who had not been marked on their foreheads with the seal of the Great Spirit.
They were not permitted to kill anyone, but only to bring them pain and suffering for five moons—pain like the sting of a scorpion.
In those days people will seek death but will not find it. They will long to die, but death will run and hide from them.
verses.html: In those days people will seek death but will not find it. They will long to die, but death will run and hide from them.

verses.text: The grasshoppers looked like warhorses prepared for battle. They wore golden headdresses, and their faces looked human.
They had hair like a woman and teeth like a mountain lion.
verses.html: They had hair like a woman and teeth like a mountain lion.

verses.text: They wore breastplates of iron, and their wings sounded like many horses galloping into battle.
Their tails were like a scorpion’s, and their sting had the power to greatly wound people for five moons.

Their war-chief is the spirit-messenger of the deep dark underworld. The name of the war-chief in our tribal language is Abaddon, meaning Destroyer, and in the language of the Outside Nations his name is Apollyon, also meaning Destroyer.
The first time of terrible pain and suffering has passed, but two more times of terrible pain and suffering will soon follow.

verses.heading: A GREAT ARMY OF MANY HORSEMEN / A GREAT ARMY OF MANY HORSEMEN
verses.text: When the sixth spirit-messenger sounded an eagle bone whistle, I heard a voice coming from the four horns of the golden altar that is before the Great Spirit.
The voice spoke to the spirit-messenger, saying, “Unleash the four spirit-messengers who are bound at the great river called Much Fruit (Euphrates).”
Then the four spirit-messengers who had been held ready for that very hour and day and moon and year were unleashed to kill a third of humankind.
I heard the number of this great herd of horse riders. It was twice ten thousand multiplied by ten thousand.

verses.heading: THE APPEARANCE OF THE HORSES AND RIDERS / THE APPEARANCE OF THE HORSES AND RIDERS
verses.text: In my sacred vision I could see the appearance of the riders and their horses. The riders wore breastplates that were fiery red, smoky blue, and yellow like sulfur that burns. The horses had heads like mountain lions, and out from their mouths came fire, smoke, and burning sulfur.
verses.html: In my sacred vision I could see the appearance of the riders and their horses. The riders wore breastplates that were fiery red, smoky blue, and yellow like sulfur that burns. The horses had heads like mountain lions, and out from their mouths came fire, smoke, and burning sulfur.

verses.text: It was these three things that killed a third of humankind—the fire, smoke, and burning sulfur that came from the horses’ mouths.
The power of the horses was in their mouths and tails, for on the end of their tails were snake-like heads that could bite and injure people.
verses.html: The power of the horses was in their mouths and tails, for on the end of their tails were snake-like heads that could bite and injure people.

verses.heading: THE PEOPLE WHO WERE NOT KILLED / THE PEOPLE WHO WERE NOT KILLED
verses.text: The rest of the people who were not killed in this way did not turn away from the spirit-images they made with their own hands. They continued to follow evil spirits and pray to these spirit-images made of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood—things that cannot see, hear, or walk.
They also did not turn away from their murders, witchcraft, and sexual impurity, or from taking what is not theirs.

verses.heading: A SPIRIT-MESSENGER AND THE VOICE OF SEVEN THUNDERS / A SPIRIT-MESSENGER AND THE VOICE OF SEVEN THUNDERS
verses.text: Then I saw another powerful spirit-messenger coming down from the spirit-world above. He was clothed with a cloud, and a rainbow was over his head. His face was like the sun, his legs were like towers of fire,
and a small scroll lay open in his hand. He put his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land.
He cried out with a loud voice that roared like a lion. And when he cried out, the seven thunders spoke with rumbling voices.

I was about to write down the message spoken by the seven thunders when I heard a voice from the spirit-world above. “Do not reveal what the seven thunders have spoken,” the voice instructed me. “Seal up the words and do not write them down.”

verses.heading: THE ANCIENT MYSTERY IS FINISHED / THE ANCIENT MYSTERY IS FINISHED
verses.text: Then the spirit-messenger whom I saw standing on the sea and on the land raised his right hand to the spirit-world above.

He made a solemn promise representing the one who lives to the time beyond all days, the one who created all things in the spirit-world above, on the earth below, the great waters of the sea, and all that is in them. “There shall be no more delay,” he cried out,
verses.html:
He made a solemn promise representing the one who lives to the time beyond all days, the one who created all things in the spirit-world above, on the earth below, the great waters of the sea, and all that is in them.
“There shall be no more delay,” he cried out,

verses.text: “for the time has come for the seventh spirit-messenger to sound his eagle bone whistle! When he sounds, the ancient mystery spoken by the Great Spirit will be complete, bringing the full meaning and purpose of the good story that he revealed to his prophets who served him.”

verses.heading: THE SMALL SCROLL IS SWEET AND BITTER / THE SMALL SCROLL IS SWEET AND BITTER
verses.text: Then I again heard the voice that had spoken to me from the spirit-world above. “Go,” the voice said to me, “and take the scroll that is lying open in the hand of the spirit-messenger who is standing on the sea and on the land.”

I did as I was told and instructed the spirit-messenger to give me the scroll. “Take it and eat it,” the messenger said to me. “It will be as sweet as honey in your mouth, but it will turn bitter in your stomach.”
So I took the small scroll from the hand of the spirit-messenger and ate it. It was as sweet as honey in my mouth, but when I swallowed, it became bitter in my stomach.
Then I was told, “You must once again prophesy to many peoples, nations, languages, and rulers.”

verses.heading: MEASURING THE SACRED LODGE / MEASURING THE SACRED LODGE
verses.text: A measuring reed the size of a walking stick was given to me. “Rise up,” a voice said to me, “and measure Creator’s sacred lodge and the altar, and count the ones who make their prayers and serve him there.
But do not measure the courtyard that is outside of the lodge, for it has been given over to the Outside Nations. And for forty-two moons they will trample the sacred village under their feet.

verses.heading: THE TWO TRUTH-TELLER PROPHETS / THE TWO TRUTH-TELLER PROPHETS
verses.text: “And I will give power to my two truth tellers, and they will prophesy for one thousand two hundred sixty days, wearing rough animal hides to show the sorrow in their hearts.”
These are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand before the Honored One of all the earth.
Fire will come out from their mouths to burn up all their enemies. All who try to harm them must die in this manner.

They also have the power over the sky to hold back the rain during the days of their prophesying. And they have power over the waters, to turn them into blood, and the power to bring all kinds of disasters on the land as often as they desire.

verses.heading: THE TWO PROPHETS ARE KILLED / THE TWO PROPHETS ARE KILLED
verses.text: When they have completed their time of truth telling, the wild beast who rises from the deep, dark underworld will make war with them and defeat and kill them.

Their bodies will lie dead in the pathway of the great Village of Peace (Jerusalem), where our Honored Chief was killed by being nailed to a tree-pole—the cross. This village is spiritually known as Village of Bad Spirits (Sodom) and as Black Land (Egypt).
For three and a half days people from many tribes, languages, and nations will stare at their dead bodies and will not permit them to be buried properly.
Those who dwell in the land will celebrate with glad hearts and send gifts one to another, because these two prophets had caused them such great suffering.

verses.heading: THE PROPHETS RETURN TO LIFE / THE PROPHETS RETURN TO LIFE
verses.text: But after three and a half days, the breath of the Great Spirit entered into them. When they rose to their feet, great fear fell on all who were watching.
Then the two prophets heard a loud voice from the spirit-world above. “Come up here!” the voice said to them. As their enemies watched, a cloud took them up into the spirit-world above.

At that same time there was a great shaking of the earth. A tenth of the village came crashing down, and seven thousand people were killed. Those who remained were filled with fear and gave honor to the Great Spirit of the world above.
The second time of terrible pain and suffering has passed, but a third time of terrible pain and suffering will soon follow.

verses.heading: THE SEVENTH EAGLE BONE WHISTLE / THE SEVENTH EAGLE BONE WHISTLE
verses.text: Then when the seventh spirit-messenger sounded his eagle bone whistle, I heard loud voices in the spirit-world above. “The power to rule this world now belongs to our Great Spirit Chief and to his Chosen One,” the voices thundered, “and the guidance of his good road will last beyond the end of all days!”
verses.html:
Then when the seventh spirit-messenger sounded his eagle bone whistle, I heard loud voices in the spirit-world above.
“The power to rule this world now belongs to our Great Spirit Chief and to his Chosen One,” the voices thundered, “and the guidance of his good road will last beyond the end of all days!”

verses.text: Then the twenty-four elders, who sit in seats of honor before Creator, fell face down on the ground to give honor to the Great Spirit.
“We offer thanks to you, O Honored One,” they said with one voice. “You are the All-Powerful One, Who Is and Was, for you have revealed your great power and established your good road.
verses.html: “We offer thanks to you, O Honored One,” they said with one voice. “You are the All-Powerful One, Who Is and Was, for you have revealed your great power and established your good road.

verses.text: The nations were furious, but now the time of your fierce anger has come. It is time for you to decide the fate of the dead and to honor the ones who serve you—both prophets and holy ones—all who have deep respect for your name, from the smallest to the greatest among us. And it is time for you to bring to an end the ones who have brought destruction to the land.”
verses.html: The nations were furious, but now the time of your fierce anger has come. It is time for you to decide the fate of the dead and to honor the ones who serve you—both prophets and holy ones—all who have deep respect for your name, from the smallest to the greatest among us. And it is time for you to bring to an end the ones who have brought destruction to the land.”

verses.text: Then I looked and saw that the way into Creator’s sacred lodge in the spirit-world above was open. Inside the lodge the cedar box of the peace treaty came into view. Lightning flashed with the sound of crashing thunder, and the earth shook while large hailstones fell from the sky.
verses.html: Then I looked and saw that the way into Creator’s sacred lodge in the spirit-world above was open. Inside the lodge the cedar box of the peace treaty came into view. Lightning flashed with the sound of crashing thunder, and the earth shook while large hailstones fell from the sky.

verses.heading: OMENS IN THE WORLD ABOVE / OMENS IN THE WORLD ABOVE
verses.text: A great and mysterious omen was seen in the spirit-world above: a woman wearing the sun for her regalia, with the moon under her feet, and on her head a headdress of twelve stars.
She was with child and cried out in agony as she was giving birth.
Then another omen was seen in the spirit-world above: a great fiery-red sea serpent with seven heads and ten horns. On each of its seven heads it wore the headdress of a chief.

With its tail the sea serpent reached up into the spirit-world above and pulled down a third of all the stars and threw them down on the land. Then the fiery-red sea serpent, wanting to swallow up her child as soon as it was born, placed itself in front of the woman, waiting for her to give birth.

verses.heading: A SON IS BORN TO RULE THE NATIONS / A SON IS BORN TO RULE THE NATIONS
verses.text: The woman gave birth to a son, a male child, the one who holds an iron chief’s staff to rule over all nations. And her child was taken up to the Great Spirit and to his seat of honor.
The woman found safe passage into the desert wilderness, to the place Creator had prepared for her. There she would be fed and kept safe for one thousand two hundred sixty days.

verses.heading: WARFARE IN THE WORLD ABOVE / WARFARE IN THE WORLD ABOVE
verses.text: I looked up and saw that there was an uprising in the spirit-world above. Who Is Like Creator (Michael) and his spirit-messengers were waging war with the fiery-red sea serpent and its spirit-messengers. They fought back,
verses.html: I looked up and saw that there was an uprising in the spirit-world above. Who Is Like Creator (Michael) and his spirit-messengers were waging war with the fiery-red sea serpent and its spirit-messengers. They fought back,

verses.text: but they were not powerful enough, and the sea serpent and its spirit-messengers lost their foothold in the spirit-world above.

The great fiery-red sea serpent was thrown down from the spirit-world above. He is the ancient trickster snake, who is also called the evil one and Accuser (Satan). He is the one who takes the whole world down a false path. He was thrown down to the ground, along with all his spirit-messengers.
verses.html: The great fiery-red sea serpent was thrown down from the spirit-world above. He is the ancient trickster snake, who is also called the evil one and Accuser (Satan). He is the one who takes the whole world down a false path. He was thrown down to the ground, along with all his spirit-messengers.

verses.heading: CREATOR’S GOOD ROAD HAS ARRIVED / CREATOR’S GOOD ROAD HAS ARRIVED
verses.text: Then I heard a voice thundering in the spirit-world above, saying, “The good road of the Great Spirit has finally arrived! This good road has the power to set us free and make us whole! The Chosen One has walked this good road to the end and has the right to bring it to us. And now, the one who by day and by night accuses the sacred family members before the Great Spirit has been thrown down to the ground.
Creator’s holy ones won the victory over him by the lifeblood shed by the Lamb and by boldly telling his story, and, when faced with death, they loved him more than they loved their own lives.

“So let your hearts be glad, you who live in the spirit-world above. But to those who live on land and sea there will be great sorrow and trouble, for the evil trickster snake has come down upon you with great anger, because he knows that his time will soon come to an end.”
verses.html: “So let your hearts be glad, you who live in the spirit-world above. But to those who live on land and sea there will be great sorrow and trouble, for the evil trickster snake has come down upon you with great anger, because he knows that his time will soon come to an end.”

verses.heading: EAGLE HELPS THE WOMAN / EAGLE HELPS THE WOMAN
verses.text: So when the fiery-red sea serpent saw that he had been thrown down to the ground, he hunted down and mistreated the woman who had given birth to the male child.
verses.html: So when the fiery-red sea serpent saw that he had been thrown down to the ground, he hunted down and mistreated the woman who had given birth to the male child.

verses.text: But the woman was given two wings of a great eagle, so she could fly deep into the desert wilderness to a place where she would be cared for. There she was hidden from the face of the evil trickster snake—for a season, and seasons, and half a season.

verses.heading: THE LAND HELPS THE WOMAN / THE LAND HELPS THE WOMAN
verses.text: The sea serpent spewed a raging river of water out from its mouth at the woman, to carry her away in its flood.
But the land helped the woman by opening its mouth to swallow the river the sea serpent had spewed from its mouth.

The serpent’s anger toward the woman grew fierce, so it left her and attacked the rest of her descendants—the ones who walk in the ways of the Great Spirit and stand true to the message of Creator Sets Free (Jesus).

verses.heading: THE WILD BEAST FROM THE GREAT WATERS / THE WILD BEAST FROM THE GREAT WATERS
verses.text: The fiery-red sea serpent took its stand on the shore of the great waters. Then I saw a wild beast with ten horns and seven heads emerging from the waters. On each horn was a headdress like a chief would wear. Its heads had names carved into them that spoke evil against the Great Spirit.

I saw that the wild beast looked like a leopard with feet like a bear and a mouth like a mountain lion. The fiery-red sea serpent gave the wild beast its power, its seat of ruling, and its far-reaching dominion.
verses.html: I saw that the wild beast looked like a leopard with feet like a bear and a mouth like a mountain lion. The fiery-red sea serpent gave the wild beast its power, its seat of ruling, and its far-reaching dominion.

verses.text: I saw that one of the heads of the wild beast was fatally wounded, but the wound had healed, and all the people of the land were filled with wonder as they followed after the wild beast.

They were all bowing down and honoring the fiery-red sea serpent, because it had given power to the wild beast. So they gave honored service to the wild beast, saying, “Who can be compared to the wild beast? Who can make war with it?”

The fiery-red sea serpent filled the mouth of the wild beast with arrogant words and insults spoken against the Great Spirit. And for forty-two moons the wild beast was permitted to do whatever it wanted.
So it spoke with boldness against the Great Spirit, his name, his sacred lodge in the spirit-world above, and against all who live there.
The wild beast was given the ability to make war against Creator’s holy people and defeat them. It was also given authority over every tribe and people and language and nation.

All who dwell in the land will honor and serve the wild beast—all whose names have not been written down in the book of life belonging to the Lamb who was chosen to be violently killed from the formation of the world.
verses.html: All who dwell in the land will honor and serve the wild beast—all whose names have not been written down in the book of life belonging to the Lamb who was chosen to be violently killed from the formation of the world.

verses.text: Let the one who has ears, hear this:

“All who lead others into captivity will themselves become captive. All who take up the long knife to kill will by the long knife be killed.” This will test the faithfulness of Creator’s holy ones to stay true to the path of trusting in the ways of the Great Spirit.

verses.heading: THE WILD BEAST FROM THE LAND / THE WILD BEAST FROM THE LAND
verses.text: Then I saw another wild beast emerging from the land. This beast had two horns like a lamb, but it spoke like a fiery-red sea serpent.
Representing the first wild beast, it used its power to make all who dwell in the land honor and serve the first wild beast whose deadly wound had been healed.
It performed great signs and wonders in the sight of everyone, even making fire come down on the land from the sky.

Because of the signs that were done as it represented the first wild beast, it was able to trick the people who live in the land. It instructed them to carve an image to honor the first wild beast who was fatally wounded by the long knife yet lived.
verses.html: Because of the signs that were done as it represented the first wild beast, it was able to trick the people who live in the land. It instructed them to carve an image to honor the first wild beast who was fatally wounded by the long knife yet lived.

verses.text: It was given the power to give breath to the carved image and make it speak. It could then have anyone killed who would not bow down to honor the carved image of the first wild beast.
verses.html: It was given the power to give breath to the carved image and make it speak. It could then have anyone killed who would not bow down to honor the carved image of the first wild beast.

verses.text: The second wild beast then required everyone, small or great, rich or poor, slave or free, to be tattooed on their right hand or on their forehead,
so that no one could buy or sell without this mark, which represents the name of the wild beast or the number of its name.
Wisdom is needed here. The one who understands will count the number representing the name of the wild beast. It is the number of a human being, and this one’s number is six hundred sixty-six.

verses.heading: THE ONE HUNDRED AND FORTY-FOUR THOUSAND / THE ONE HUNDRED AND FORTY-FOUR THOUSAND
verses.text: Then I looked, and there on Strong Mountain (Mount Zion) stood the Lamb. Standing with him were one hundred forty-four thousand who had his name and the name of his father tattooed on their foreheads.

And coming from the spirit-world above I heard a voice that sounded like the roar of rushing water or the sound of loud thunder. And the voice I heard was like the sound of music being played on stringed instruments.

The singers were standing before the seat of honor and the four living spirit animals and the elders. They sang a new song that no one was able to learn except for the one hundred forty-four thousand, who, at a great cost, had been rescued from the land.
verses.html: The singers were standing before the seat of honor and the four living spirit animals and the elders. They sang a new song that no one was able to learn except for the one hundred forty-four thousand, who, at a great cost, had been rescued from the land.

verses.text: These are the ones who have kept themselves spiritually as pure as a virgin. Wherever the Lamb goes, they walk the road with him. They are the first from among humans to be set apart for the Great Spirit and for the Lamb. They are the ceremonial first fruits of the harvest, for a great price has been paid to rescue them and set them free.
verses.html: These are the ones who have kept themselves spiritually as pure as a virgin. Wherever the Lamb goes, they walk the road with him. They are the first from among humans to be set apart for the Great Spirit and for the Lamb. They are the ceremonial first fruits of the harvest, for a great price has been paid to rescue them and set them free.

verses.text: They speak only what is true, for they are spiritually pure and have no false ways within them.

verses.heading: A SPIRIT-MESSENGER ANNOUNCES THE GOOD STORY / A SPIRIT-MESSENGER ANNOUNCES THE GOOD STORY
verses.text: Then I saw another spirit-messenger flying high above me. The messenger had the words of the good story that tells about the good things of the world to come. This good story is to be told to all who dwell in the land, to every nation, tribe, language, and people!

“Show great respect and honor to the Great Spirit,” the messenger said with a loud voice, “for the time has come for him to decide who has done right and who has done wrong. Bow down and humble yourselves before the one who created the sky above, the earth below, the great waters of the sea, and the springs of water that flow out from the ground.”
verses.html: “Show great respect and honor to the Great Spirit,” the messenger said with a loud voice, “for the time has come for him to decide who has done right and who has done wrong. Bow down and humble yourselves before the one who created the sky above, the earth below, the great waters of the sea, and the springs of water that flow out from the ground.”

verses.text: A second spirit-messenger followed the first, saying, “It has fallen! The great Village of Confusion (Babylon) has fallen! She is the village that has made the nations drink of the wine of Creator’s anger toward her spiritual impurity.”
verses.html: A second spirit-messenger followed the first, saying, “It has fallen! The great Village of Confusion (Babylon) has fallen! She is the village that has made the nations drink of the wine of Creator’s anger toward her spiritual impurity.”

verses.heading: A WARNING TO THE FOLLOWERS OF THE WILD BEAST / A WARNING TO THE FOLLOWERS OF THE WILD BEAST
verses.text: The first two spirit-messengers were followed by a third spirit-messenger, who spoke with a thundering voice, saying, “All who bow down to serve the wild beast or its carved image or any who accept its mark on their foreheads or on their hands

will also drink the wine of Creator’s great anger. The wine in the cup of his deep anger will not be watered down, and those who drink it must face great suffering with fire and burning rocks in the presence of the holy spirit-messengers and the Lamb.

And the smoke from their suffering will rise to the time beyond the end of all days. And there will be no rest day or night for all who bow down to serve the wild beast or its carved image, or for any who accept the mark that represents its name.”
verses.html: And the smoke from their suffering will rise to the time beyond the end of all days. And there will be no rest day or night for all who bow down to serve the wild beast or its carved image, or for any who accept the mark that represents its name.”

verses.text: This is the time when Creator’s holy people, who follow his instructions and trust in the way of Creator Sets Free (Jesus), will be required to walk with firm steps and stay true to the path.

Then I heard a voice from the spirit-world above saying to me, “Write this down: from this time forward Creator’s blessing will rest on those who die, the ones who will make the ultimate sacrifice for their Honored Chief.” “It is true!” says the Spirit. “The weary will find rest from their troubled path, and what they have done will follow them into the world to come.”
verses.html:
Then I heard a voice from the spirit-world above saying to me, “Write this down: from this time forward Creator’s blessing will rest on those who die, the ones who will make the ultimate sacrifice for their Honored Chief.”
“It is true!” says the Spirit. “The weary will find rest from their troubled path, and what they have done will follow them into the world to come.”

verses.heading: THE LAND IS RIPE FOR THE HARVEST / THE LAND IS RIPE FOR THE HARVEST
verses.text: Then I looked up and saw a bright cloud, and there seated on the cloud was one that looked like a True Human Being. He wore a golden headdress and held a sharp harvesting stick in his hand.

Another spirit-messenger came out from the sacred lodge. With a loud voice he called out to one who was seated on the cloud, “Take your stick and start harvesting, for the time has come and the land is ripe.”
Then the one seated on the cloud swung his stick over the land and harvested the crop.
Another spirit-messenger came out from the sacred lodge that is in the spirit-world above. He also had a sharp harvesting stick.

He was followed by another spirit-messenger, one who has the power of fire. The messenger came out from the sacred altar and called out to the spirit-messenger with the sharp harvesting stick, “Take your sharp stick and harvest the grapes from the land, for her grapes are ripe.”
So the spirit-messenger swung his harvesting stick over the land, gathered the grapes, and threw them into the great winepress of Creator’s fierce anger.
Then, outside the village, the grapes were trampled on, and blood poured out from the winepress to the height of a horse’s shoulders for a distance of about two hundred miles.

verses.heading: A POWERFUL OMEN FROM ABOVE / A POWERFUL OMEN FROM ABOVE
verses.text: Then in the spirit-world above I saw another omen. It was powerful enough to take one’s breath away! There were seven spirit-messengers with seven last disasters. After these, Creator’s fierce anger will come to an end.

And then I saw what seemed to be a great sea, smooth and crystal clear, glowing with fire. And standing on this great sea were the ones who had won the victory over the wild beast, its carved image, and its mark. In their hands they held stringed instruments gifted to them from the Great Spirit.

They were singing the song of Creator’s servant Drawn from the Water (Moses) and the song of Creator’s Lamb. “O Great Creator and Honored One!” they sang with one voice. “All that you do is powerful and full of wonder! Your ways are right and true, O Chief of All Nations!
verses.html:
They were singing the song of Creator’s servant Drawn from the Water (Moses) and the song of Creator’s Lamb.
“O Great Creator and Honored One!” they sang with one voice. “All that you do is powerful and full of wonder! Your ways are right and true, O Chief of All Nations!

verses.text: Who is there who does not honor you with deep respect for who you are and what your name represents? Only you are holy! Because your right ways have been clearly shown to all nations, they will come to bring honor to you and serve you.”

verses.heading: THE SEVEN SPIRIT-MESSENGERS / THE SEVEN SPIRIT-MESSENGERS
verses.text: After this I looked up and in the spirit-world above I saw that the sacred tent of Creator’s peace treaty was opened.

The seven spirit-messengers who hold the power of the seven disasters came out from the sacred tent. They wore regalia made from pure, shining white garments with golden sashes wrapped around their chests.

Then one of the four living spirit animals gave to the seven spirit-messengers seven golden smudge bowls that were filled with the fiery anger of the Great Spirit, the one who lives beyond the end of all days.
verses.html: Then one of the four living spirit animals gave to the seven spirit-messengers seven golden smudge bowls that were filled with the fiery anger of the Great Spirit, the one who lives beyond the end of all days.

verses.text: Smoke that came from Creator’s shining-greatness filled the sacred tent, and no one was able to enter until the seven disasters from the seven spirit-messengers had come to an end.

verses.heading: THE SEVEN SMUDGE BOWLS POURED OUT / THE SEVEN SMUDGE BOWLS POURED OUT
verses.text: I then heard a loud voice coming from the sacred lodge in the spirit-world above. “Go!” the voice said to the seven spirit-messengers, “and pour out on the land the seven smudge bowls of Creator’s fiery anger.”
verses.html:
I then heard a loud voice coming from the sacred lodge in the spirit-world above.
“Go!” the voice said to the seven spirit-messengers, “and pour out on the land the seven smudge bowls of Creator’s fiery anger.”

verses.text: So the first spirit-messenger poured his smudge bowl onto the land, and horrible and painful sores broke out on the people who had the mark of the wild beast and bowed down to serve its carved image.
The second spirit-messenger poured his smudge bowl into the waters of the sea. And the waters turned into blood that was like the blood of a dead body—and all living things in the sea died.
The third spirit-messenger poured his smudge bowl into rivers and springs of water, and their waters also turned into blood.
Then I heard the spirit-messenger of the waters say, “You are upright and true, O Holy One Who Is and Was. Your decisions are right and true!
For the ones who shed the blood of your holy ones and prophets have been given blood to drink, and this is what they deserve.”
And I heard a voice from the sacred altar, saying, “All your decisions are upright and true, O Honored and all-powerful Great Spirit!”
Then the fourth spirit-messenger poured out his smudge bowl on the sun, which was permitted to scorch people with fire.
When scorched by the fierce heat, they cursed the Great Spirit, the one who had the power over these disasters. But they did not return to Creator’s right ways and give him the honor he deserves.

The fifth spirit-messenger poured out his smudge bowl on the wild beast’s seat of power. And all that the wild beast ruled over was covered in darkness. The people the wild beast ruled over gnawed their tongues in pain
verses.html: The fifth spirit-messenger poured out his smudge bowl on the wild beast’s seat of power. And all that the wild beast ruled over was covered in darkness. The people the wild beast ruled over gnawed their tongues in pain

verses.text: and cursed the Great Spirit from the spirit-world above. But they would not turn back from their evil ways to Creator’s right ways.

The sixth spirit-messenger then poured out his smudge bowl on the great river named Much Fruit (Euphrates). The waters of the river dried up to prepare the way for the rulers that would come from the east.
Then I saw three impure frog-spirits coming out from the mouth of the fiery-red sea serpent, the wild beast, and the false prophet.

These spirits are evil demons, performing misleading signs and omens. These spirits go out into all the lands, to gather their rulers to make war against the Great Spirit on the day of the great battle when he shows his mighty power.
verses.html: These spirits are evil demons, performing misleading signs and omens. These spirits go out into all the lands, to gather their rulers to make war against the Great Spirit on the day of the great battle when he shows his mighty power.

verses.heading: HE COMES LIKE A THIEF / HE COMES LIKE A THIEF
verses.text: “Behold, I am coming like a thief!” says Creator Sets Free (Jesus). “Creator’s blessing will rest on the one who remains awake, wearing regalia, and not naked and ashamed for all to see.”
verses.html: “Behold, I am coming like a thief!” says Creator Sets Free (Jesus). “Creator’s blessing will rest on the one who remains awake, wearing regalia, and not naked and ashamed for all to see.”

verses.text: And the evil frog-spirits gathered the rulers together to the place called in our tribal language Mountain of Invasion (Armageddon).
Then the seventh spirit-messenger poured out his smudge bowl in the air. Out of the sacred lodge came a loud voice from the seat of honor. “It is done!” the voice roared.
The lightning flashed, the thunder rumbled, and the earth shook violently! The earthquake was greater than humankind has ever seen or felt before!

The great village was split into three parts, and the villages of the Outside Nations fell to the ground. Creator remembered all that the great Village of Confusion (Babylon) had done and gave her the cup that was filled with his fierce anger.
Every island sank into the great waters, and the mountains could not be found.
Monstrous one-hundred-pound hailstones fell from the sky onto the people. The people cursed the Great Spirit for the hailstones that brought on them such a great disaster.

verses.heading: THE FATE OF THE GREAT VILLAGE OF CONFUSION / THE FATE OF THE GREAT VILLAGE OF CONFUSION
verses.text: One of the seven spirit-messengers who had the seven smudge bowls came to talk with me. “Come,” the spirit-messenger said to me, “and I will show you the fate of the infamous woman who sits on many waters and trades her body for possessions.
The rulers of the land have participated in her broken and impure ways. And the people of the land have become drunk on the wine of her impurities.”

verses.heading: THE WOMAN WHO SITS ON THE WILD BEAST / THE WOMAN WHO SITS ON THE WILD BEAST
verses.text: The spirit-messenger carried me away in the spirit to a desert wilderness. I saw a woman sitting on a wild beast that was red in color. The wild beast had seven heads with ten horns and was filled with names that spoke evil against the Great Spirit.
The woman wore purple and red garments sparkling with gold, costly stones, and pearls. She held in her hand a golden cup filled with all of her horrible, shameful, and impure ways.
Carved into her forehead was a mysterious name: VILLAGE OF CONFUSION, MOTHER OF ALL WHO DWELL IN THE LAND AND FOLLOW SHAMEFUL AND IMPURE WAYS

I could see that this woman was drunk with the blood of Creator’s holy ones and with the blood of the truth tellers for Creator Sets Free (Jesus). I could only stare at this woman with wonder and amazement.

verses.heading: THE MYSTERY OF THE WOMAN IS REVEALED / THE MYSTERY OF THE WOMAN IS REVEALED
